data.jd_text:
**Description**
 Amazon Now is building the future of ultra\-fast grocery delivery across the Middle East. We are looking for a Program Manager to drive measurable improvements across store capacity management, cost\-per\-order reduction, and delivery speed (Click\-to\-Door).
   

  

 This role sits within the Operations Excellence function and is responsible for identifying, scoping, and delivering high\-impact programmes that improve customer experience and unit economics across Amazon Now’s network in Saudi Arabia.
   

  

 You will work across Last Mile, Middle Mile, and Under\-The\-Roof (UTR) operations to find inefficiencies, build the business case, and drive cross\-functional execution. This is not a reactive role, you will proactively identify opportunities before they become problems, connect the dots across operational channels, and ensure every initiative ladders up to CX outcomes and P\&L impact.
   

  

 The right candidate is analytically sharp, comfortable with ambiguity, and operates with a bias for action. You think in systems, not silos. You’re as comfortable in the data as you are in a room with senior stakeholders making the case for change.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Store Capacity \& Cost Management
   

  

* Own programmes to optimise store capacity utilization, including bin density, ASIN rationalisation, gas tank management, and space allocation across darkstores.
* Drive cost\-per\-order reduction across the end\-to\-end operation: UTR pick efficiency, DA (Delivery Associate) productivity, hub\-to\-store transhipment costs, and middle mile truck utilisation.
* Analyse operational cost structures to identify the highest\-leverage opportunities for unit economics improvement. Build business cases with clear ROI and execution plans.
* Partner with UTR, Last Mile, and Middle Mile teams to implement changes that reduce waste, improve throughput, and lower cost\-to\-serve without degrading customer experience.
* Develop and maintain dashboards and reporting mechanisms to track capacity utilisation and cost metrics across KSA stores.


 Delivery Speed \& Click\-to\-Door (C2D)
   

  

* Own the programme roadmap for C2D reduction, identifying bottlenecks across order acceptance, pick \& pack, dispatch, and last mile delivery.
* Analyse delivery defects, early delivery marking, Did\-Not\-Receive (DNR) patterns, and other CX pain points to drive root cause resolution.
* Identify and eliminate handoff delays between UTR, Middle Mile, and Last Mile that contribute to C2D inflation.


 Project \& Programme Delivery
   

  

* Scope, plan, and execute operational improvement projects end\-to\-end, from opportunity identification through to measurable business impact.
* Build and manage a portfolio of initiatives across capacity, cost, and speed, with clear prioritisation based on CX and P\&L impact.
* Create mechanisms for project tracking, stakeholder communication, and escalation. Maintain a clear view of project status, risks, and dependencies.
* Drive cross\-functional alignment with ACES, Tech, Finance, Category, and operations teams to remove blockers and deliver on commitments.
* Contribute to the development of scalable solutions that can be replicated across KSA stores, solve once, scale everywhere.


 Cross\-Functional Influence \& Visibility
   

  

* Operate as the connective tissue between operational channels, ensuring improvements in one area don’t create problems in another.
* Build visibility into operational performance through data, dashboards, and regular reporting cadences (WBR/MBR contributions).
* Influence without authority, drive outcomes through data\-backed recommendations, clear communication, and stakeholder management.
* Support Automation \& AI initiatives that drive efficiency, reduce manual effort, and improve decision\-making across operations.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 5\+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Master's degree
* Experience in program requirements definition, together with data and metrics leveraging to drive improvements


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 5\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience in project management methodologies, business analysis, or process improvement
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL

If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

data.jd_text:
**Description**
 Amazon is seeking an experienced Program Manager to help scale our operations network through the launch of new facilities and expansion initiatives across the UAE. This role offers the opportunity to lead complex, high\-visibility programs that directly impact customer experience, business growth, and operational excellence.
   

  

 As a Program Manager, you will own end\-to\-end delivery of expansion projects from site selection and design through construction, launch readiness, and operational handover. You will work across multiple stakeholder groups including operations, engineering, finance, procurement, real estate, technology, and external partners to deliver new facilities safely, on time, and within budget.
   

  

 This role requires strong program management skills, the ability to navigate ambiguity, influence stakeholders across different functions, and drive execution in a fast\-paced environment where priorities evolve quickly.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of network expansion and launch programs, ensuring projects are completed safely, on schedule, and within budget.
* Develop project plans, launch schedules, governance mechanisms, and risk mitigation strategies across multiple concurrent initiatives.
* Partner with operations, engineering, finance, procurement, technology, and real estate teams to define requirements and ensure successful project execution.
* Manage external vendors, consultants, contractors, and service providers throughout the project lifecycle.
* Track project performance through data, metrics, and reporting mechanisms, identifying risks and driving corrective actions when required.
* Own stakeholder communication, providing clear updates on milestones, dependencies, financial performance, risks, and launch readiness.
* Drive process standardization and continuous improvement initiatives to improve launch speed, reduce cost, and increase scalability across markets.
* Support business planning activities including capital planning, budget forecasting, resource planning, and long\-term network expansion strategies.
* Conduct site visits and audits to validate project progress, operational readiness, quality standards, and compliance requirements.
* Build scalable tools, mechanisms, and operating models that enable efficient execution of future expansion programs.


 A day in the life
   

  

 As a Program Manager, your primary focus will be delivering expansion and launch projects that help Amazon grow its operational footprint across the UAE.
   

  

 A typical day may include reviewing project milestones, coordinating with stakeholders, resolving execution risks, and tracking launch readiness activities. You will work closely with operations, engineering, finance, procurement, and external partners to keep projects on schedule and within budget.
   

  

 You will regularly analyze performance metrics, drive process improvements, and communicate progress, risks, and key decisions to senior leaders. Success in this role comes from balancing strategic thinking with hands\-on execution and delivering results.
   

  

**About The Team**
 In the Amazon Now team, you will be part of a high\-velocity, high\-visibility group responsible for launching programs that unlock new growth and capabilities for Amazon globally. You’ll have the opportunity to build new processes, shape how we scale, and make a measurable difference. Working from UAE, you will collaborate with global teams, drive significant impact, and help elevate Amazon’s capabilities in a market of strategic importance.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* Bachelor's degree in BI, finance, engineering, statistics, computer science, mathematics, finance or equivalent quantitative field
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
* 3\+ years of delivering cross functional projects experience
* Experience in project management including resource planning, managing schedules, reporting project status and prioritizing own tasks and those of other team members for multiple projects


**Preferred Qualifications**
* PMP certificate
* Experience communicating results to senior leadership

data.jd_text:
Lead and oversee the addressing and GIS function within the Licensing unit by developing and implementing strategies that ensure accurate location identification, standardized address data, and effective integration with organizational systems, while collaborating with key stakeholders to enhance national addressing capabilities and meet their address\-related needs.
 



  





  





**Strategy, Policy and Procedure** 



* Lead the development and implementation of GIS and national addressing systems aligned with the overall Licensing and postal infrastructure strategy.
* Establish policies, standards and procedures governing address data management, GIS integration and location intelligence platforms.
* Ensure alignment with national geographic information standards and international postal addressing frameworks
* Define key performance indicators, service standards and operational KPIs for GIS and addressing initiatives.
* Maintain the confidentiality of the information relating to work, to protect the interests and activity of the Company.



  





**Addressing and Post Code Projects** 



* Monitor and follow up on the implementation of the UAE Post Code project in coordination with municipalities and GIS centers, ensuring compliance with agreed standards.
* Lead and direct the design, implementation and continuous improvement of the addressing system, including address formats, coding systems and classification standards.
* Develop and implement processes to collect, verify, and validate address data through address verification tools, audits and coordination with relevant entities to maintain address accuracy.
* Direct and oversee the assignment and maintenance of unique addresses for new properties and ‎locations within the postal network.‎
* Ensure efficient handling and resolution of address\-related inquiries and issues from internal ‎and external stakeholders.‎
* Direct and oversee the assignment and maintenance of unique addresses for new properties and ‎locations within the postal network.‎
* Ensure efficient handling and resolution of address\-related inquiries and issues from internal ‎and external stakeholders.‎



  





**Project Governance and Continuous Improvement** 



* Oversee the planning, execution, and monitoring of GIS and addressing\-related projects ensuring compliance with defined timelines, budgets, and quality standards.
* Identify opportunities to enhance addressing accuracy, operational efficiency, and digital service integration by evaluating new technologies, tools, and methodologies within the addressing function.



  





**Synergies with Stakeholders** 



* Collaborate with external stakeholders such as government entities, municipalities, utility providers, emergency services, GIS centres and postal authorities to support accurate addressing and service delivery.
* Maintain partnerships with GIS technology vendors and solution providers to ensure adoption of best practices and innovations.



  





**Reports** 



* Prepare periodic reports on addressing system performance, data accuracy, GIS and spatial data reports, Post Code and addressing projects status reports to support management decision\-making.
* Develop analytical and GIS\-related reports highlighting trends, operational gaps and improvement opportunities within the addressing system.



  





**Team Management** 



* Ensure a high standard of employee motivation through regular employee communication, training and equipping with the best tools to achieve the maximum results.
* Set comprehensive goals for performance \& growth ensuring the team is capable of delivering the strategic intent.



  





**Other Tasks** 



* Perform any other responsibilities relating to this job request or work task as allocated by the Line Manager.



  





**Qualifications and Knowledge:** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Geographic Information Systems, Geomatics, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* Certifications like GIS Professional (GISP) or Esri Technical preferred.



  





**Experience:** 



* 7\-10 years experience in a leadership role in GIS, addressing systems, geospatial data management, or related fields at a national or organizational level.
* Experience working with government entities, municipalities, or logistics/postal organizations



  





**Job Specific Skills (Technical Competencies):** 



* GIS platforms and geospatial technologies
* Address management systems and postal addressing standards
* Spatial data analytics and mapping
* Data governance and integration
* Project and program management
* Digital transformation and system integration
* Stakeholder management
* Communication and collaboration skills

data.jd_text:
Equiti is a pioneering fintech firm and world\-class provider of multi\-asset fintech products \- from liquidity solutions to in\-house tech hubs to online trading platforms. With over 400 global specialists in 9 languages, Equiti provides clients with access to individual, professional, and institutional brokerage services in Europe, the Middle East, and Africa.
 



  





 At Equiti, we believe that financial opportunities can unlock potential for everyone, everywhere. We’re on a mission to deliver accessible online trading products around the world through education and accessibility.
 



  





 Think finance is stuffy? Think again.
 



  





 At Equiti, we’re building fintech with a purpose: making wealth tools accessible to everyone. As we continue to grow, we’re seeking talented individuals who thrive in innovative environments. , and we are on the lookout for talented individuals who can perform and excel in a dynamic and innovative working environment. Our Technology department would like to welcome a detail\-oriented.
 



  





**Head of Engineering Excellence** 
 in our office in Dubai.
 



  





 As the Head of Engineering Excellence, you will…
 



 Be the force that turns Equiti’s engineering principles into everyday practice. Reporting directly to the CTO, you will own the operating system of the technology organisation — the standards, processes, delivery cadence and metrics that keep a fast\-scaling, multi\-domain engineering org accountable, aligned and continuously improving. You will be the CTO’s trusted partner for execution: making sure the right things get done, by the right owners, to the right standard — without the CTO having to chase.
 



 You will define and enforce how the engineering org works — ways of working, communication and accountability standards, and delivery governance — and make performance visible through engineering KPIs and dashboards. You will lead a culture of Kaizen (continuous improvement), running the cadences and retrospectives that turn data and incidents into lasting improvements across mobile, web, backend, data, platform, QA and trading teams.
 



 You will also be Equiti’s engineering voice to the outside world — championing our work through blogs, talks and conferences, growing our presence in the developer community, and building the technical brand that draws great people to us.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



* Own and enforce Equiti’s engineering principles, standards and ways of working across all technology domains.
* Define, track and report engineering KPIs — delivery throughput and predictability, DORA metrics (deployment frequency, lead time, change\-failure rate, MTTR), responsiveness/SLA attainment and quality — and turn them into action.
* Run the engineering operating cadence: planning, delivery reviews, incident/postmortem reviews and the operations review that holds owners accountable to SLAs.
* Drive a culture of Kaizen / continuous improvement — facilitate retrospectives, identify systemic bottlenecks, and land process improvements that stick.
* Embed the communication \& accountability framework — ownership/RACI, triage lanes, escalation and channel standards — so nothing falls through the cracks.
* Govern cross\-team delivery for major programmes and product launches; surface risks and dependencies early and unblock them.
* Partner with domain leads to raise engineering maturity, consistency and governance — without slowing teams down.
* Act as the CTO’s go to on execution — translate strategy into tracked outcomes, prepare leadership and board\-ready updates, and ensure follow\-through on decisions.
* Champion engineering quality, change management and operational excellence in partnership with SRE / Engineering Platforms.
* Establish lightweight tooling and dashboards (within the ticketing and observability stack) that make standards and metrics self\-serve for every team.
* Lead Equiti’s external engineering evangelism — represent the technology org through conference talks, meetups and panels, and grow our standing in the wider engineering community.
* Own the Equiti engineering blog and technical thought leadership, and shape the engineering employer brand that helps attract and retain top talent.



  





**Experience Requirements** 



* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 10\+ years in software engineering, technical programme management, or engineering operations, with at least 5 years leading process or delivery excellence in scaled engineering organisations.
* Proven track record defining and enforcing engineering principles, ways of working and delivery governance across multiple teams.
* Deep fluency in engineering KPIs and metrics (DORA, delivery predictability, quality, reliability) and in building dashboards that change behaviour.
* Hands\-on experience leading continuous improvement / Kaizen, Agile, and incident/postmortem practices at scale.
* Strong technical credibility — able to hold weight with senior engineers and architects — without needing to be the deepest coder in the room.
* Exceptional influence and stakeholder management; able to enforce standards through trust and clarity, not authority alone.
* A confident public communicator — a track record of external technical writing, conference speaking, or developer\-community engagement (engineering blogs, talks, open source).
* Experience operating as a trusted partner to a CTO or VP of Engineering (programme leadership / execution\-focused role) strongly preferred.
* Experience in fintech, brokerage, or regulated industries preferred.
* Based in, or willing to relocate to, Dubai.



  





  





**Perks** 




  





 Each of our offices has its special perks; be it ‘no ties’, free lunches, charity events, or a hybrid work policy – but whenever you walk into an Equiti office, you’re sure to see a friendly face. We encourage international collaborations and always keep our eyes open to how we can do more.
 



 The benefits you can expect at your Equiti workplace include:
 


* Competitive salary package
* Performance\-based bonus
* Medical insurance coverage for employees and family members
* Smart working options
* Employee wellness initiatives
* Personalized career development
* Company lunch in the office
* Regular company events



  





 With energy, drive, and imagination, there’s no limit to where your career can go at Equiti. With a diverse workforce and geographical spread of offices, we strongly support career development initiatives as well as provide a range of opportunities for professional and life experiences.
 



  





 Equiti is an equal opportunity employer.
 



  





 “Equiti” refers to a group of companies consisting of seven regulated financial services companies licensed to operate in the respective jurisdictions of their incorporation, in addition to our tech and marketing hubs. Equiti has presence in Africa, Europe, and the Middle East.

I am currently looking for an experienced
 **Project Director** 
 to lead the successful delivery of several High\-Rise projects across Dubai. This is a senior leadership position suited to an individual with a proven background in delivery of High\-Rise buildings from construction stage through to successful handover.
 



  





 The successful candidate will be responsible for overseeing all site activities, ensuring projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget, and to the highest standards of quality. You will act as a key point of contact between clients, consultants, and project teams while providing strategic leadership throughout the project lifecycle.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Lead the delivery of complex, large\-scale construction projects, overseeing all site operations from mobilisation through to completion and handover.
* Manage project teams, contractors, subcontractors, and consultants to ensure successful project execution.
* Develop and implement project strategies, programmes, schedules, and delivery plans aligned with client expectations and contractual requirements.
* Monitor project budgets, commercial performance, resource allocation, and overall project progress.
* Oversee contract administration, ensuring compliance with contractual obligations, variations, claims, and project requirements.
* Identify potential project risks and implement effective mitigation strategies to protect programme, cost, and quality objectives.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, stakeholders, authorities, and project partners.
* Lead coordination between design, commercial, construction, and technical teams to ensure efficient project delivery.
* Ensure compliance with Dubai construction regulations, authority requirements, health \& safety standards, and quality procedures.
* Drive best practices across project delivery, improving processes, efficiency, and overall project performance.
* Provide clear reporting and project updates to senior leadership and key stakeholders.
* Mentor and develop project teams, creating a high\-performance and collaborative working environment.



  





**Requirements:** 



* Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a related discipline.
* PMP certification or equivalent project management qualification is preferred.
* Minimum 18 years’ experience within construction, project management, or supervision, with a strong track record delivering major developments.
* Previous experience operating as a Project Director or Senior Project Manager on High\-Rise projects is a Must.
* Strong Middle East experience is essential, with proven knowledge of the Dubai construction market.
* Strong understanding of construction methodologies, project controls, planning, cost management, and risk mitigation.
* Ability to manage large multidisciplinary teams.
* Excellent client\-facing skills with experience dealing directly with developers, consultants, subcontractors, and government authorities.
* Strong leadership, communication, and decision\-making abilities.



  





 This is an excellent opportunity for an established Project Director to play a key role in delivering high\-rise developments in Dubai.

**Job Description**
 WSP Middle East is seeking an experienced AI Business Partner to work in direct partnership with the Property \& Buildings (P\&B) Business Unit leadership. This senior role sits at the intersection of design, engineering, and applied intelligence, driving the integration of emerging technologies into core business and project delivery processes.
   

  

 The successful candidate will combine deep architectural or engineering expertise with the ability to apply AI, computational design, and digital tools to deliver measurable performance improvements across major programmes.
   

  

 As the single point of accountability for the P\&B AI agenda, you will define priorities, lead delivery, and embed scalable solutions that enhance design quality, operational efficiency, and client outcomes.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Strategic Partnership \& Leadership**
* Act as the dedicated AI Business Partner to P\&B leadership across the Middle East.
* Develop and maintain a clear AI and digital roadmap aligned to business priorities and project demands.
* Provide informed, experience\-led advisory to senior stakeholders on opportunities, risks, and investment decisions.


**Use Case Development \& Value Realisation**
* Identify and prioritise high\-impact use cases across the full project lifecycle—from concept design to delivery.
* Build structured business cases with clear KPIs, ROI, and measurable outcomes.
* Maintain a transparent pipeline from opportunity identification through to scaled deployment.


**Computational Design \& Technical Enablement**
* Lead the integration of AI and computational design approaches into project workflows.
* Drive AI adoption within tools including Revit, Dynamo, Rhino, Grasshopper, AutoCAD, and Power BI to support data\-driven design.
* Promote a culture of continuous improvement and innovation within design and engineering teams.


**Delivery \& Change Management**
* Oversee the end\-to\-end implementation of AI solutions within live project environments.
* Ensure solutions are practical, scalable, and adopted effectively by multidisciplinary teams.
* Lead change management efforts to embed new ways of working across large programmes.


**Governance, Risk \& Compliance**
* Establish and maintain governance frameworks for AI deployment within P\&B.
* Ensure adherence to WSP standards relating to data security, intellectual property, and risk management.
* Support client engagement on responsible and ethical use of AI technologies.


**Performance Tracking \& Reporting**
* Track and report on performance, benefits, and adoption of AI initiatives.
* Provide clear, executive\-level reporting aligned to business outcomes.
* Continuously refine strategy based on performance insights and evolving requirements.


**Qualifications**
* Degree in Architecture, Engineering, or a related discipline; professional accreditation (e.g. RIBA, ARB) is advantageous.
* Minimum 10 years’ experience within a Design Manager, Architect, or equivalent role, delivering large\-scale projects.
* Strong understanding of multidisciplinary engineering principles within the built environment.
* Proven experience managing complex, multi\-stakeholder programmes.
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive strategic initiatives.
* Experience delivering digital, data\-driven, or AI\-enabled solutions within the AEC sector.
* Strong regional experience within the Middle East market.


**Technical Capability**
* Proficiency in BIM and computational design tools (Revit, Dynamo, Grasshopper, Rhino).
* Understanding of data workflows, automation, and emerging AI capabilities within design and engineering contexts.


**Desirable Experience**
* Exposure to Generative AI, advanced analytics, and automation platforms.
* Familiarity with project delivery systems such as P6, Aconex, ACC, and Power BI.
* Experience working within structured enterprise governance environments.
* Background in digital engineering, BIM leadership, or design technology roles.

data.jd_text:
Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drive everything we do. The Middle East markets (UAE and Kuwait) are one of our most dynamic and competitive markets. Functions include commercial, operations, and marketing, and teams in the Middle East partner closely with global functions such as product, technology, and consumer to deliver results for our customers.
   

  

 This role sits within Operations and leads all things Rider Experience. A large and impactful scope that includes Rider community management, Rider communications, several aspects of Rider Performance, Rider Support, and Rider Onboarding. The role entails building, improving, and implementing processes across the areas above, tracking and managing efficiency and effectiveness of how we are performing across a variety of metrics, and finally ensuring that we are able to deliver excellent support to riders across the region.
   

  

**The Role**
 Operating at scale in a hyper\-competitive, hyper\-growth environment is no easy feat. As such, you'll be faced with some of the most exciting problems across the food tech space. Reporting to the Director of Operations, Middle East, you’ll have a key role in ensuring the success of the logistics network in our Middle East markets. This centers around ensuring that we always have a fleet of highly engaged, highly satisfied, and highly performing riders on our network. Working with stakeholders within Ops to find the right approach through levers like communications, education modules, and rider events. This role is regional, and will be required to build world\-class frameworks and systems that are both effective and scalable. The objective is straightforward: build the best systems to ensure riders are able to deliver the best experience for our customers and merchants.
   

  

 You’ll work closely with other members of the Middle East rider operations teams, as well as wider teams within HQ Ops, Product, and Tech to ensure the best possible outcomes for our riders, restaurants, and customers.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
 Here’s what your day\-to\-day might look like:
   

  

* Managing a large team that owns and runs several processes across the scope of the team
* Building effective, scalable, and efficient frameworks and systems that can be centralized to manage and track several key metrics across our network
* Make recommendations on how to allocate our resources to ensure the best possible outcomes, for instance, managing rider churn to optimal levels to ensure best\-in\-class service levels
* Ensuring the quality and engagement of riders newly onboarded on our network is conducive to our strategy of having best\-in\-class service levels
* Track our key metrics, look for unusual trends in our data, and uncover root causes to ensure that we preserve the health of the network.
* Work alongside other members of the Middle East Rider Operations team to ensure that we operate to budget
* Provide regular, relevant, concise updates on rider experience to senior business stakeholders.


**What You'll Need To Thrive**
 Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:
   

  

* A high standard of university\-level education
* 8\+ years of experience in program management, consulting, banking, engineering, or a high\-growth start\-up
* Excellent problem\-solving skills – experience solving tough, complex problems
* An ownership mindset that means you know what is happening in your area of responsibility
* Experience managing a multi\-functional team
* Experience building scalable processes, tools, and structured change methodologies, and therefore enjoying working in a process\-driven environment
* Strong analytical mindset and comfortable with large data sets
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
* Comfortable handling multiple workstreams at the same time, working both individually and as part of a team


**Why Join Us?**
 At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real\-world problems in a three\-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving.
   

  

 We’re Food Lovers, Problem Solvers, Community Builders, And More, Brought Together By a Shared Drive To Make Things Better. Working Here, You Can Expect To
   

  

**🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale** 
 Work on a complex, always\-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.
   

  

 🌱
 **See your impact, fast** 
 Ship, test, and improve ideas quickly in a low\-hierarchy, high\-ownership
   

  

 environment.
   

  

**🧠Grow through challenge and ownership** 
 Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.
   

  

**🌎A culture built for builders** 
 High standards, collaboration, flexible working, and continuous learning.
   

  

 We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3\-4 stages. Find more about how we hire
 **here.**
**Our Global Structure**
 Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
   

  

**Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion**
 At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.
   

  

 We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio\-economic background, religion, or belief.
   

  

 If you have a disability or long\-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.
   

  

 If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast\-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

 Your impact
   

  

 At Jacobs, we push the limits of what’s possible to make the world smarter, more connected and more sustainable. In our transport work, that means designing innovative solutions to move people and goods safely and efficiently across the globe. From rail systems mobilising accessible transit, to ports linking land and sea – when it comes to connecting the people and places of tomorrow, the future of transport depends on us.
   

  

 Bring your curiosity, talent for multi\-tasking, and extreme attention to detail, and we’ll help you grow, pursue and fulfill what drives you – so we can make big impacts on the world, together
   

  

 We are seeking a
 **Principal Consultant / Engagement Manager** 
 to join our Strategic Advisory team in the Middle East. This is a leadership role focused on delivering strategic and advisory engagements across a broad range of government priorities, including economic development, sector development, infrastructure, investment initiatives, policy implementation, and national transformation programs.
   

  

 The successful candidate will lead complex consulting engagements, manage multidisciplinary teams, build trusted client relationships, and support the continued growth of our advisory business across the region.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 As a
 **Principal Consultant / Engagement Manager** 
 , you will play a pivotal role in delivering high\-impact advisory services while supporting the growth of the practice.
   

  

 Your responsibilities will include
   

  

* Leading multidisciplinary teams in the delivery of complex advisory engagements for government, public sector, and private sector clients.
* Advising ministries, government agencies, regulators, public authorities, government\-owned entities, investors, and private sector organizations on strategic priorities, sector development, policy implementation, investment initiatives, and transformational programs.
* Managing the development of strategies, business cases, policy assessments, implementation plans, economic analyses, sector studies, and other advisory deliverables tailored to client needs.
* Supporting clients in addressing complex economic, social, infrastructure, and development challenges through evidence\-based analysis and practical recommendations.
* Conducting research, benchmarking, market assessments, and quantitative and qualitative analyses to support strategic decision\-making.
* Managing complex stakeholder environments and engaging effectively with senior government officials, executives, regulators, investors, and private sector leaders.
* Leading project delivery to ensure technical excellence, commercial performance, quality outcomes, and client satisfaction.
* Managing project budgets, schedules, resources, risks, and contractual obligations.
* Supporting major national initiatives, sector development programs, and strategic priorities across the Middle East.
* Supporting business development activities, including opportunity identification, client engagement, and proposal preparation.
* Building and maintaining strong client relationships and acting as a trusted advisor to senior decision\-makers.
* Supporting collaboration across Jacobs' global advisory network to leverage best practices and technical expertise.

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Economics, Business Administration, Public Policy, Engineering, Finance, or a related discipline.
* 8\+ years of professional experience in management consulting, government advisory, public sector advisory, strategy consulting, economic development, infrastructure advisory, or a related field.

* Experience delivering advisory projects for government entities, public authorities, regulators, government\-owned organizations, investors, or private sector clients.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, report writing, and presentation skills.
* Strong stakeholder engagement and communication skills with the ability to influence senior decision\-makers.
* Strong project management capabilities with experience managing budgets, schedules, and client relationships.
* Proven ability to support business development activities and contribute to winning new work.


 Ideally, Here's What You'll Also Have
   

  

* Experience supporting national transformation initiatives, Vision programs, or government development agendas within the GCC and broader Middle East region.
* Experience across one or more sectors including economic development, infrastructure, transportation, industry, energy, utilities, tourism, social infrastructure, or public services.
* Experience advising ministries, government authorities, development agencies, regulators, sovereign entities, investors, or private sector organizations.
* Understanding of public sector decision\-making processes, policy environments, and government priorities within the Middle East.
* Ability and willingness to travel across the Middle East.
* A passion for helping clients address complex challenges and deliver meaningful outcomes for governments, businesses, citizens, and communities.

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
 What if you could do the kind of work the world needs?
   

  

 At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.
   

  

 As a Senior Project Manager, you are responsible for the strategic leadership and successful delivery of complex, multi\-disciplinary projects, with a focus on retail and mixed\-use developments, from early concept through to completion.
   

  

 The role requires a highly proactive and commercially astute approach, ensuring delivery aligns with client objectives, brand requirements, operational constraints, and fast\-track retail programmes. You will lead project teams, drive decision\-making, and manage key stakeholder relationships, ensuring high\-quality outcomes across all stages of design and delivery.
   

  

 You are expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy, provide leadership across multiple workstreams, and act as a trusted advisor to clients.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Contract \& Scope
   

  

* Lead project set\-up, including contract finalisation, internal alignment and mobilisation of the team
* Fully understand and manage the contract, ensuring compliance with key obligations and deliverables
* Define, agree and manage scope across all disciplines, ensuring clarity of responsibilities
* Lead the appointment and coordination of sub\-consultants, including scope, fees and agreements
* Identify and manage changes to scope, leading variation preparation, negotiation and agreement with the client
* Ensure all deliverables meet WSP quality standards and client expectations


 Communication \& Team Leadership
   

  

* Act as the primary interface with the client, operators, tenants, and key stakeholders
* Provide clear leadership, establishing a high\-performing “one team” culture
* Lead client engagement, workshops and presentations, including executive\-level reporting
* Manage complex stakeholder environments, including retail tenants, landlords, operators and authorities
* Support clients with strategic decision\-making, balancing commercial, operational and design priorities
* Proactively manage expectations, risks and issues to maintain trust and project momentum Programme
* Lead development of detailed, realistic programmes aligned with retail delivery and tenant fit\-out requirements
* Manage programmes proactively, identifying and mitigating risks to delivery
* Coordinate with design teams to ensure alignment with anchor tenant, F\&B and retail unit handover milestones
* Oversee integration of base build, shell \& core, and tenant fit\-out packages
* Ensure programme reflects authority approvals, procurement strategies and phased handovers
* Work with Planning \& Controls to maintain robust P6 programmes and client reporting


 Design \& Technical Coordination
   

  

* Lead multidisciplinary design coordination through all stages (Concept to IFC and construction support)
* Ensure alignment between brand standards, operational requirements and technical design solutions
* Oversee design reviews, ensuring buildability, compliance and coordination across disciplines
* Drive high\-quality outputs through structured QA/QC processes
* Ensure coordination between landlord criteria and tenant requirements


 Risk Management
   

  

* Establish and lead the project Risk Register, ensuring regular review and active management
* Identify key risks associated with retail phasing, tenant changes, authority approvals and programme constraints
* Develop and implement mitigation strategies
* Escalate critical risks to senior leadership and clients as required


 Commercial Management
   

  

* Lead all project commercial aspects, including budget management and financial reporting Manage project invoicing, cost tracking and financial performance
* Lead preparation, negotiation and agreement of variations
* Provide commercial advice to clients, particularly relating to programme impacts and tenant\-driven changes


 Delivery \& Handover
   

  

* Oversee project delivery through to completion, ensuring alignment with client and operational objectives
* Coordinate phased handovers, including base build and tenant fit\-out interfaces
* Ensure smooth transition to supervision / construction teams
* Lead project close\-out, ensuring all deliverables, approvals and documentation are complete


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture or related field
* 13\+ years professional experience, with a strong focus on retail, mixed\-use or commercial developments
* Proven track record delivering complex, multidisciplinary projects from Concept through to IFC and construction
* Demonstrable experience in retail delivery, including tenant coordination and fit\-out integration
* Experience working with major developers, operators or retail brands preferred
* Experience managing large, multidisciplinary teams and multiple stakeholders


 Core Competencies
   

  

* Strong leadership and ability to operate at a senior, client\-facing level
* Strategic thinking with ability to manage competing priorities
* Excellent stakeholder management, particularly within complex retail environments
* Commercial acumen and contractual awareness
* Strong programme and risk management capability
* Ability to drive quality, coordination and technical excellence
* Collaborative and proactive communication style
* Ability to lead and motivate multidisciplinary teams
* Strong understanding of health and safety in design


**Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.**
 Join our close\-knit community of talented individuals who share your passion for making a positive impact. Our global team includes more than 69,000 employees, working together to make a difference in communities both close to home and around the world.
   

  

**With us, you can. Apply today.**

data.raw_snippet:
**Duties And Responsibilities**
 Take responsibility and ownership for executing the project end\-to\-end and for delivery of project on time with good quality and profitability.
   

  

**Project Initiation**
* Outline project execution strategy and submit to management prior to project kick\-off
data.jd_text:
**Duties And Responsibilities**
 Take responsibility and ownership for executing the project end\-to\-end and for delivery of project on time with good quality and profitability.
   

  

**Project Initiation**
* Outline project execution strategy and submit to management prior to project kick\-off meeting
* Ensure preparation of detailed project schedule with appropriate milestones, based on contract.
* Ensure that drawings are obtained from design team. Review and approve drawings prior to submission to client and monitor and review all rework and resubmissions until final approval is obtained.
* Work with Finance and Management team to prepare ACE and get it approved.
* Define initial organization of project team, competencies required based on contract and project scope and work with HR to hire members for key positions immediately. Define detailed org chart subsequently and take steps to build an effective team with required skill set and mobilize the team.
* Evaluate available sub\-contractor options and get quote from suitable ones and submit to management. Participate in a meeting with other committee members ( BU Head, regional head, finance head etc) to finalize sub\-contractor.
* Ensure resource mobilization for the project at various stages, as required.
* Ensure that soil testing and initial site assessments are completed properly as per schedule.
* Ensure that procurement is on track and provide necessary support for the same.
* Review and finalize Project Quality Manual (PQM) and Health and safety Manual ( HSM)
* Establish relationship with all stakeholders including the client and CE and internal stakeholders including management team, supporting teams.


**Project Execution And Completion**
* Ensure resource deployment and mobilization as per project strategy and project requirements.
* Ensure material procurement and logistics are on track and site is ready to receive materials as per delivery schedule.
* Set up efficient systems and processes to ensure smooth interactions between various departments.
* Monitor and keep abreast of all site activities and ensure that all issues and concerns are addressed in a timely manner.
* Monitor progress periodically against schedule, quality standards and budget (ACE), as well as against contractual requirements, client requirements and company standards. Highlight critical points and propose corrective action plans.
* Ensure adherence of every function and process to PQM and HSM right through the project lifecycle. Monitor NCR and keep a check on LTI.
* Prepare risk assessment and mitigation plans.
* Organize weekly project review meetings with project team, site team and Engineering team (Head Quarter) to understand the design progress, actual project progress in terms of SPI, CPI, EVM etc. and provide appropriate action plans.
* Present project status updates to the management team during management review meetings
* Gather extensive knowledge on local people and communities in order to arrange social awareness programs for site teams.


**Team Management**
* Provide guidance and support to the various project teams to achieve their respective goals.
* Ensure that all teams are communicating with each other appropriately.
* Conduct weekly review meetings with site team.
* Ensure that site team and workmen are motivated and engaged and ensure that all their basic needs are met.
* Ensure that new joiners are inducted and on\-boarded effectively.


**Client/Consultant Management**
* Establish a good working relationship with the client and CE and ensure customer satisfaction.
* Represent the company’s interests while dealing with the client/CE.
* Ensure that progress reports are shared with client/CE as per agreed terms.
* Keep the client informed of any changes/developments/major deviations from contract required during execution and get required approvals.
* Ensure that all client approvals are obtained appropriately and without delay and all client/CE inspections are conducted as per contract. Address any variations contractually.
* Approve all communications to the client, from members of the project team.
* Attend review meetings, along with project \& execution team as required when arranged by client or CE.


**Sub\-contractor Management**
* Ensure mobilization of sub\-contractor’s resources as per project plan
* Ensure development and implementation of sub\-contractor’s work plan and reporting/review mechanism.
* Monitor quality and safety plan implementation by sub\-cotractors


**Reporting**
* Review periodic reports submitted by heads of departments and take necessary actions.
* Ensure the periodic submission of all review reports on EHS, Quality, Schedule and Cost related items to BU Head/ Head of operations(SS/TL) as per mutually agreed terms
* Ensure the periodic submission of all review reports on EHS, Quality and Schedule related items to Client/CE as per contract.


**Financial**
* Prepare and periodically review project related budgets.
* Monitor and control cost to ensure profitability of project is maintained.
* Ensure that sales targets are achieved and invoicing and collections are done on time.
* Develop strategy for Processing Claims and implement it with all relevant stakeholders including customers, suppliers, partners, insurances and other third parties.


**Statutory**
* Manage contracts effectively with internal and external stakeholders, CE and client.
* Ensure that work adheres to all statutory requirements and policies on safety, environment and community issues as per contract, company policies and law of land.
* Be the front end for bidding for all local legislative and administrative government authorities.


**Role Requirements**
**Education :** 
 BE Electrical
   

  

**Experience**
 Electrical Substation projects:
   

  

* Should have 15 to 20 years’ experience in Electrical/Civil/Mechanical aspects of SS Projects Experience in the project management of medium / large size EPC projects.

data.raw_snippet: The Center for Arab Studies and Islamic Civilizations (CASIC) at the American University of Sharjah (AUS) in the United Arab Emirates invites applications for the full\-time CASIC Faculty Director position. The successful candidate will have a specialization in a relevant field of Arabic studies, Is
data.jd_text:
The Center for Arab Studies and Islamic Civilizations (CASIC) at the American University of Sharjah (AUS) in the United Arab Emirates invites applications for the full\-time CASIC Faculty Director position. The successful candidate will have a specialization in a relevant field of Arabic studies, Islamic civilization, or a closely related discipline, broadly defined.
   

  

 The successful candidate will also serve as Co\-Chair of the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO) Chair in Arabic Language, AI, and Digital Heritage. The UNESCO Chair promotes interdisciplinary research, education, and international collaboration at the intersection of Arabic language studies, artificial intelligence, and digital heritage preservation. In this role, the candidate will provide academic leadership and build partnerships that advance the Chair’s research, education, and outreach and strengthen its regional and global impact.
   

  

 CASIC draws on AUS’s expertise across academic disciplines to promote innovative, multidisciplinary research on the cultural continuity and diversity of the Arab and Islamic worlds. CASIC aligns its research objectives with key priorities in Sharjah and the UAE, emphasizing the study of the Arabic language, heritage, history, and cultures of the Arab and Islamic worlds. Situated at the heart of the Arab and Islamic worlds and shaped by cultural influences from both East and West, CASIC offers a counterpoint to Western approaches to the study of the Arab world and Islamic civilization.
   

  

 CASIC conducts in\-depth research on the region’s history, cultures, arts, contemporary dynamics, and diasporas. Its work will focus on cultural heritage, arts, and architecture; language, literature, and media studies; humanities, performing arts, and visual communication; economy, society, and the digital age. The center seeks to reorient the study of the Arab world and Islamic civilization both regionally and globally. CASIC seeks a director with deep knowledge of the culture, history, and contemporary realities of the Arab and Islamic worlds. Proficiency in Islamicate languages is desirable. The director will shape the center’s long\-term strategy, set clear priorities, and foster a culture of innovation and collaboration. The center will build research programs that combine the scholarly traditions of Arab and Islamic civilizations with contemporary methods, applying them to the needs of modern UAE society, the Arab region, and the wider world.
   

  

 AUS offers several educational programs that align with and support CASIC's activities and goals. These programs provide strength in Arabic and Translation Studies; the History and Culture of the Arab World; Islamic Arts and Architecture; Philosophy; Middle Eastern Studies; the Politics and Economy of the Arab World; and Arab Media, Visual Communication, and Performing Arts. CASIC will serve as a central hub, uniting expertise from within AUS and engaging with local and international stakeholders to address cultural and societal issues. The center aims to foster partnerships highlighting Arab and Islamic contributions to global heritage. The center will collaborate closely with organizations such as the Sharjah Art Foundation, the Sharjah Museums Authority, the Sharjah Arabic Language Academy, and others.
   

  

 CASIC’s leadership will build the center into a globally recognized hub for the study of Arab and Islamic civilizations and strengthen AUS’s research profile. The center will prioritize disseminating knowledge, building strategic partnerships with local and international institutions and researchers, and fostering academic collaboration. Furthermore, CASIC will invest in talent development by supporting graduate student research, postdoctoral fellowships, and visiting scholars.
   

  

 Faculty Director candidates must hold a PhD in a relevant field at the time of appointment, demonstrate an excellent record of academic and research leadership, and, ideally, be prepared to relocate to the UAE by
 **December 2026\.**
 As an institution based on the American model of higher education and with English as the medium of instruction, AUS prioritizes candidates with significant experience in similar educational systems.
   

  

**How To Apply**
 Please fill the application Form
   

  

 The complete application will include the following documents, uploaded as separate files: a letter of application, a curriculum vitae, a list of three referees with contact information, a research statement, a teaching statement, a chapter\- or article\-length publication sample, and evidence of prior research leadership experience.
   

  

 Situated near Sharjah International Airport in the expansive University City area and only 30 minutes from Dubai International Airport, AUS is in a dynamic, cosmopolitan area with abundant opportunities for travel, entertainment, cultural experiences, and natural beauty. Salary and benefits are competitive.
   

  

 The American University of Sharjah is a not\-for\-profit, independent, coeducational institution of higher education formed on American models but thoroughly grounded in Arab culture. Located in University City, Sharjah, AUS offers undergraduate and graduate degree programs to more than 5,800 students from approximately 90 nations. English is the language of instruction and the workplace. AUS has been ranked among the top 10 Arab universities by the QS World University Rankings for the past 9 consecutive years.
   

  

 AUS is licensed, and its programs are accredited by the Commission for Academic Accreditation of the Ministry of Education’s Higher Education Affairs Division in the United Arab Emirates. AUS has been accredited in the United States of America by the Middle States Commission on Higher Education (1007 North Orange Street, 4th Floor, MB \#166, Wilmington, DE 19801 USA) since June 2004\.

data.jd_text:
**Role: Director of Engineering \- Platform \| eVTOL Aerospace** 




**Location: Dubai \- Tax\-Free** 




**Working Arrangement: Office based** 




**Salary: Salary details available on application** 




  





 Most senior engineering roles are about maintaining something someone else built.
 



  





 This one isn't.
 



  





 We've just come off a briefing with the leadership team of one of the most ambitious aerospace programmes in the world right now, and we need to talk to you. Because if your career has been building towards a moment where you get to stand something up from scratch \- a genuinely novel aircraft, a founding team of world\-class domain engineers, a programme with the kind of commercial backbone that most ventures can only dream about \- this might be it.
 



  





 What is it?
 



 A Director of Engineering \- Platform role on a confidential eVTOL programme based in Dubai South. The aircraft is a next\-generation electric platform designed to deliver life\-saving emergency response capability. Novel configuration. Genuinely unsolved engineering problems. And a mission that, unlike a significant chunk of what the aerospace industry produces, is unambiguously good for the world.
 



  





 The company is both OEM and operator \- they will certify the aircraft and operate a fleet at scale. That combination essentially doesn't exist anywhere else in the industry today. And they're doing it under a 20\-year sovereign customer agreement, which gives this programme the kind of forward visibility that venture\-backed eVTOL companies simply cannot offer.
 



  





 What does the role involve?
 



 You will own engineering operations for the Platform stream. That means building the team, running the technical maturity cadence, managing the gate review rhythm, allocating resources across the domain Chief Engineers, and keeping the programme moving from early architecture through to certification and production. You sit alongside the Chief Engineer \- Platform as an equal counterpart, and you report directly to the CTO.
 



  





 This is not a technical design role. It is a programme execution and people leadership role. The CE decides what gets built. You make sure it gets built.
 



  





 Who are we looking for?
 



 Someone who has led teams of serious engineers \- Chief Engineers or equivalent \- on certified civil aerospace programmes. Someone who has built an engineering organisation in the early stages of a complex programme, not just joined one that was already running. Someone who is comfortable with greenfield ambiguity and thrives in it rather than tolerating it.
 



  





 If you have spent your career in mature OEM programmes with hundreds of engineers and a decades\-old process framework, this will feel different. That's not a warning \- it's a filter. The people who've already joined this programme left very senior roles at very large companies to do it. They did it because the scale of the challenge and the quality of the mission was worth it.
 



  





 The package
 



 Tax\-free in Dubai. Relocation package included. Senior leadership level. Salary details available on application.
 



  





 A note on the location
 



 Dubai South is adjacent to Al Maktoum International Airport \- one of the most significant aviation infrastructure developments in the world. If you have always wanted to be somewhere that takes aerospace seriously, this is it.
 



  





 If this sounds like the kind of opportunity you've been waiting for, apply now or reach out directly. We screen every applicant personally \- no AI filters.
 



  





 We welcome diverse applicants and are dedicated to treating all applicants with dignity and respect, regardless of background.

You have previously articulated a clear academic vision and taken ownership of its results. You have led visibly and decisively, not from the margins. Your work in learning science is substantive—you have designed operational systems, produced measurable outcomes, and represented that work publicly with confidence. If this describes your career, 2 Hour Learning seeks its Director of Academic Excellence.
   

  

 2 Hour Learning operates on a model in which students achieve learning outcomes twice as quickly, dedicating just two hours daily. This is made possible through AI\-driven tutoring, mastery\-based learning pathways, and a departure from traditional classroom methods. Performance data validates the approach. We now require a leader capable of aligning execution across varied school implementations, elevating academic standards across teams, and serving as the authoritative voice for a model rooted in evidence\-based learning science.
   

  

 This position is not conceptual. It is operational and strategic. You will take full ownership of academic execution, establish performance benchmarks, diagnose implementation challenges, and develop leadership teams to deliver tangible results. You will translate the scientific principles underlying our work into consistent operational practice and advocate for the model in high\-stakes external forums.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Designing academic frameworks that operationalize learning science principles into actionable guidance for curriculum design, motivational architecture, and application functionality.
* Conducting structured academic execution reviews with Heads of Academics to ensure alignment, accountability, and measurable progress across all school teams.
* Integrating quantitative data, qualitative interviews, and direct observation into comprehensive academic ecosystem assessments that identify high\-impact barriers to learning acceleration and recommend targeted interventions.
* Ensuring strategic coherence through continuous planning, structured feedback mechanisms, and milestone oversight to sustain focus on student learning objectives.
* Serving as the senior representative of 2 Hour Learning in external forums—including keynote presentations and engagements with Ministries of Education—to influence global discourse on educational transformation.


**What You Won’t Be Doing**
* Engaging in narrow curriculum revisions that do not contribute to broader systemic improvement.
* Producing theoretical research disconnected from measurable student outcomes or operational implementation.
* Transferring accountability for team performance to mid\-level managers or external advisors.
* Depending on institutional reputation or conceptual arguments to convince critical audiences.


**Director Of Academic Excellence Key Responsibilities**
 Expand and refine 2 Hour Learning's validated academic model by aligning execution across all school sites, raising leadership performance standards, and establishing yourself as the authoritative public representative of a movement founded on rigorous learning science and demonstrated outcomes.
   

  

**Basic Requirements**
* Advanced degree (Masters or Ph.D) in Learning Science, Educational Psychology, Instructional Design, or a related field
* At least 7 years in academic or EdTech leadership roles, leading a team of staff/employees (not an informal peer leader role, such as grade\-level lead); you must have been responsible for hiring, monitoring performance, coaching, and making termination decisions
* Experience driving learning outcomes for students and upholding student performance standards
* Experience applying AI or emerging technologies to improve education, such as through personalized learning, adaptive learning, AI agents, etc.
* Experience managing academic teams of 50\+ people (e.g., the teams you managed directly executed curriculum, instruction, or assessment)
* Experience interacting directly with students, teachers, or school leaders in a professional setting


**About 2 Hour Learning**
 Education is broken, but 2 Hour Learning is proving it doesn’t have to be. They’re tearing down the outdated one\-size\-fits\-all model and replacing it with AI\-driven personalized learning that helps kids master academics in just two hours a day.
   

  

**With students consistently ranking in the top 1\-2% nationally and the top 20% achieving an astonishing 6\.5x growth, they’re proving that smarter learning is possible. At 2 Hour Learning, it’s talent and performance that matter.**
 They offer a dynamic, on\-campus and remote\-friendly environment where innovators, educators, and AI specialists can be a part of fixing a broken school system.
   

  

**2 Hour Learning is reprogramming learning for the AI era.**
**Here’s How They’re Fixing It.**
 There is so much to cover for this exciting role, and space here is limited. Hit the Apply button if you found this interesting and want to learn more. We look forward to meeting you!
   

  

**Working with us**
 This is a full\-time (40 hours per week), long\-term position. The position is immediately available and requires entering into an independent contractor agreement with Crossover as a Contractor of Record. The compensation level for this role is $200 USD/hour, which equates to $400,000 USD/year assuming 40 hours per week and 50 weeks per year. The payment period is weekly. Consult www.crossover.com/help\-and\-faqs for more details on this topic.

**Description**
 Job Description
   

  

 Amazon Now is building the future of ultra\-fast grocery delivery across the Middle East. We are looking for a Program Manager to drive measurable improvements across store capacity management, cost\-per\-order reduction, and delivery speed (Click\-to\-Door).
   

  

 This role sits within the Operations Excellence function and is responsible for identifying, scoping, and delivering high\-impact programmes that improve customer experience and unit economics across Amazon Now’s network in Saudi Arabia.
   

  

 You will work across Last Mile, Middle Mile, and Under\-The\-Roof (UTR) operations to find inefficiencies, build the business case, and drive cross\-functional execution. This is not a reactive role, you will proactively identify opportunities before they become problems, connect the dots across operational channels, and ensure every initiative ladders up to CX outcomes and P\&L impact.
   

  

 The right candidate is analytically sharp, comfortable with ambiguity, and operates with a bias for action. You think in systems, not silos. You’re as comfortable in the data as you are in a room with senior stakeholders making the case for change.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Store Capacity \& Cost Management
   

  

* Own programmes to optimise store capacity utilization, including bin density, ASIN rationalisation, gas tank management, and space allocation across darkstores.
* Drive cost\-per\-order reduction across the end\-to\-end operation: UTR pick efficiency, DA (Delivery Associate) productivity, hub\-to\-store transhipment costs, and middle mile truck utilisation.
* Analyse operational cost structures to identify the highest\-leverage opportunities for unit economics improvement. Build business cases with clear ROI and execution plans.
* Partner with UTR, Last Mile, and Middle Mile teams to implement changes that reduce waste, improve throughput, and lower cost\-to\-serve without degrading customer experience.
* Develop and maintain dashboards and reporting mechanisms to track capacity utilisation and cost metrics across KSA stores.


 Delivery Speed \& Click\-to\-Door (C2D)
   

  

* Own the programme roadmap for C2D reduction, identifying bottlenecks across order acceptance, pick \& pack, dispatch, and last mile delivery.
* Analyse delivery defects, early delivery marking, Did\-Not\-Receive (DNR) patterns, and other CX pain points to drive root cause resolution.
* Identify and eliminate handoff delays between UTR, Middle Mile, and Last Mile that contribute to C2D inflation.


 Project \& Programme Delivery
   

  

* Scope, plan, and execute operational improvement projects end\-to\-end, from opportunity identification through to measurable business impact.
* Build and manage a portfolio of initiatives across capacity, cost, and speed, with clear prioritisation based on CX and P\&L impact.
* Create mechanisms for project tracking, stakeholder communication, and escalation. Maintain a clear view of project status, risks, and dependencies.
* Drive cross\-functional alignment with ACES, Tech, Finance, Category, and operations teams to remove blockers and deliver on commitments.
* Contribute to the development of scalable solutions that can be replicated across KSA stores, solve once, scale everywhere.


 Cross\-Functional Influence \& Visibility
   

  

* Operate as the connective tissue between operational channels, ensuring improvements in one area don’t create problems in another.
* Build visibility into operational performance through data, dashboards, and regular reporting cadences (WBR/MBR contributions).
* Influence without authority, drive outcomes through data\-backed recommendations, clear communication, and stakeholder management.
* Support Automation \& AI initiatives that drive efficiency, reduce manual effort, and improve decision\-making across operations.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 5\+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Master's degree
* Experience in program requirements definition, together with data and metrics leveraging to drive improvements


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 5\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience in project management methodologies, business analysis, or process improvement
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
