data.title: Medical Affairs Director, BBU, Gulf
data.raw_snippet:
**About Astrazeneca**
 At AstraZeneca we fuse the worlds of Medical and Commercial to spot opportunities and pioneer approaches that better serve our patients. Bridging Commercial and Scientific goals, we apply our people and leadership skills to launch cutting\-edge products into our growing health
data.jd_text:
**About Astrazeneca**
 At AstraZeneca we fuse the worlds of Medical and Commercial to spot opportunities and pioneer approaches that better serve our patients. Bridging Commercial and Scientific goals, we apply our people and leadership skills to launch cutting\-edge products into our growing healthcare ecosystem. It takes a holistic mindset to treat each unique patient and tailor the whole experience – from early diagnosis to treatment. We step up and take accountability to deliver new ways of doing things that will create a better future for our markets.
   

  

**Job Description**
 The role is responsible for leading a high\-performing Biopharmaceuticals Business Unit (BBU) Medical Affairs team across the CVRM and R\&I Therapy Areas in the AstraZeneca Gulf cluster. Prioritizes across both therapy areas according to BBU strategy and organizational impact, with a deep understanding of the Gulf healthcare systems, their priorities and challenges across the disease areas.
   

  

 Ensures excellence in the development and execution of integrated CVRM and R\&I Medical Affairs Plans – composed of confidence and evidence\-generation activities, as well as fundamental and sustainable clinical\-practice transformations that strengthen healthcare ecosystems, improve treatment outcomes, and enable equitable access to quality patient care in alignment with the BBU portfolio.
   

  

 Recognizes and leverages innovation wherever appropriate to drive strategic and sustainable impact internally and externally. Leads the team to identify, activate and measure scalable healthcare practice shaping initiatives across both therapy areas, with integrated partnership engagement plans composed of key traditional (e.g. HCPs and scientific leaders in cardiology, nephrology, endocrinology/diabetes, respiratory and immunology/rheumatology) and non\-traditional (e.g. policy and decision makers, PAGs, government, payers, innovative solution providers) stakeholders.
   

  

 Drives operational effectiveness, impact and efficiencies of the CVRM and R\&I Medical Affairs teams through measurable outcomes and a continuous improvement approach, balancing resources appropriately across the two therapy areas. Communicates on the quality, delivery and value of the BBU Medical Affairs teams with a good understanding of the internal business ecosystem.
   

  

 Leads the BBU Medical Affairs teams as a member of the Senior Leadership Team, partnering closely with the CVRM and R\&I commercial BUDs. Acts as part of the leadership team for the Gulf organization and participates in organizational decisions with an entrepreneurial mindset.
   

  

**Typical Accountabilities**
**Medical Strategy**
* Accountable for setting the integrated CVRM and R\&I Medical Affairs strategy for the Gulf cluster, ensuring appropriate resources and delivering the strategic Medical Affairs plans across both therapy areas with maximum impact and effectiveness.
* Accountable for the strategic direction, business planning and team leadership of the BBU (CVRM \& R\&I) Medical Affairs function within the Gulf cluster, aligning local plans with the global/area CVRM and R\&I medical strategies and the Gulf launch sequence.
* Translates the differing scientific, evidence\-generation and stakeholder needs of CVRM and R\&I into a single prioritized plan, balancing investment, capabilities and focus across the two therapy areas.
* Leads the BBU Medical Affairs organization as part of the cluster’s senior leadership team and represents the local company externally on the topic of science and healthcare across the cardiovascular, renal, metabolic, respiratory and immunology disease areas.
* Manages and leads change initiatives, challenges current thinking and assumptions within the organization, and collaborates with cross\-functional teams and across organizations at various levels.


**Team Leader**
* Manages and coaches the CVRM and R\&I medical teams – e.g. Medical Advisors, Medical Managers and MSLs – for performance with purpose, holding the team accountable for timely and effective delivery in the prioritized areas that drive the greatest impact across both therapy areas.
* Establishes required standards of medical core – and new capabilities, ensures medical operational excellence, business and resource planning and people processes (recruitment, talent management, motivation, retention).
* Drives performance with impact\-focused goals and measurable outcomes, continuously validating and improving strategies through data\-driven insights.
* Builds and sustains deep therapy\-area and scientific expertise across CVRM and R\&I, and drives a collaborative, patient\-centric culture with an innovative mindset that focuses on impact.


**External Engagements**
* Knowledgeable of the global and Gulf healthcare ecosystem – its priorities, challenges, opportunities and issues.
* Ensures scalable and sustainable strategic solutions to Transforming Care are incorporated and prioritized into the CVRM and R\&I Medical Affairs plans to strengthen healthcare ecosystems and improve treatment outcomes.
* Drives Scientific Leadership across cardiovascular, renal, metabolic, respiratory and immunology care.
* Establishes collaborative engagements with Key Opinion Leaders of the HC ecosystem (e.g. cardiologists, nephrologists, endocrinologists/diabetologists, pulmonologists, immunologists/rheumatologists, payers, policy makers, regulatory bodies and PAGs) to drive consensus and successfully advocate for policy changes that improve access to quality patient care.


**Medical Evidence Generation Oversight**
* Ensure building of high\-quality Gulf Medical Evidence Plans to generate Clinical, Payer, Policy evidence in line with brand strategy
* Ensure meeting local and above market RWE study program KPIs (startup timelines, recruitment, etc)
* Ensure high quality medical insights provided to area/regional Evidence Generation strategies
* Ensuring GCP Quality and compliance with local GCP Quality Management System (QMS) SOP and all applicable AZ policies and Standards


**Medical Excellence and Governance Oversight**
* Ensure Nominated Signatory, Medical Information, Ethical Interactions policies are implemented and tracked
* Ensure setting up and conduct regular review of Field Medical Quarterly Dashboard (KPIs) and assessment of MSL Capabilities
* Ensure Medical function are compliant with AZ Code of Ethics, Corporate Governance, Audit requirements, guidelines, policies, procedures, development/ updating of SOPs in timely manner. Ensures and monitors compliance by team members and third parties by (a) positively reinforcing the Code of Ethics and all relevant AstraZeneca Policies and Standards, (b) ensuring completion of all required training, (c) fostering a culture of openness in which employees are comfortable raising questions or concerns, and (d) immediately addressing and reporting, as appropriate, instances of non\-compliance.
* As a leader with accountability for GxP areas, understands the legal and regulatory requirements of the role in providing appropriate resources (human, financial, material, facilities and equipment) to maintain the Quality system and continually improve its effectiveness.
* Collaborates with Compliance to ensure full adherence to company standards on ethical interactions.


**Essentials For The Role**
* Science degree and/or Master’s degree in a scientific discipline.
* Extensive experience of the Medical Affairs function within the pharmaceutical industry.
* Therapy\-area knowledge across CVRM and/or R\&I (cardiovascular, renal, metabolic, respiratory or immunology).
* Experience leading or supporting Medical Affairs across more than one therapy area.
* Extensive experience in relationship and stakeholder management.
* Extensive team management / people\-leadership experience.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills.


**Desirables for the role**
* Doctoral degree in a scientific discipline (e.g. M.D., Ph.D., Pharm.D.).
* In\-depth scientific expertise in one or more CVRM or R\&I disease areas (e.g. heart failure, chronic kidney disease, type 2 diabetes, severe asthma, COPD, immunology/rheumatology).
* Experience supporting product launches within CVRM or R\&I.
* Experience of the Gulf / GCC healthcare environment and stakeholders.
* Extensive knowledge of the latest technical and regulatory developments.
* Innovative and solution\-oriented mindset; ecosystem\-scaled project experience.
* Experience with research, drug discovery, drug development and drug lifecycle management.


**Date Posted**
 01\-يوليو\-2026
   

  

**Closing Date**
 19\-يوليو\-2026
   

  

 AstraZeneca embraces diversity and equality of opportunity. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team representing all backgrounds, with as wide a range of perspectives as possible, and harnessing industry\-leading skills. We believe that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We welcome and consider applications to join our team from all qualified candidates, regardless of their characteristics. We comply with all applicable laws and regulations on non\-discrimination in employment (and recruitment), as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements.

data.jd_text:

 The Project Director is responsible for driving the successful delivery of projects while actively contributing to the creation and execution of the business plan for future projects.

 Working closely with the Director of Event Production BU and the wider leadership team, the Project Director will translate the business plans into actionable initiatives, ensure targets are met, maintain and expand client relationships, and strengthen our competitive position in the market.
   

  

 The role also requires close collaboration with other Project Directors across the organisation to ensure alignment, knowledge sharing, and collective progress toward shared goals.
   

  

 This position reflects our new structure of appointing Project Directors with defined focus areas (e.g., KSA, UAE, Special Projects Global), ensuring scalability and dedicated leadership as our business continues to expand.
   

  

**Leadership \& Strategic Oversight**

data.jd_text:
Join the UAE’s largest bank and one of the world’s largest and safest financial institutions. Our focus is to create value for our employees, customers, shareholders and communities to grow through differentiation, agility and innovation. We are looking for top talent, and your success is our success. Accelerate your growth as you help us reach our goals and advance your career. Be ready to make your mark a top company, in an exciting \& dynamic industry.
 



  





**Job Purpose** 




 To manage and grow relationships with large and strategic clients within the assigned portfolio in the Retail \& Consumer Goods segment of Wholesale Banking. Drive new business origination while ensuring full compliance with Credit and Risk frameworks. Improve service quality levels and supervise the day‑to‑day activities and client interactions of subordinates to ensure the team consistently meets its objectives and achieves revenue targets, while maintaining strong client satisfaction and portfolio credit quality. Promote effective cross‑functional collaboration to deliver integrated financial solutions. Achieving financial targets and strategic objectives will be essential in driving sustainable growth and maintaining profitability.
 



  





**Key Accountabilities** 




**Business Origination** 



* Originate new business opportunities with target clients across banking products and in line with relevant policies.
* Obtain support from relevant stakeholders and governance forums to execute deals (e.g., credit, products, GT).
* Draft Term Sheets, Information Memorandums, Mandate letters etc.
* Examine \& resolve credit, market and operational risk aspects of transactions in collaboration with products and enablement units.
* Leverage FAB’s network expansion through cross border deals.
* Expand Products Penetration Through Sector\-Focused Solutions.
* Ensure high returns with satisfactory yields and sufficient ancillary business.
* Maintain the credit quality of the client's relationships within the Portfolio to an acceptable level set by the Bank's management.
* Pitch, review, negotiate and conclude deals.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with key decision makers in other banks to originate business.
* Up to date with the latest market, competitors, regulatory and industry and amend accordingly the account plans as when applicable.
* Ability to handle sophisticated transactions and engage assigned team members.
* Recommend policy amendments as when required to match with the latest business trends.



  





**Client Relationship Management** 



* To achieve assigned financial and non\-financial objectives by meeting all borrowing \& non borrowing needs of customers with target segments (E.g., borrowers, transactors, depositors).
* Prepare and Maintain Group Account Plans for all clients with support from relevant partners (e.g., products, international banking, Employee banking, Asset Management, etc.).
* Act as the main point of contact for clients, ensuring quality service and effective resolution of issues.
* Prepare briefing note memos ahead of senior management meetings with clients.
* Engage with internal stakeholders to obtain approvals for client RFPs in a timely manner.
* Increase wallet share with existing clients through strategic engagement and product penetration.
* Support on the conduct of annual/periodic credit facility reviews in the existing portfolio in a timely manner and support on the recommendation of appropriate credit facilities in line with the banks credit. policy to maximize earnings while containing risks to an acceptable level and identifying candidates for downgrades/ upgrades.
* Develop, Implement and maintain complete control aspects i.e., documentation, periodical client visits / call reports, stock inspections and formal credit checks / informal market feedback to monitor the assigned portfolio effectively.
* Organize client meetings with relevant partners/ seniority to deepen FAB relationship within the portfolio.
* Identify \& develop cross selling opportunities and increase cross\-sell ratio and returns with clients.
* Support client on their day\-to\-day banking requirements with support from the team (as applicable).
* Ensure customer satisfaction remains high and meets the targeted NPS score.
* Be knowledgeable on market trends and manage a disciplined marketing process by identifying steps/strategies necessary to effectively initiate relationships with prospects.
* Onboard new clients as and when required.



  





**Collaboration** 



* Align with Retail \& Consumer Goods team as well as other partners to identify and convert opportunities.
* Collaborate with other business divisions to drive cross\-BU collaboration. Develop proposition strategy, competition analysis, focused group approach, service delivery model, customer experience, internal \& external campaigns and alignment with other Products \& proposition including Risk policies, Payment \& Cash management, Trade products, collaboration with Retail banking including Private Banking, etc.
* Align with International banking to support client in FAB network locations.
* Support Unit/Divisional/Bank\-wide initiatives (as required or assigned).



  





**Operational** 



* Follow all relevant policies, processes, standard operating procedures, and instructions so that work is carried out in a controlled and consistent manner.
* Present transactions/proposals to the Credit Allocation Committee (CAC) for approvals.
* Run deal RAROCs and draft CAC submissions, ensuring delivery on CAC promises to achieve target RAROC thresholds.
* Prepare Green Light Memos for deal screening and Client Credit Applications (CAs).
* Review CAs and draft relationship comments before submission to Credit Committees.
* Ensure all credit reviews are submitted on time and agreed conditions are met.
* Address Credit inquiries, liaise with CAD and Legal for documentation matters.
* Conduct periodic reviews of risks (credit, operational, compliance etc.) within the portfolio on a regular basis.
* Drive day\-to\-day administrative and transactional activities for the team such as client calls, documentation follow up, pipeline updates, and any other activities in the unit/team to ensure continuity of work and delivery of effective/high quality output.
* Ensure that internal processes for existing portfolio/ NTBs are in\-line with the Bank's policies \& procedures.
* Manage and follow up on KYC and compliance requirements to ensure consistency with the Bank's KYC and AML policies and regulatory requirements.
* Ensure all clients' files \[documents] are maintained.
* Maintain a satisfactory audit on the portfolio.
* Adhere to process KPl's and, ORM, BCP \& Internal Audit requirements.
* Prepare timely and accurate statements and reports to meet the unit's requirements, policies, and standards.



  





**Client and Market Analysis** 



* Conduct financial analysis on clients and their respective geographies/ industries/ markets to identify potential opportunities and risks.



  





**Leadership** 



* Act as Role Model for the entire Retail \& Consumer Goods group and Retails \& Wholesale team
* Lead, Mentor, Motivate, Develop and Coach team members to ensure career growth and short\- \& long\-term successors
* Establish high\-performance culture and ensure high engagement levels.
* Encourage ownership through rightful assignments to team members.
* Achieve individual and team's financial performance targets.
* Learning \& Development Attend appropriate on and off\-the\-job training programs and ensure development and skill upgradation of team members.
* Involvement in team members new hirings.


- 


**Qualifications \& Experience** 



* Bachelor’s degree in finance or related discipline.
* CFA, or master’s degree in business administration is preferred.
* 12\+ years of experience in Banking with at least 8\+ years in senior role of team management.



  





**Knowledge, Skills, And Attributes** 



* Deep Knowledge of Wholesale Banking or Investment Banking with exposure to Retail \& Consumer Goods.
* Strong understanding of credit analysis, trade finance, and treasury products.
* Excellent relationship management, negotiation, and leadership skills.
* Ability to manage complex client structures and deliver on strategic objectives.
* Understanding of FAB's product offering and business strategy.
* Ability to collaborate with a wide range of stakeholders to drive business.
* Strong relationship management skills both internally and externally.
* Sound communication skills (written and verbal).
* Ability to analyze and research information.
* Deep Financial and credit analysis ability with an aptitude to identify opportunities and close business deals.
* Data analysis and financial modelling skills
* Ability to work under pressure and adjust quickly to changing priorities
* Proficient in MS Office (excel, word and Power\-point).

data.jd_text:
Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together.
   

  

 The Company operates Snapchat, a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world, and Specs Inc., a wholly\-owned subsidiary dedicated to making computing more human, in addition to Bitmoji, Saturn, and other digital services.
   

  

 We’re looking for a Head of Public Policy, MEA to join Snap Inc. As a member of the EMEA Public Policy team, the role reports to the Senior Director Public Policy EMEA. You will be responsible for the public policy and government relations work across the MEA region, with a particular focus on UAE and Saudi Arabia, as well as Qatar and potentially further afield in Africa. Working from our office in Dubai, you will co\-design, and execute the implementation of the public policy plan for relevant markets. The Middle East and Africa are key growth regions for Snap and our relationships with the governments and other key public stakeholders are of the utmost importance. Ensuring that Snap’s distinctive voice is heard and accommodated in policy\-making circles will be a key priority.
   

  

 The Head of Public Policy is co\-responsible for development of positions on key local and regional policy issues impacting Snap and for developing effective strategies to achieve policy outcomes and mitigate risk. This person will work closely with the rest of the Global Public Policy team, wider Legal team, regional Sales teams, the Communications team, Platform Integrity and Product teams and, on occasion, senior business executives to ensure the public policy program supports business growth and protects the company’s interests.
   

  

 What you’ll do:
   

  

* Serve as the main day\-to\-day policy representative of Snap Inc in the Middle East and Africa. Further deepen relationships with relevant government officials, NGOs, trade associations, non\-governmental organizations, and other influential stakeholders.
* Work closely with the Senior Director EMEA of Public Policy, the EMEA Public Policy team, the SVP Global Policy \& Platform Operations and, on occasion, the senior executive organization.
* Being the Policy spokesperson of the company in the region in various fora, events etc.
* Be the first to act and respond to the appropriate public policy inquiries.
* Collaborate with Public Policy, Legal and Business teams to analyze legislative initiatives, advise on risks and opportunities and develop company policy positions and messaging
* Partner with the Communications team to help them appropriately respond to Policy\-related media inquiries, by providing the correct policy narrative that best represents Snap Inc.


 Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities:
   

  

* A proven ability for shaping, and working with, government officials, NGOs, coalitions and other stakeholder groups.
* Good tech policy understanding and existing relationships within government and the wider stakeholder community in the region.
* Excellent communication and advocacy skills and sound political judgment.
* Forward thinking and proactive ability on legislative, regulatory and public policy issues. Ability to rapidly understand and master complex policy issues.
* Ability to work with Snap business to identify pertinent issues and orient the public policy team to meet priorities.
* Ability to work independently/ self\-starter in a fast\-paced, multicultural environment
* Demonstrated ability to work with a wide range of external groups and individuals, including those who are opponents or critics.
* Teammate with a positive attitude, motivation and a sense of humor
* Articulate and thoughtful.
* Able to adapt communication on complex issues for different audiences.
* A passion for Snapchat and creativity.


 Minimum Qualifications:
   

  

* Master's degree or advanced studies in law/economics/public affairs

 Preferred Qualifications:
   

  

* Working experience in Dubai or Riyadh
* Previous experience working with the Government or regulators or other Public institutions is a plus
* Full Arabic and English proficiency necessary


 If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please don’t be shy and provide us some information.

To reflect this, we practice a “default together” approach and expect our team members to work in an office 4\+ days per week.
   

  

 At Snap, we believe that having a team of diverse backgrounds and voices working together will enable us to create innovative products that improve the way people live and communicate. EOE, including disability/vets.

Our benefits are built around your needs and include paid parental leave, comprehensive medical coverage, emotional and mental health support programs, and compensation packages that let you share in Snap’s long\-term success!

**Role Overview \- Senior Security Program Manager** 




  





 Noon’s Group Cybersecurity is hiring a Senior Security Program Manager to run the execution engine of security org across the noon group of companies. We need a senior program manager who can turn a complex security roadmap into predictable delivery.
 



  





 The role spans keeping the security portfolio moving with clean artifacts and executive\-grade reporting. It is designed to be more hands\-on and cross\-cutting than a traditional PMO function, while also being broader in scope than a TPM role focused on delivering within a single engineering team or system.
 



  





 You will PM the security roadmap across Platform Security, Application and Product Security, GRC, and engineering partners. You will own the planning system, the delivery rhythm, the reporting model, and the closure standards for security initiatives.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* Own the cybersecurity portfolio execution model including planning, governance rhythm, risk, reporting, and closure standards

* Translate CISO projects and priorities, regulatory commitments, and audit requirements into executable program plans with owners, milestones, dependencies, and measurable outcomes
* Run weekly execution reviews with security leadership, enforce action closure, and manage decision deadlines
* Build and maintain the Group Security Scorecard across entities and functions, defining the metric set, targets, owners, and data sources and including it in the monthly reviews.
* Maintain the cybersecurity portfolio system of record covering initiative status, milestones, risks, dependencies, and decisions
* Produce executive\-ready reporting packs with consistent format across progress, risks, decisions required, and next milestones
* Write one\-pager program briefs for major initiatives covering scope, success metrics, owners, milestones, acceptance criteria, and timelines
* Track hiring and onboarding critical path for roadmap delivery milestones, without owning recruiting execution
* Improve execution visibility through automation, tooling, and dashboards that keep portfolio health current with minimal overhead on teams



  





**Who we need?** 




  




* Senior PM experience running cross\-functional portfolios across multiple teams with tight delivery expectations
* Strong ability to drive accountability through clarity, structured pressure, and escalation, without relying on formal authority
* Strong ability to build a delivery system including cadence, artifacts, templates, dashboards, and consistent reporting
* Executive\-grade writing and communication with concise updates, clear risk framing, and clean decision asks
* Strong judgment on prioritization, sequencing, and tradeoffs under competing demands and constrained capacity
* Ability to convert ambiguity into scope, milestones, owners, and measurable outputs
* Strong program management fundamentals with a bias toward execution, not ceremony
* Security fluency across variety of security domains, enough to pressure\-test plans and timelines without being the technical decision maker.
* High ownership and maturity handling sensitive information while representing the security leaders and CISO.



  





**Preferred experience** 




  




* Experience in a CISO office, security leadership office, or security program portfolio in a large tech company
* Experience delivering security transformation programs across multiple geographies and business units.
* Experience PM’ing security roadmaps that include detection and response maturity, platform security modernization, secure engineering programs, and governance remediation.
* Experience building governance rhythms and reporting packs used by executives, audit committees, or senior leadership stakeholders
* Experience in high\-scale consumer internet, e\-commerce, fintech, payments, logistics, or marketplace environments
* Strong program management tooling depth (or equivalent) and dashboarding habits that leadership can actually consume.

data.jd_text:
**Director Advisory Group Water \& Maritime Middle East** 




 Would you like to contribute to Haskoning’s ambitious Strategy in the Middle East? The region is one of our strategic focus areas, currently with Water and Maritime at its core. Haskoning aims to build on this core to accelerate growth and expand other parts of the businesses through a cross\-business line Advisory Group.
 



  





**What you do as a Director Advisory Group** 




 As the Director of the Advisory Group (DAG) Water \& Maritime Middle East, you will lead, develop, and empower a dynamic international team of 30 plus highly skilled professionals based primarily in the United Arab Emirates, Oman and Saudia Arabia. You will be supported by the management team of Water \& Maritime Americas Middle East \& India and the Associate Directors in the Advisory Group based in Oman and the United Arab Emirates. In this pivotal role, you will not just manage a team — you will spearhead growth, drive innovation, and shape the future of the Haskoning business in the Middle East in a way that enhances sustainability and resilience for clients across the globe.
 



  





 Furthermore, you will also lead the development and growth of a cross\-business line Advisory Group. The group currently comprises around 10 staff and is expected to grow to approximately 50 over the next four years. You will be responsible for executing the group’s growth strategy, developing a strong and diverse team, and creating effective collaboration across different parts of Haskoning’s global business. This will include identifying new client opportunities, shaping multidisciplinary advisory services, strengthening relationships with key internal and external stakeholders, and ensuring the group achieves sustainable commercial performance. You will play a central role in establishing the cross\-business Advisory Group as a recognised platform for integrated advisory services in the Middle East, with a focus on growth, innovation, client impact, and long\-term value for Haskoning.
 



  





 In addition to the Director of Advisory Group it is expected that you will in due course assume responsibilities of Resident Director for the UAE. In this capacity, you will act as Haskoning’s senior representative in the United Arab Emirates, providing country\-level leadership across all Business Lines and Global Leading Markets. Resident Director is responsible for the effective management of the UAE entity, ensuring that local operations are aligned with company strategy, governance requirements, and regional and global priorities. This includes oversight of statutory and regulatory compliance, company registrations, finance and taxation, payroll, human resources, visas and work permits, facilities management, health and safety, risk management, and the overall performance and culture of the local office. Resident Director will also represent Haskoning with clients, partners, authorities, and other key stakeholders, helping to strengthen our market position, safeguard business continuity, and enable sustainable growth in the UAE.
 



  





 This opportunity has arisen as the current incumbent moves into a new role within Haskoning. We are seeking a successor who is committed to the Haskoning group and the region for the long term.
 



 Key Performance Indicators:
 


* **P\&L Responsibility, Commercial success and continuous improvement** 
 : Drive the commercial and financial success of the Advisory Group by fostering co\-creation with global clients and partners. Generate focused growth in our key markets by connecting teams within the Advisory Group and with other expertise centres across the globe.



  




* **Stakeholder management:** 
 Build strong communication channels within and outside Haskoning to encourage seamless cooperation and create a distinct, unified identity. You will serve as the glue that holds teams together, fostering relationships that accelerate both business and environmental impact.



  




* **People management** 
 : Cultivate an environment and culture where both individuals and the business can thrive. Develop the Advisory Group strategy as part of Haskoning’s overarching corporate and Business Line / Business Unit strategies and enable the Associate Directors to implement it successfully under your guidance and leadership.



  




* **Project Delivery** 
 (of proof of concepts, projects and support contracts), including:



 \-Meeting client's expectations, achieving required scope and quality
 



 \-Driving Financial performance
 



 \-Promoting solid and accountable project management practices.
 



  





 You will report directly to the Business Unit Director of Water \& Maritime Americas Middle East \& India and be a key member of the Business Unit Management Team, collaborating on the broader vision and strategy of our business.
 



  





**Where will you work** 




 Haskoning is a globally established and operating independent consultancy, engineering and project management firm which integrates over 140 years of domain expertise with digital technologies and software solutions. Our 6,500 colleagues work from offices in more than 25 countries across the world. Through our mission Enhancing Society Together, we take responsibility for having a positive impact on the planet.
 



 You will be based in our Dubai office with frequent travel across the region.
 



  





**What you bring** 




 We are looking for a visionary leader with a strategic mindset. You thrive in dynamic environments, have a natural ability to lead and inspire diverse teams, and are ready to drive the next chapter of growth for the Middle East.
 



  




* Higher Education in engineering, management or environmental disciplines;
* Extensive Experience in Engineering Consultancy in the Maritime or related industry, also with the knowledge of the Energy \& Industry sectors being advantageous;
* Minimum of 5 years Line management (including P\&L) responsibility, with proven experience to lead teams of at least 30 people;
* A network of clients in the Middle East region is a significant advantage;
* General management and entity management experience is an advantage;
* Fluent in English with the ability to engage stakeholders across cultures and geographies. Arabic would be an advantage but is not essential;
* An international outlook, with experience working in diverse, multicultural environments, ensuring effective communication across borders



  





**What we offer** 




 Within our company you will be able to develop yourself while working on challenging projects across the globe. Besides that, we also offer:
 


* A good work\-life balance, with the flexibility to work from home up to 2 days per week;
* 25 annual leave days per year, based on a 40\-hour work week;
* A competitive salary package;
* Lifelong learning by offering you plenty of training \& development opportunities.
* Profit share based on company profit.
* Medical insurance



  





**Are you our new colleague?** 




 We would like to meet you! Click on the apply button and upload your resume and motivation letter. After receiving your application, we will contact you as soon as possible. Are we all enthusiastic after this? Then you will receive an offer from us, and we will be happy to welcome you on board!
 



 In case of questions, please contact Anouk de Winter, recruiter, anouk.de.winter@haskoning.com.
 



 Please note the deadline for receiving applications is Wednesday the 15th of July 2026\.
 



  





 Due to the privacy law, please submit your application via the apply button and not via email.
 



***Acquisition of this vacancy by agencies is not appreciated and the candidates offered will not be taken into consideration.***

The role delivers manufacturing excellence aligned with business strategy, approved budgets, and customer requirements, while ensuring compliance with UAE regulatory authorities and international standards.

* Reports to: Manufacturing Operations Director
* Direct Reports: Business Unit Managers, Maintenance Manager, Supply Chain Manager, Purchase Manager, Production Engineering Manager, Contracts Manager and Finance Manager
* Functional reports: IT Lead, Regional HR Manager, HSE Manager, Quality Manager

 Strategy \& Operations

 Quality \& HSE

data.jd_text:
**About Moove**
 Moove is one of the world's fastest\-growing mobility infrastructure companies.
   

  

 We finance and supply vehicles to mobility platforms across Africa, the Middle East, Asia, and Latin America and we're building the infrastructure layer that the next generation of mobility will depend on. The company is pre\-IPO, operating at scale across multiple geographies, and moving through one of the most consequential phases of its growth.
   

  

 The pace is fast and the stakes are high. The decisions being made now will define the company for a decade. We are building the next phase of this business to be AI\-native from the ground up and the people around the leadership table need to be operating at their best.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Director of Strategy \& Operations serves as a trusted partner to the Co\-CEO and President, ensuring that ambitious growth plans are executable, aligned, and supported across the organisation. The role will be crucial in operationalizing the vision of Moove.
   

  

 On the execution side, this role owns the operating rhythm of the leadership team, converts strategic direction into clear accountabilities, and ensures decisions are structured, actioned, and embedded across business units. On the strategic side, the Director of Strategy \& Operations researches and constructs long\-term corporate strategy, embeds governance and decision rights, and provides forward\-looking scenario analysis to feed into any corporate planning.
   

  

 Because much of the company’s operating infrastructure is still being built, this role carries significant build responsibility. The Director of Strategy \& Operations will design the ways of working, stand up performance frameworks, and embed the OKR and scorecard systems through which the business runs. This is an execution role with strategic range, the ratio matters, and the ceiling is high.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
 Strategy and Governance
   

  

* Research, construct, and support the development of long\-term corporate strategy in partnership with the Co\-CEO and President; ensure it is cascaded into business unit priorities through structured communication channels including town halls, leadership briefings, and BU\-level planning.
* Operationalise the operating model, ensuring business units are aligned, accountable, and able to deliver against growth priorities
* Guide the decentralisation effort, embedding governance structures and clear decision rights across business units
* Partner with senior functional leaders to identify and close capability gaps that impact business performance
* Provide forward\-looking scenario analysis to feed into future strategy


 Operating Rhythm and Execution
   

  

* Own the executive operating rhythm, leadership meetings, offsites, board and committee reviews, ensuring decisions are structured, actioned, and embedded
* Translate strategic direction into clear actions, owners, and timelines across the organisation; hold stakeholders accountable to commitments
* Identify and remove blockers; drive stalled decisions to resolution with pace and rigour
* Facilitate integration across functions and business units, aligning resources and priorities to avoid silos
* Identify and escalate risks that may impact business performance or growth, ensuring mitigation plans are in place


 Performance and Organizational Effectiveness
   

  

* Embed OKRs and business performance scorecards in collaboration with the People Team; provide data\-driven insights to the Co\-CEO and executive team to inform decisions
* Ensure business performance outcomes are supported by aligned people performance priorities
* Manage information flow to and from the Co\-CEO, surface what requires attention and filter what does not


**Strategic Outputs**
* Prepare and own high\-stakes outputs: board materials, investor updates, strategic documents, and executive briefings
* Lead specific strategic and operational workstreams directly when required, including platform development and capital markets preparation
* Identify and deploy AI tools and workflows to increase the velocity and quality of the Co\-CEO’s office


**Experience**
**What You will need for this position**
* 6–10 years of experience owning outcomes in high\-growth or high\-complexity environments
* Prior experience as a Chief of Staff, Director of Strategy \& Operations, COO, or senior operator at a high\-velocity technology company, or equivalent seniority from top\-tier strategy consulting with demonstrated operational delivery
* Experience building or running a critical function through a period of rapid growth, transformation, or M\&A activity
* Demonstrable track record of closing things, decisions, commitments, workstreams, at pace and without loss of quality


**Skills And Capabilities**
* Exceptional written communication; produces board\-quality documents, strategic memos, and executive briefings independently
* Ability to process complexity quickly, communicate it clearly, and operate with minimal direction
* Genuinely AI\-native; uses AI to increase personal and team velocity, with experience managing AI\-enabled workflows or operating system design
* Sufficient fluency across technology, capital markets, and business transformation to engage credibly across Moove’s active workstreams
* Strong product and technology instincts; understands how software is built, how platforms scale, and how technology and physical operations intersect
* Sound judgment on when to act independently and when to escalate
* Available across geographies and time zones as required


**What Does Success Look Like**
* The Co\-CEO and President’s office operates as a high\-performance execution engine, no decisions stall, no commitments drop
* The company’s operating cadence is designed, implemented, and running effectively within the first 90 days
* OKRs and performance scorecards are embedded and generating actionable insights for the executive team
* Governance structures and decision rights are documented and operational across all business units
* Board and investor outputs are produced on time, to a consistently high standard
* Strategic workstreams move faster and with greater clarity as a direct result of this role’s involvement


**Who You'll Be Working with:**
 Directly reporting to our CO\-CEO \& President, and closely working with our office of the CEO team.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Our team is collaborative, positive, curious, and engaged. We think fast, work smart, laugh often, and are looking for like\-minded people to join us in our mission to disrupt vehicle ownership and make financial freedom within reach.
   

  

 Moove is strongly committed to diversity within its community. The Company’s approved Employment Equity Plan and Targets will be considered as part of the recruitment process. As an Equal Opportunities employer, we welcome people from all backgrounds who seek the opportunity to help build a future where everyone and everything can move independently.
   

  

**Pre\-hiring Notice:** 
 Moove relies on the accuracy of information contained in employment applications, as well as the accuracy of other data presented throughout the hiring process and during employment. Any misrepresentations, falsifications, or material omissions in any information or data provided by an applicant may result in the applicant being excluded from further consideration for employment or if an individual has already been hired, termination of employment.
   

  

**EEO Statement:** 
 Moove is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of gender, race, sexual orientation, marital status, religion, political affiliation or any other protected characteristic.

At Lummus Technology, innovation thrives, and excellence is a shared pursuit. When you join Lummus, you are empowered to make an impact and be part of a dynamic team that celebrates creativity, encourages professional development, and fosters collaboration.
   

  

 From our technology portfolio to our global workforce, Lummus is growing at a rapid pace, and we hope that you will grow with us during this exciting time.
   

  

 Lummus Consultants International (LCI) is an autonomous business within Lummus Technology that provides technical, environmental \& social and management consulting services worldwide. We work primarily in the energy industry, with a depth of expertise in power generation, oil \& gas, refining and petrochemicals. We maintain a very strong presence in the international technical due diligence markets to support the global financial industry. LCI has a far\-reaching organization with offices in the United States, UK, the Middle East and Asia.
   

  

 Lummus Consultants is looking for a Business Development Director to grow the company into the area of technical and management consulting in the energy industry – offshore and onshore oil \& gas, LNG, pipelines, power generation and transmission, as well as refining and petrochemicals. This role will be expected to help grow the consulting practice area in the fields of oil\& Gas, power delivery and decarbonization and will primarily entail growing relationships with the financial community and project developers. Assignments require a high level of experience and ability to focus quickly on important issues.
   

  

 The individual we are seeking must be comfortable and confident to work in a seller/doer organization structure.
   

  

**Position**
 The Business Development Director will be expected to grow and lead a new consulting practice area in the fields of Oil \& Gas, power delivery and decarbonization. The group VP and the Leadership Team should have contacts and skills to help him achieve this goal. An international focus is expected. Areas of skill and knowledge should include knowledge of project financing, capex benchmarking analysis, O\&M practices and costs, M\&A support, due diligence and strategy development. The candidate will be expected to lead and participate in advisory assignments, conduct business development, and manage his/her practice business area and interface with Lummus Consultants’ senior management. Additional business areas may be identified based upon the candidate’s personal history and strengths and interests.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities/Accountabilities**
* Grow Lummus Consultants’ business – in cooperation with the existing business heads. His growth strategy should be heavily focused on technical solutions but with a broad business perspective beyond traditional due diligence assignments.
* Develop a business plan to capitalize on existing talents and resources within Lummus Consultants and Lummus Technology; the candidate’s strengths; and market opportunities.
* Grow name recognition of Lummus Consultants in all Energy industry segments (with assistance from the Lummus Communication team and other internal resources).
* Carry out business development, marketing, and proposal preparation efforts and lead Key Account Management teams efforts.
* Lead or participate in consulting project work.
* Prepare clear and concise written reports on assignments, develop conclusions and present clear and precise written and verbal results to clients.
* Expand the Lummus Consulting practice area (globally), consistent with the business plan – identify gaps in skills and potential recruits.
* Achieve objectives with minimal oversight.
* Management of the P\&L forecast by close collaboration with his supervisor and finance.
* Report to Senior Director of Lummus Consultants in Dubai office.


**Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities Required**
* Strong leadership abilities and excellent interpersonal skills
* Strong communicator with excellent written and oral communication skills
* Must have a high degree of self\-motivation and energy
* Must have proven ability to manage business forecasting, short and long term projection
* Capability of earning respect from the team and capable of influencing others without authority
* Excellent professional image/presentation
* Knowledge of many cultures/international style
* Strong commercial savvy and negotiating skills

data.jd_text:
Would you like to contribute to Haskoning’s ambitious Strategy in the Middle East? The region is one of our strategic focus areas, currently with Water and Maritime at its core. Haskoning aims to build on this core to accelerate growth and expand other parts of the businesses through a cross\-business line Advisory Group.
   

  

**What You Do As a Director Advisory Group**
 As the Director of the Advisory Group (DAG) Water \& Maritime Middle East, you will lead, develop, and empower a dynamic international team of 30 plus highly skilled professionals based primarily in the United Arab Emirates, Oman and Saudia Arabia. You will be supported by the management team of Water \& Maritime Americas Middle East \& India and the Associate Directors in the Advisory Group based in Oman and the United Arab Emirates. In this pivotal role, you will not just manage a team — you will spearhead growth, drive innovation, and shape the future of the Haskoning business in the Middle East in a way that enhances sustainability and resilience for clients across the globe.
   

  

 Furthermore, you will also lead the development and growth of a cross\-business line Advisory Group. The group currently comprises around 10 staff and is expected to grow to approximately 50 over the next four years. You will be responsible for executing the group’s growth strategy, developing a strong and diverse team, and creating effective collaboration across different parts of Haskoning’s global business. This will include identifying new client opportunities, shaping multidisciplinary advisory services, strengthening relationships with key internal and external stakeholders, and ensuring the group achieves sustainable commercial performance. You will play a central role in establishing the cross\-business Advisory Group as a recognised platform for integrated advisory services in the Middle East, with a focus on growth, innovation, client impact, and long\-term value for Haskoning.
   

  

 In addition to the Director of Advisory Group it is expected that you will in due course assume responsibilities of Resident Director for the UAE. In this capacity, you will act as Haskoning’s senior representative in the United Arab Emirates, providing country\-level leadership across all Business Lines and Global Leading Markets. Resident Director is responsible for the effective management of the UAE entity, ensuring that local operations are aligned with company strategy, governance requirements, and regional and global priorities. This includes oversight of statutory and regulatory compliance, company registrations, finance and taxation, payroll, human resources, visas and work permits, facilities management, health and safety, risk management, and the overall performance and culture of the local office. Resident Director will also represent Haskoning with clients, partners, authorities, and other key stakeholders, helping to strengthen our market position, safeguard business continuity, and enable sustainable growth in the UAE.
   

  

 This opportunity has arisen as the current incumbent moves into a new role within Haskoning. We are seeking a successor who is committed to the Haskoning group and the region for the long term.
   

  

 Key Performance Indicators:
   

  

* P\&L Responsibility, Commercial success and continuous improvement: Drive the commercial and financial success of the Advisory Group by fostering co\-creation with global clients and partners. Generate focused growth in our key markets by connecting teams within the Advisory Group and with other expertise centres across the globe.
* Stakeholder management: Build strong communication channels within and outside Haskoning to encourage seamless cooperation and create a distinct, unified identity. You will serve as the glue that holds teams together, fostering relationships that accelerate both business and environmental impact.
* People management: Cultivate an environment and culture where both individuals and the business can thrive. Develop the Advisory Group strategy as part of Haskoning’s overarching corporate and Business Line / Business Unit strategies and enable the Associate Directors to implement it successfully under your guidance and leadership.


* Project Delivery (of proof of concepts, projects and support contracts), including:
+ Meeting client's expectations, achieving required scope and quality
+ Driving Financial performance
+ Promoting solid and accountable project management practices.


 You will report directly to the Business Unit Director of Water \& Maritime Americas Middle East \& India and be a key member of the Business Unit Management Team, collaborating on the broader vision and strategy of our business.
   

  

**Where will you work**
 Haskoning is a globally established and operating independent consultancy, engineering and project management firm which integrates over 140 years of domain expertise with digital technologies and software solutions. Our 6,500 colleagues work from offices in more than 25 countries across the world. Through our mission Enhancing Society Together, we take responsibility for having a positive impact on the planet.
   

  

 You will be based in our Dubai office with frequent travel across the region.
   

  

**What You Bring**
 We are looking for a visionary leader with a strategic mindset. You thrive in dynamic environments, have a natural ability to lead and inspire diverse teams, and are ready to drive the next chapter of growth for the Middle East.
   

  

* Higher Education in engineering, management or environmental disciplines;
* Extensive Experience in Engineering Consultancy in the Maritime or related industry, also with the knowledge of the Energy \& Industry sectors being advantageous;
* Minimum of 5 years Line management (including P\&L) responsibility, with proven experience to lead teams of at least 30 people;
* A network of clients in the Middle East region is a significant advantage;
* General management and entity management experience is an advantage;
* Fluent in English with the ability to engage stakeholders across cultures and geographies. Arabic would be an advantage but is not essential;
* An international outlook, with experience working in diverse, multicultural environments, ensuring effective communication across borders


**What we offer**
 Within our company you will be able to develop yourself while working on challenging projects across the globe. Besides that, we also offer:
   

  

* A good work\-life balance, with the flexibility to work from home up to 2 days per week;
* 25 annual leave days per year, based on a 40\-hour work week;
* A competitive salary package;
* Lifelong learning by offering you plenty of training \& development opportunities.
* Profit share based on company profit.
* Medical insurance


**Are you our new colleague?**
 We would like to meet you! Click on the apply button and upload your resume and motivation letter. After receiving your application, we will contact you as soon as possible. Are we all enthusiastic after this? Then you will receive an offer from us, and we will be happy to welcome you on board!
   

  

 In case of questions, please contact Anouk de Winter, recruiter, anouk.de.winter@haskoning.com.
   

  

 Please note the deadline for receiving applications is Wednesday the 15th of July 2026\.
   

  

 Due to the privacy law, please submit your application via the apply button and not via email.
   

  

***Acquisition of this vacancy by agencies is not appreciated and the candidates offered will not be taken into consideration.***

data.jd_text:
**Locations** 
 : Dubai \| Riyadh
   

  

 Who We Are
   

  

 The Middle East IT Service Manager is the face of Tech@BCG in a key market for BCG. Spanning Dubai, Riyadh, Doha, Abu Dhabi, and Kuwait, this role is not a back\-office function: it is the primary connection between a demanding regional business and the global IT organisation. Local business leadership knows this person by name, calls them first, and relies on them to make technology work.
   

  

 The role sits at the intersection of the local business and the IT function. It owns regional IT service delivery end to end, manages senior stakeholder relationships, feeds office demand and business feedback into the IT organisation, and ensures that what is built and delivered globally actually works for the Middle East. The person in this role represents the business to IT, and IT to the business.
   

  

 In practice, this means running a tight operation, governing vendors and contracts with discipline, driving a sustained shift towards automation and AI\-enabled support, and always knowing what the numbers are telling you. It requires someone equally comfortable in a service review and a conversation with a Managing Director, who understands that trust with the business is the foundation everything else is built on.
   

  

 Beyond operations, this role demands a genuine people leader. Someone who invests in their team, listens before they act, and creates an environment where people do their best work. Within the broader EMESA IT Service community, this person is a collaborative and engaged peer: sharing what works, supporting colleagues across other regions, and contributing to a function that is stronger because its leaders work well together. If you lead with integrity, bring others with you, and take the success of the team as seriously as your own, this role is for you.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

* Stakeholder Relationships \& Business Partnering
* Serve as the primary point of contact for local business leadership across all Middle East offices as the face of Tech@BCG in the region
* Actively manage senior stakeholder relationships, building trust with office leadership and ensuring IT is seen as a partner, not a utility
* Capture, consolidate, and feed local business demand and feedback into the global IT organisation and translating office needs into inputs the IT function can act on
* Own the senior escalation path for critical incidents and high\-impact service events, and maintain playbooks for executive support and key office moments
* Capacity \& Financial Management
* Ensure regional capacity is managed in line with global and functional targets, escalating deviations and translating business demand into resourcing inputs for the IT organisation
* Build cost\-to\-serve visibility at office level to support data\-led conversations with both local leadership and global IT
* Challenge and reduce local service deviations where demand doesn’t justify them
* Drive the shift from human\-touch support to automation and self\-service. This is a direction of travel, not a one\-off project
* Automation \& AI\-Enabled Support
* Set and own targets for no\-contact and low\-contact resolution rates across the region
* Build out self\-service capabilities for high\-frequency, routine requests: if a human is handling it repeatedly, it should be automated
* Embed AI\-assisted triage and resolution tooling into local support workflows
* Maintain a live automation backlog and convert repeat demand into scalable workflows systematically
* Improve ticket and knowledge quality to cut engineering escalations and break the cycle of recurring incidents
* Security, Compliance \& Resilience
* Ensure secure fulfilment patterns are embedded in all service workflows, not treated as a separate workstream
* Enforce compliance with device management, access control, and privileged support standards
* Minimise operational risk through disciplined change management and resilience practices
* Partner closely with ISRM: regional security posture is a shared responsibility and I expect you to own your side of i


 What You'll Bring
   

  

* 8–12\+ years in IT Service Management, Digital Workplace, or End\-User Computing leadership
* Proven experience running multi\-site or regional service delivery across geographically dispersed teams
* Background in service transformation or operating model redesign : you have changed how a function works, not just run it
* Hands\-on familiarity with AI\-enabled / automated support tooling and modern ESM platforms
* Strong grounding in financial management, capacity planning, and cost\-to\-serve modelling
* Vendor management and contract governance experience in a contracted or hybrid delivery model
* Fluent English; Arabic proficiency is a genuine advantage in this region
* Readiness to travel occasionally across Middle East office locations : presence matters here


 Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

data.jd_text:
We’re looking for a Director Supply Chain to join the team and focus on growing our own Grocery Store “tMart”. THis role is critical leadership role at the core of tMart UAE's business performance. This position owns both Demand Planning (DP) and Supply Chain (SC), ensuring seamless integration between forecasting, inventory management, warehouse operations, transportation, and network optimization.
 



  





 The role is responsible for maximizing product availability while optimizing inventory, transportation costs, working capital, and overall profitability. As a key member of the UAE leadership team, the successful candidate will proactively design scalable supply chain solutions, drive operational excellence, and lead innovation initiatives that directly impact GMV growth, free cash flow, and customer experience.
 



  





**WHAT’S ON YOUR PLATE?** 




  





**Demand Planning \& Inventory Management** 



* Own end\-to\-end demand forecasting accuracy across all categories and channels.
* Drive product availability as the primary business metric through optimized forecasting and replenishment strategies.
* Manage inventory health and Days on Hand (DOH) targets across warehouses and stores.
* Optimize stock allocation across stores and distribution centers.
* Lead forecasting enhancement initiatives through advanced analytics, AI, and Intelligent Demand Planning (IDP) tools.
* Balance service levels, inventory investment, and waste reduction to maximize profitability.
* Partner closely with Commercial, Operations, and Inventory teams to anticipate business needs and proactively plan capacity and stock requirements.



  





**Supply Chain Network \& Logistics** 



* Own the design, optimization, and performance of the UAE supply chain network
* Optimize transportation flows, routes, network design, truck utilization, and contract structures.
* Identify opportunities to reduce logistics costs while improving service levels and fill rates.
* Lead warehouse and network optimization projects, incorporating automation and industry best practices.
* Proactively map and implement new operational flows and processes as the business scales.



  





**Warehouse Operations \& Inventory Accuracy** 



* Serve as the primary point of contact for warehouse and transportation 3PL partners.
* Monitor and improve key contractual KPIs including:
* On\-Time Delivery
* Damage Rates
* Service Compliance
* Cost Efficiency
* Maintain inventory accuracy targets through robust reconciliation processes between warehouse systems and operational platforms.
* Oversee cycle count programs and inventory controls across all distribution centers and across all tMart stores.
* Drive SOP compliance and continuous improvement initiatives across supply chain functions.
* Ensure optimal space utilization, stock positioning, and inventory valuation management.



  





**Process Excellence \& Business Transformation** 



* Develop, implement, and continuously improve SOPs across supply chain processes including:
* Lead supply chain innovation initiatives leveraging technology, automation, and data\-driven decision making.
* Introduce external best practices to improve scalability, productivity, and operational efficiency.
* Build proactive planning capabilities that anticipate future business needs rather than reacting to operational challenges.



  





**Leadership \& Stakeholder Management** 



* Lead and develop Supply Chain and Distribution Center Teams
* Build a high\-performing organization with clear accountability, ownership, and succession planning.
* Establish and deliver shared OKRs across functions.
* Lead executive\-level business reviews and strategic discussions with senior stakeholders and external partners.
* Drive cross\-functional collaboration to improve business outcomes rather than optimize individual functions in isolation.



  





**WHAT DID WE ORDER?** 




  





**Experience** 



* 8–12\+ years of experience in Demand Planning, Supply Chain, Logistics, Warehouse Operations, or Network Optimization.
* Proven leadership experience managing multi\-functional supply chain teams.
* Experience operating within complex distribution networks involving multiple warehouses, stores, cross\-docks, and third\-party logistics providers.
* Strong background in inventory management, forecasting, transportation optimization, and warehouse operations.
* Experience leading large\-scale transformation, automation, or systems implementation projects.



  





**Skills \& Competencies** 



* Exceptional analytical and quantitative capabilities.
* Strong business and financial acumen with understanding of P\&L, working capital, and cash flow drivers.
* Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands\-on execution.
* Deep understanding of supply chain flows, inventory dynamics, and operational processes.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.
* Ability to lead through ambiguity and solve business\-wide problems rather than functional issues alone.
* Comfortable presenting to senior leadership and leading executive discussions.
* High agility with data, systems, and supply chain technology platforms.

Established in 2004, Dubai Holding is a global investment company with investments in more than 34 countries and a combined workforce of nearly 45,000 individuals. In line with the vision of Dubai’s leadership and economic diversification strategy, Dubai Holding companies have nurtured sectors, irrevocably transforming Dubai’s socio\-economic landscape and positioning Dubai as a diversified, globally integrated economy.
 



  





 Dubai Holding is committed to the diversification of Dubai’s non\-oil economy. Our portfolio, valued at over AED 284\+ billion, spans 10 sectors, including real estate, hospitality, leisure \& entertainment, ICT, design, education, media, retail, manufacturing \& logistics, and science.
 



  





**For the Good of Tomorrow** 




  





 Dubai Holding is looking to hire a
 **Vice President – Digital Engineering** 
 within the
 **Information Technology Department** 
 at Dubai Holding Corporate. The role holder is responsible for defining and executing the Group\-wide Digital Engineering and Platform Strategy, with direct accountability for the design, build, and scaling of enterprise technology capabilities across AI, ERP platforms, Integration Services, Digital Products, and Service Orchestration.
 



  





 The role ensures that enterprise technology platforms are strategically aligned with Dubai Holding’s business priorities, enabling scalable growth, operational efficiency, and differentiated customer experiences. A key focus is the governance and execution of integrated product and platform roadmaps across these domains to drive long\-term value creation.
 



  





 The role acts as a strategic partner to the Group CTO and business leadership, translating technology strategy into integrated, platform\-driven capabilities that accelerate growth, efficiency, and enterprise value.
 



  





**Role Relationships:** 




  




* Group CTO, Group and Vertical Technology Teams, Strategy \& Value Creation, Business Verticals, Technology Vendors, System Integrators, Cloud \& Platform Providers
* 4\-5 Direct Reports



  





**Key Accountabilities:** 




  





**Group Digital Engineering \& Platform Strategy** 




  




* Define and own the enterprise\-wide Digital Engineering strategy aligned to Group and vertical priorities
* Establish strategic direction across core domains: AI \& Data Platforms, ERP \& Enterprise Systems, Integration \& APIs, Digital Products, Service Orchestration
* Drive platform consolidation, standardisation, and reuse across business units
* Translate business priorities into coherent cross\-domain platform strategies



  





**Product Roadmap Ownership \& Strategic Alignment** 



* Own definition, governance, and execution of product and platform roadmaps
* Align technology investments with business value creation objectives
* Prioritise initiatives based on ROI, strategic importance, and enterprise impact
* Eliminate duplication and fragmentation through centralised roadmap governance



  





**AI \& Intelligent Platform Enablement** 




  




* Define and execute the Group AI strategy across enterprise platforms
* Identify and scale high\-value data and AI use cases (automation, personalisation, analytics)
* Establish AI platform capabilities including data foundations, model lifecycle, and MLOps
* Drive enterprise adoption of AI\-enabled services



  





**ERP \& Core Enterprise Platforms** 




  




* Own strategy, operation and transformation of ERP platforms (Oracle) and adjacent systems
* Lead consolidation, simplification, and standardisation across business entities in line with Enterprise Architectural patterns
* Ensure ERP technology\-stack supports scalable, integrated, and efficient business operations
* Review and align ERP roadmap with business capability needs



  





**Integration Services \& Enterprise Connectivity** 




  




* Define and lead Group\-wide integration strategy (APIs, middleware, event\-driven architecture)
* Build, operate and scale integration platforms (API gateways, iPaaS) (Informatica, Frends)
* Establish standardised integration patterns to eliminate complexity
* Enable seamless interoperability across enterprise and vertical systems



  





**Digital Products \& Services** 




  




* Lead strategy and delivery of Group IT digital product platforms
* Define product operating models, lifecycle management, and engineering frameworks
* Drive development of scalable, reusable digital services
* Align digital product outcomes with growth, engagement, and customer experience
* Evaluate, implement and scale blockchain and tokenisation platforms to support digital asset enablement, new business models, and ecosystem partnerships with Strategy \& Value Creation



  





**Service Orchestration \& Platform Operating Model** 




  




* Define and implement service orchestration capabilities (ServiceNow)
* Enable end\-to\-end service delivery across ERP, integration, and digital layers
* Establish frameworks to unify fragmented workflows and services
* Drive adoption of platform\-based operating models



  





**Engineering Excellence \& Delivery** 




  




* Establish best\-in\-class engineering practices (DevSecOps, CI/CD, agile delivery)
* Drive engineering quality, productivity, and scalability
* Lead complex transformation programmes across multiple entities
* Ensure delivery aligns with strategic priorities and roadmap commitment



  





**Stakeholder Collaboration \& Communication** 




  




* Act as a trusted advisor to Group CTO and senior leadership across the Group
* Translate technology strategies into clear business outcomes
* Align stakeholders across technology, product, and business domains
* Provide executive\-level communication and reporting



  





**Vendor \& Partner Ecosystem** 




  




* Define and manage strategic partnerships (ERP, cloud, AI, platforms)
* Oversee system integrators and delivery partners
* Ensure vendor accountability, performance, and value realisation
* Continuously scout market for potential future technologies and partners to support the long\-term Group IT Strategy



  





**Who we are looking for:** 




  




* 12–15\+ years in large\-scale enterprise technology delivery and operations
* 8–10\+ years in senior leadership roles managing large engineering and product organisations
* Proven experience leading enterprise\-wide transformation programmes
* Experience in complex, multi\-entity organisations (real\-estate, hospitality, construction or similar sectors preferred)



  





**Education/Professional Certification:** 









**Minimum requirements** 



* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or related field
* Master’s Degree (MBA or MSc) strongly preferred
* PMP / PRINCE2
* ITIL v4
* TOGAF or Enterprise Architecture certifications
* Agile / SAFe certifications
* 



**Technical Competencies:** 




  




* Strong analytical thinking and problem\-solving skills
* Strong attention to detail
* Strong interpersonal skills
* Evolved organisational awareness and stakeholder management



  





 Deep expertise across:
 



  




* AI \& Data Platforms (Foundry, MS Fabric, MLOPs)
* ERP Systems (Oracle)
* Integration Architecture (APIs, middleware, event\-driven systems)
* Digital Product Platforms (Webflow/Acquia)
* Service orchestration and platform operating models (ServiceNow)
* Experience blockchain infrastructure, smart contracts, and tokenisation frameworks, including their integration into enterprise platforms and digital product ecosystems
* Strong knowledge of cloud\-native architectures, microservices, and DevSecOps
* Ability to define and execute multi\-domain enterprise platform strategies



  





**Behavioural Competencies:** 




  




* Strong executive presence and influence at C\-suite level
* Strategic thinking with strong execution capability
* Ability to operate in complex, multi\-stakeholder environments
* Excellent communication and storytelling skills
* Results\-oriented with high accountability
* Proven ability to build and lead high\-performing teams



  





**As much as we would be delighted to entertain all applicants, due to the high volumes of applications, only successful applicants will be contacted within 14 business days.** 




  





**This job description is not all inclusive. Dubai Holding reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. Dubai Holding is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment.**
