data.jd_text:
Independent Food Company is home to some of the region's most recognised hospitality concepts, including SALT, Somewhere, Parker's, Shalwa, Somewhere, and Public. We are a fast\-growing organisation with an expanding portfolio of concepts, an active acquisition strategy, and ambitious plans for growth across new and existing markets. As we scale, the quality of our people remains central to everything we build. That is where you come in.
 



  





**Job Purpose:** 




 The Director of Real Estate is responsible for managing and expanding the organization’s retail property portfolio, including site selection, lease negotiations, budget analysis, and store openings across the UAE and franchisees. This role requires strategic leadership to develop and implement real estate strategies aligned with the company’s vision, while building strong relationships with key stakeholders and ensuring compliance with industry standards. The Director will lead a team and work closely with operations, project managers, and developers to identify growth opportunities, mitigate risks, and achieve sustainable expansion.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**Strategic Planning and Market Analysis:** 




 • Conduct in\-depth market and competitive analysis to develop independent expansion plans, either in house or outsourced.
 



 • Prepare and submit annual business plans to the board, ensuring equal growth opportunities for all brands.
 



 • Create and implement real estate strategies tailored to each brand’s demographics, pricing, and product range.
 



 • Present brand market potential and expansion capacity for the next 3 years.
 



 • Conduct Real Estate Market Mapping and Sales Forecasting.
 



 • Develop and present detailed feasibility studies, including financial projections and market analysis, prior to obtaining site approvals
 



  





**Existing Portfolio Management, Renewals, and Crisis Resolution** 




 • Portfolio Oversight \& Performance Tracking: Proactively manage and monitor the performance of the existing real estate portfolio, conducting monthly reviews of asset performance, rent\-to\-sales ratios, and location viability.
 



 • Lease Renewals \& Restructuring: Oversee the end\-to\-end lease renewal pipeline, evaluating historical store performance to determine whether to renew, renegotiate terms, relocate, or exit properties.
 



 • Crisis Management \& Landlord Relations: Act as the primary point of escalation and resolution for property crises (e.g., operational disruptions, landlord\-tenant disputes, mall maintenance issues affecting sales, or unexpected economic downturns). Lead rent\-reduction or lease\-restructuring negotiations during operational crises to safeguard company margins.
 



  





**Site Selection and Management** 




 • Aggressive Location Scouting: Lead hands\-on, ground\-level field scouting and site mapping to uncover premium, off\-market, or high\-potential spaces (malls, high\-streets, cloud kitchens, and standalone spots) tailored to specific brand concepts.
 



 • Conduct comprehensive site assessments, traffic counts, visibility analyses, and accessibility mapping to guarantee optimum footfall and brand exposure.
 



 • Investigate, evaluate, and identify potential sites, markets, towns, and competition for new store locations.
 



 • Manage schedules for projects and oversee processes to obtain permits and approvals.
 



 • Prepare detailed project estimates and reports for management review.
 



  





**F\&B Project Development** 




 • Oversee the development of F\&B projects, including feasibility studies, design monitoring, and financial analyses.
 



 • Develop and implement strategies to expand and improve F\&B offerings in retail locations, aligning with company goals and market trends.
 



 • Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to align F\&B goals with overall business objectives.
 



 • Present findings and recommendations to stakeholders.
 



 • Provide insights and guidance on food and beverage (F\&B) operations, including labor optimization, supply chain logistics, and customer service standards, to ensure successful project execution.
 



 • Ensure properties and real estate strategies aligned with delivering exceptional guest experiences, prioritizing innovation, quality, and service excellence
 



  





**Team Development and Risk Management** 




 • Recruit, manage, and develop a high\-performing team, including managers and supervisors, to build a reliable and effective department for market mapping and research.
 



 • Ensure compliance with relevant laws, regulations, and industry standards in all property dealings. • Identify and mitigate risks, including regulatory and financial risks, through effective risk management strategies.
 



 • Foster a positive and collaborative team culture, aligned with the company’s core value
 



  





**Contractual \& Commercial Lease Terms Governance** 




 • Legal \& Commercial De\-risking: Direct the drafting, review, and structuring of all legal lease agreements, ensuring all commercial and operational terms protect the company's long\-term interests.
 



 • Clause Enforcement: Secure favorable legal clauses, including but not limited to: Exclusivity/Non compete protections within specific developments, clear termination and break\-clauses, realistic force majeure terms, and capped annual rent escalations.
 



  





**Landlord Negotiations \& Deal Structuring** 




 • Deal Sourcing \& Commercial Pitches: Lead high\-stakes commercial negotiations with major developers (e.g., Emaar, Nakheel, Majid Al Futtaim, Merex) and private landlords to secure highly competitive rates and preferential positioning.
 



 • Financial Terms Optimization: Strategically negotiate base rents, turnover rent percentages, rent\-free periods (fit\-out periods), key money, and landlord fit\-out contributions to maximize early\-stage ROI and reduce capital expenditure.
 



  





**Business Development and Relationship Management** 




 • Create, pitch, and build new leads with developers, investors, and local authorities.
 



 • Develop business and market plans for all brands acquired or franchised by the company.
 



 • Address stakeholder concerns and collaborate on approvals and permits.
 



 • Stay updated on industry trends, demographic shifts, and competitor activities to identify new opportunities and recommend strategies for sustainable growth.
 



 • Demonstrate cultural awareness and sensitivity by understanding local customs, preferences, and business practices in the Middle East, ensuring alignment with regional expectations
 



  





**Other Duties:** 




 Perform other duties and responsibilities as may be assigned by management from time to time.

data.jd_text:
**About Faux Consultancy.** 




 Founded in 2011, Faux is the Middle East’s leading Public Relations and Events Consultancy, working in partnership with global brands and the region’s most exciting independent concepts. Based in Dubai and working actively across the whole of the GCC, Faux is a trusted on\-the\-ground partner for brands focused on amplifying their visibility and commercial success in the region. Faux’s client divisions focus solely on Fashion and Beauty, spanning the luxury and niche sectors. This sharp focus, along with the agency’s legacy of over a decade of innovative brand representation, allows for a level of experience and insight that is unmatched. We are committed to providing the most qualitative, thoughtful and effective representation for our brands.
 



  





 The Account Director is a central leadership role within Faux, spanning key pillars of strategic development and project implementation for both local and international clients. Working in direct collaboration with the Senior Management team, this is a position that involves engagement in both day\-to\-day Account Direction and team management, as well as high\-level strategic planning and the opportunity to be involved in Business Development.
 



  





 Overseeing a portfolio of Beauty brands, the Account Director is responsible for leading a team of employees in the successful management and representation of their ‘team portfolio’, ensuring a qualitative approach to Public Relations in the GCC, and achieving certain KPIs associated with the accounts.
 



 The Account Director ensures that best\-practice standards are always in place, from strategy development through to campaign execution, and enjoys a level of autonomy in the management of their ‘working group’ to best utilise and develop the talents of their team.
 



  





 This role requires significant industry experience in a similar Senior PR position, working specifically across Beauty clients, preferably with experience or insight into the GCC Market. The ideal candidate for this role will have a strong sense of self\-direction and a desire to take on a top leadership role within a market\-leading, fast\-paced and dynamic agency.
 



  





 Innovation, professionalism, and a qualitative approach to Public Relations lie at the heart of Faux's approach to client representation, and these qualities will be reflected in the successful candidate, in terms of their previous success and future goals.
 



  





**RESPONSIBILITIES** 




  




* Development and implementation of innovative and effective GCC\-wide strategies for PR clients, spanning Press, Influencer, VIP and CRM Relations
* Leadership of a dedicated team within the company, providing structure, mentorship and guidance to ensure smooth workflow and delivery
* Securing qualitative, high\-value PR coverage and other results in line with allocated KPIs, always aiming to exceed targets
* Demonstrate strong leadership skills, including allocation of tasks, mentoring of direct reports, and providing clear, critical feedback
* Responsibility for the successful delivery of organic and commercial PR projects carried out on behalf of clients, including planning, implementation, and post\-activity analysis
* Work in partnership with the Faux Events team to effectively plan and host events, activations, and other concepts for agency clients
* Provide active contribution to the business development goals of the agency, participating in the development and presentation of pitches for new business
* Maintain a strong awareness of industry trends, talents, and other movements, to provide the best possible insight to clients, GCC\-wide
* Planning and negotiation of commercial talent and media deals on behalf of clients, including advertorials, ambassadorship deals, and paid campaigns
* Local content creation: show expertise and ease in handling production and post\-production of localised campaigns, which are specifically targeted to the GCC market
* Daily budget management, including the responsible planning, spending, and tracking of client budgets
* Team management to ensure the accurate data gathering, analysis and client reporting are carried out within the provided deadlines
* Active contribution to the development of a positive workplace culture, collaborating and sharing suggestions with Senior Management on ways to best motivate and reward the team.



  





**QUALIFICATIONS** 




  




* A bachelor's or master’s degree in public relations, communications or other relevant discipline
* **At least 8 years of PR industry experience, including in the role of Public Relations / Communications Manager, specifically in the Beauty industry**
* **At least 3 years in a similar role or as a Senior PR Manager, specifically in the Beauty industry**
* **A strong media and influencer network across the GCC is an essential requirement**
* Proven leadership skills, with the ability to confidently guide, motivate and manage a team
* A creative thinker who values innovation, bringing to the table fresh ideas and strategies
* Proven success in a previous senior PR role, including the securing of high\-value coverage and the generation of market\-leading ideas
* Excellent regional networks with the leading press, influencers, stylists and celebrities
* A positive and engaged attitude to relationship development in the region
* An awareness and understanding of regional market nuances, and their impact on Beauty brand management
* A keen interest in social media trends and a keen interest in staying ahead of the curve, always to nourish our clients with fresh concepts and locally relevant and time\-sensitive social listening ideas
* Strong multi\-tasking and organisational skills, to thrive in a fast\-paced agency environment where many projects are carried out in parallel
* High level of organisation and experience in complex workflow management, with the ability to hit strict deadlines and KPIs
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into engaging stories
* Ad\-hoc regional and international travel will be required.

**Job Description**
 The Senior Project Controls Manager will provide strategic leadership and oversight of all project controls functions for a major high\-rise development in Riyadh. The role will be responsible for establishing and managing project controls governance, including planning, scheduling, cost management, risk management, change control, reporting, and performance monitoring across all project phases.
   

  

 Acting as a key member of the PMC leadership team, the Senior Project Controls Manager will ensure robust controls are implemented from the post\-concept design stage through procurement, construction, commissioning, and handover, enabling informed decision\-making and successful project delivery in line with client objectives.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Project Controls Leadership**
 Lead and manage all project controls activities across the project lifecycle.
   

  

 Develop and implement the Project Controls Management Plan, procedures, and governance framework.
   

  

 Provide strategic advice to the Project Director and Client on project performance, risks, and opportunities.
   

  

 Lead and mentor planning, cost control, reporting, and risk management teams.
   

  

**Planning \& Scheduling**
 Establish and maintain the integrated project master programme covering design, procurement, construction, and commissioning activities.
   

  

 Review and approve contractors’ and consultants’ schedules, methodologies, and recovery plans.
   

  

 Conduct critical path analysis and schedule risk assessments.
   

  

 Monitor project progress against approved baselines and recommend corrective actions.
   

  

 Ensure timely achievement of key project milestones and deliverables.
   

  

**Cost Management \& Commercial Oversight**
 Lead project cost control, budgeting, forecasting, and cash flow management.
   

  

 Establish cost reporting systems and performance measurement indicators.
   

  

 Monitor commitments, expenditures, change requests, and forecasted project costs.
   

  

 Support commercial and contract management teams regarding valuation, variations, and claims.
   

  

 Advise project leadership on financial performance and potential cost risks.
   

  

**Risk \& Change Management**
 Establish and maintain project risk management processes and risk registers.
   

  

 Facilitate periodic risk workshops and mitigation planning sessions.
   

  

 Lead schedule and cost impact assessments for changes and variations.
   

  

 Ensure proper governance and approvals for all change control activities.
   

  

**Reporting \& Performance Management**
 Develop executive dashboards, KPIs, and performance reporting frameworks.
   

  

 Present project performance reports to senior stakeholders and the Client.
   

  

 Track project health indicators and provide early warning notices on emerging issues.
   

  

 Utilize Earned Value Management (EVM) and performance analytics to monitor project delivery.
   

  

**Claims \& Dispute Avoidance**
 Provide project controls input into claims evaluation and extension\-of\-time assessments.
   

  

 Review contractor claims, delay analyses, and entitlement submissions.
   

  

 Support contract administration and dispute resolution activities.
   

  

 Ensure robust project records and documentation are maintained.
   

  

**Stakeholder \& Client Management**
 Act as the primary project controls interface with the Client, designers, contractors, and key stakeholders.
   

  

 Participate in executive steering committee and project review meetings.
   

  

 Build strong relationships with project stakeholders to facilitate successful project delivery.
   

  

 Provide strategic recommendations and presentations to senior management.
   

  

**Digital Project Controls**
 Drive the implementation of project controls technologies and digital reporting tools.
   

  

 Lead the utilization of Primavera P6, Power BI, cost management systems, and project dashboards.
   

  

 Promote data\-driven decision\-making and continuous improvement initiatives.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Quantity Surveying, Project Management, or related discipline.
* Master's Degree is preferred.
* Professional certifications such as PMP, PSP, CCP, MRICS, or equivalent are highly desirable.
* Minimum 18–20 years of project controls experience on large\-scale building and infrastructure projects.
* Minimum 8 years in a Senior Project Controls Manager or equivalent leadership role.
* Proven PMC/consultancy experience on large\-scale mixed\-use, commercial, hospitality, or high\-rise developments.
* Strong experience across design, procurement, construction, testing, commissioning, and handover phases.
* Previous experience in Saudi Arabia and the GCC is highly preferred.
* Experience working on projects delivered in accordance with RIBA stages and international project management standards.
* Advanced knowledge of Primavera P6 and project scheduling techniques.
* Strong expertise in cost management, forecasting, budgeting, and project analytics.
* Experience with Power BI, reporting systems, and digital project controls solutions.
* Strong understanding of risk management methodologies.
* Working knowledge of FIDIC contracts, claims, and dispute resolution processes.
* Proficiency in Earned Value Management (EVM) and project performance measurement.

**Project Controls Leadership**
* Lead the project controls strategy and implementation for utility compound programs.
* Develop and maintain integrated project controls plans, aligning schedule, cost, risk, change, and reporting processes with corporate and client requirements.

**Planning \& Scheduling**
* Establish, review, and approve baseline schedules in collaboration with planning engineers and project leads.
* Integrate multiple contractor and internal schedules into a single program\-level master schedule.
* Monitor schedule performance, analyze critical paths, float, and interfaces between utility compounds and wider network works.
* Lead schedule risk analysis and scenario planning to assess and mitigate potential delays.
* Review contractors’ recovery plans and assess their viability.


**Cost Management \& Forecasting**
* Develop and manage project budgets, cash flow forecasts, and cost control frameworks for utility compounds.
* Oversee cost tracking, commitment control, and monthly cost/value reconciliations.
* Lead cost forecasting and estimate\-at\-completion reviews, ensuring alignment with schedule and risk.
* Identify cost variances, trends, and opportunities for savings; recommend corrective and optimizing measures.


**Change \& Risk Management**
* Set up and manage robust change control processes, including impact assessments on scope, time, cost, and risk.
* Chair or support change control boards, ensuring timely review, approval, and documentation of changes.
* Establish and maintain project risk registers, facilitating risk identification, qualitative/quantitative assessment, and mitigation planning.
* Coordinate schedule and cost risk analyses and integrate results into forecasts and management reporting.


**Performance Measurement \& Reporting**
* Implement earned value management or equivalent performance measurement techniques.
* Define and monitor KPIs for schedule adherence, cost performance, productivity, and change/risk effectiveness.
* Produce clear, concise monthly and ad‑hoc project controls reports for senior management, clients, and stakeholders.
* Provide early warning on emerging issues and propose data‑driven mitigation and recovery strategies.


**Data, Systems \& Governance**
* Oversee configuration and use of project controls tools (e.g., Primavera P6, MS Project, cost management and reporting systems).
* Ensure data integrity, version control, and alignment between planning, cost, and reporting systems.
* Develop and maintain project controls procedures, templates, and standards tailored to utility compound delivery.
* Support internal and external audits, ensuring compliance with company governance and client requirements.


**Stakeholder \& Interface Management**
* Act as the primary point of contact for project controls matters with clients, consultants, contractors, and internal leadership.
* Coordinate interfaces between utility compounds and related packages (transmission/distribution, MEP systems, building works, enabling works).
* Present project status, trends, and recommendations in steering committees, progress meetings, and executive reviews.


**Team Leadership \& Development**
* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of planners, cost engineers, risk analysts, and reporting specialists.
* Allocate resources effectively across projects and phases, ensuring adequate coverage for critical milestones.
* Promote a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and knowledge sharing within the project controls function.

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, Quantity Surveying, or a related field.
* 15 years experience in project controls with at least 5 – 10 years on major construction or infrastructure projects, with significant exposure to utilities or industrial compounds.
* Demonstrated experience leading project controls on complex, multi‑contract programs from initiation through closeout.
* Strong understanding of planning, cost control, risk management, change control, and EVM principles.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master’s degree in Project Management, Engineering, or Business.
* Professional certification such as , , , , or equivalent.
* Experience in power / utilities (substations, utility hubs, process plants, or similar compound\-type developments).
* Experience with standard forms of contract (FIDIC) and their implications for schedule and cost management.


**Skills \& Competencies**
* Advanced proficiency in project planning software (e.g., Primavera P6, MS Project) and cost management tools.
* Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with the ability to interpret complex datasets and derive actionable insights.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, able to convey complex project controls information to non‑specialists.

data.jd_text:
SYSTRA is one of the world's leading engineering and consultancy groups specialising in public transport and sustainable mobility. With over 10,300 employees, SYSTRA's mission is to design safe and sustainable transport solutions to bring people together, develop social inclusion and facilitate access to employment, education and leisure throughout the world.
   

  

 For 65 years, the Group has been working alongside cities and regions to contribute to their development by creating, improving and modernising their infrastructure and transport systems, throughout the life cycle of their projects. SYSTRA is involved from the earliest stages of design through to the testing, deployment and maintenance phases. The company provides all its services in over 80 countries worldwide and generates 74% of its turnover internationally. With its new services, SYSTRA supports its clients and partners in their digital, ecological and energy transition, in order to invent the mobility of tomorrow.
   

  

 Context
   

  

***This requirement is for a bid opportunity only at this stage. Any engagement will be subject to successful project award and final client approval.***
 The Project Controls Manager will lead and manage all project controls functions across major railway and transportation infrastructure projects, ensuring effective planning, scheduling, cost control, reporting, risk management, change management, and performance monitoring. The role is critical to supporting successful project delivery in line with approved budgets, schedules, quality standards, and contractual obligations.
   

  

 Missions/Main Duties
   

  

* Lead and manage the overall project controls function, including planning, scheduling, cost control, risk, change management, progress measurement, and performance reporting.
* Establish and maintain project controls procedures, systems, tools, templates, and reporting protocols in line with PMC and client requirements.
* Manage and mentor the project controls team, ensuring effective delivery across planning, cost, reporting, and risk disciplines.
* Review and monitor contractor and consultant schedules to ensure alignment with project milestones, contractual requirements, and delivery strategy.
* Analyze schedule performance, identify delays and critical path impacts, and recommend mitigation, recovery, and time impact measures where required.
* Establish and oversee cost control processes, including budget tracking, forecasting, cash flow monitoring, variance analysis, and alignment of cost with physical progress.
* Prepare and consolidate dashboards, KPIs, and project controls reports for senior management and client stakeholders.
* Lead risk and change management processes, including risk registers, impact assessments, trend monitoring, variations, and support for claims and extension of time reviews.
* Coordinate with commercial, engineering, construction, and client teams to ensure alignment on project controls matters and contract compliance.
* Ensure effective use of project controls systems, data integrity, reporting quality, and continuous improvement in controls processes and governance.


 Profile/Skills
   

  

* Minimum 20 years of experience in project controls, planning, cost, and performance management on major capital projects.
* Mandatory experience in railway or major transportation infrastructure projects.
* Strong GCC experience is required.
* Saudi Arabia experience is preferred.
* Proven experience working with PMC, client\-side, or major program management teams on large, complex projects.
* Demonstrated ability to manage project controls across multiple contracts and interfaces.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, or related field is required.
* Master’s degree is preferred.
* PMP, PMI\-SP, AACE, RICS, or equivalent professional certification is desirable.
* Strong knowledge of project controls principles, scheduling techniques, cost control systems, and risk management practices.
* Proficiency in Primavera P6 and strong familiarity with cost and reporting tools.
* Strong understanding of EPC, design\-build, and FIDIC\-based contract environments.
* Ability to analyze complex data and provide strategic recommendations to project leadership.
* Strong leadership and team management capability.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Ability to work in a high\-profile, multicultural, and fast\-paced delivery environment.
* Strong report\-writing and presentation skills for senior executive audiences.


 Systra is an equal opportunities company; this position is open to all applicants.

data.jd_text:

Growth at Inverto is shared growth\-opening new opportunities for our clients, our business, and our teams.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 The Business \& Operations Senior Manager drives the effective operationalization of Inverto’s regional growth agenda by leading key commercial, people, financial, and operational processes for the Middle East.
   

  

 Acting as a strategic partner to Inverto leadership and EMESA teams, the role ensures transparency in business development activities, enables strong go\-to\-market execution, and supports high\-quality decision\-making through robust performance and financial management. It plays a central role in shaping and sustaining talent and team development, driving a cohesive and high\-performing culture, and ensuring optimal staffing and resource allocation.
   

  

 The position also safeguards operational excellence by strengthening cross\-functional collaboration with BCG Core and Inverto EMESA, ensuring reliable data flow, and securing compliance with governance, legal, and internal standards. Additionally, it oversees local office operations and orchestrates shared services and marketing initiatives to enable seamless delivery and reinforce Inverto’s brand presence in the region.
   

  

 A key aspect of the role is ensuring alignment between BCG core and Inverto\-specific requirements, in accordance with Inverto’s global guardrails, and business model.
   

  

 Overall, the role is critical in enabling the Middle East business to operate effectively, grow sustainably, and achieve its strategic objectives.

* Lead Management and GTM support

* Drive optimal team deployment and resource allocation in close collaboration with the Inverto EMESA team, ensuring sustained delivery capacity and alignment with business needs

* Collaborate with Finance teams to steer annual strategic and financial planning processes, ensuring alignment between functional priorities and financial targets
* Ensure rigorous budgeting, forecasting, and financial reporting, translating data into insights and recommendations for senior leadership
* Liaise with Inverto and BCG Finance teams to ensure accurate cost accounting and P\&L management against Plan
* Support Inverto Commercial Finance in maintaining full transparency of the project portfolio, enabling informed decision\-making on performance and risk management
* Collaboration \& Data flow

* Ensure reliable information and data flow between Inverto Middle East and Inverto EMESA, including oversight of non\-automated processes and adherence to data governance standards

* Ensure compliance with legal standards and internal policies, implementing effective local controls and maintaining transparency on regulatory updates
* Establish processes to systematically gather and synthesize up\-to\-date information on relevant compliance regulations

* Oversee day\-to\-day office operations of the Inverto team and act as a key point of contact for internal and external stakeholders, ensuring smooth and efficient business operations
* Coordinate shared services and functions (e.g., HR, Recruiting, IT) with BCG where applicable, optimizing processes to support local delivery

 Bachelors or Masters degree with an above\-average grade.
   

  

 8\+ years of relevant experience within business operations
   

  

 Confident presence in an international environment, business fluent in English.

 Reporting to the Inverto Managing Director
   

  

 Working with global, regional and local teams
   

  

 Hyper motivated individuals
   

  

 Entrepreneurs and those that have a growth mindset
   

  

 Teammates that are authentic by nature, they thrive to support the team to win

**Description**
**Job Purpose:**
 To manage the overall complete company financial and operational performance of the respective areas of responsibility as per the guidelines given by Chief Executive Officer. To ensure strict adherence to the scope of work detailed in the terms and conditions of the contract under the individual’s management. Ensure that strict cost control systems are established in all departments in the operation, and that they are constantly maintained and monitored. To ensure that storage and stock control systems are maintained up to date, and to monitor stock rotation and validity. To ensure that company and Client owned assets and equipment are maintained in good order, and that repair/replenishment costs are strictly controlled.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities And Duties**
* To ensure that the contract is operated within the budgetary margins established for the operation.
* To maintain constant liaison with the Client representative for the individual’s operation and establish a good working relationship.
* To monitor ordering of all supplies/requirements both internally on site and from the supplier.
* To ensure that validity of all employee documentation, e.g. security passes, medical certificates, licenses, vacations where applicable, are maintained and that timely action is taken for renewal that will not adversely affect the individual’s operation.
* To ensure employee time sheets are correctly filled in and that they are forwarded to Head Office on time each month.
* To liaise with Training Department for Staff Trainings.
* To conduct job training on the individual’s operations.
* To carry out annual evaluations of staff. Make recommendations for employee promotions, salary changes, employee of the month, disciplinary action, including termination where applicable.
* To ensure that employees are aware of the company policies and procedures and to ensure compliance.
* To ensure that the individual is aware of the contents of the KSA labor Law, and its stipulations regarding disciplinary action in particular.
* To ensure that leave schedules are maintained, and that requests for relievers are submitted to CEO at least two months in advance.
* To ensure strict confidentiality of all company financial information regardless of its nature.
* To compile and submit to CEO monthly reports on all aspects of the operations that should highlight any problems encountered and actions taken to rectify them.
* This report should cover maintenance activities, including both planned and reactive tasks, which are completed within required timeframes, on\-going or new projects information, supplier communications and enhancement schemes for the cost\-effective management of services.
* To ensure that copies of all Client correspondence, minutes of site meetings and any other communication (verbal or written) pertained to the operation are transmitted to the CEO immediately upon acknowledgment.
* The CEO must review on all offers to the Client prior to submittal. Site Engineers, where applicable, must be involved in offers pertaining to anything within the individual’s discipline.
* To ensure that company and Client owned assets and equipment are maintained in good order, and that repair/replenishment costs are strictly controlled. CEO must be informed of any major R\&M activity.
* To ensure that highest standards of health, hygiene and safety are maintained in the individual’s operation and to liaise closely with the company’s CEO on these matters.
* Closely monitor the performance of all the department heads.
* Adhere to the safety regulations set by the company as well as the Client.

* Comfortable operating in fast\-paced environments with ambiguity and evolving priorities

 Context
   

  

***This requirement is for a bid opportunity only at this stage. Any engagement will be subject to successful project award and final client approval.***

data.jd_text:
**Job Summary**
 As part of the Telco Services team at Red Hat, the Project Manager is an integral part of a delivery\-focused organization responsible for planning and executing professional services engagements across the telecom sector in the Middle East and Africa region. We work with geographically distributed customers, partners, and internal teams spanning Sales, Delivery, Engineering, Finance, and Legal. As a Project Manager, you are the subject matter expert in project management standards and practices, applying your skills and experience to drive delivery excellence and foster collaboration across all engagement stakeholders. You help motivate teams, drive accountability on commitments and deliverables, and support continuous improvement in how we deliver.
   

  

 We’re looking for a Project Manager to join our Telco Services team. As part of our team, you’ll partner with customer\-facing and internal organizations within Red Hat to facilitate project delivery and motivate teams to achieve program goals.
   

  

 We’re looking for a leader to steward customer engagements and transformational services delivery by providing clear direction and structure to projects. You’ll be responsible for planning, governance, and overseeing the successful delivery of services engagements across the Telco customer base. You’ll help teams execute efficiently, working as a facilitator and motivator, and set shared milestones. You’ll manage cross\-team collaboration and delivery status across multiple concurrent projects. You’ll communicate with stakeholders at different levels — from customer project leads to internal leadership — to promote collaboration and coordination. You’ll track and report delivery status and monitor achievement of project milestones and commitments.
   

  

 To be considered for this position you must be a Saudi national or be a Premium Residency holder.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Own end\-to\-end project delivery for Telco Services engagements, including scope definition, work planning, milestone tracking, and successful closure
* Maintain steady delivery momentum in complex, fast\-moving telco customer environments with shifting priorities and tight timelines
* Collaborate with delivery architects and consultants to manage customer expectations, requirements, and delivery commitments, yielding consistent results
* Ensure project scope, deliverables, and timelines remain aligned with customer contractual commitments and Red Hat business priorities
* Manage project financials across assigned Telco Services engagements, including revenue recognition tracking, cost monitoring, forecast accuracy, and timely reporting of project P\&L to the Telco Services lead.
* Identify, track, and mitigate project risks and interdependencies across active Telco Services engagements
* Manage stakeholder communication across customer, partner, and internal Red Hat teams; promote transparency and proactive coordination throughout the delivery lifecycle
* Lead cross\-functional meetings and foster teamwork; drive escalation and resolution of issues
* Apply expertise in professional services delivery to support planning, execution, and governance of Telco Services projects and initiatives
* Provide regular delivery status reporting to the Telco Services lead and relevant senior stakeholders, including escalation of risks and blockers
* Develop resourcing strategies to ensure optimum support for projects and for the day\-to\-day operational activities


**What You Will Bring**
* Experience managing a portfolio of large and complex projects
* Thorough understanding of project/program management techniques and methods
* Excellent facilitation and presentation skills
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, and proven ability to work effectively with all organizational levels
* Proven problem\-solving and decision\-making skills
* Effective consultative and influencing approach
* Ability to innovate under new and/or changing conditions
* Ability to succeed in a dynamic matrix organization
* Virtual and remote team leadership capability
* Must have demonstrated leadership ability, business acumen, and industry knowledge
* Strong knowledge of budgeting and resource allocation procedures
* More than 5\+ years of project/program management experience, including large\-scale complex projects, large portfolios OR equivalent management experience
* Experience working with project and portfolio management tools
* Bachelor’s in engineering, computer science, information technology, management or related field (Master’s preferred)
* Project management certification or program management certification are a plus


**About Red Hat**
 Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterprise open source software solutions, using a community\-powered approach to deliver high\-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40\+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in\-office, to office\-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact.
   

  

**Inclusion at Red Hat**
 Red Hat’s culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. When this is realized, it empowers people from different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to come together to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive innovation. Our aspiration is that everyone experiences this culture with equal opportunity and access, and that all voices are not only heard but also celebrated. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)**
 Red Hat is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.
   

  

 Red Hat does not seek or accept unsolicited resumes or CVs from recruitment agencies. We are not responsible for, and will not pay, any fees, commissions, or any other payment related to unsolicited resumes or CVs except as required in a written contract between Red Hat and the recruitment agency or party requesting payment of a fee.
   

  

 Red Hat supports individuals with disabilities and provides reasonable accommodations to job applicants. If you need assistance completing our online job application, email application\-assistance@redhat.com. General inquiries, such as those regarding the status of a job application, will not receive a reply.

**Job Description**
 WSP is seeking an experienced Project Handover \& Closeout Manager to support the successful delivery and transition of large\-scale civil infrastructure projects across Saudi Arabia.
   

  

 This role is critical in ensuring that infrastructure assets are fully completed, compliant, documented, and ready for operational handover to the client. The successful candidate will lead all handover and closeout activities, coordinating between construction teams, contractors, consultants, and client stakeholders.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Handover \& Closeout Management**
* Lead end\-to\-end project handover from construction completion to final client acceptance
* Develop and implement handover strategies, plans, and schedules aligned with project milestones
* Ensure completion of all handover deliverables including as\-built drawings, O\&M manuals, asset registers, and testing/inspection records


**Interface \& Coordination**
* Act as primary interface between construction teams, contractors/subcontractors, and client/end\-users

**Quality \& Compliance**

**Readiness \& Transition**
* Ensure infrastructure is operationally ready including functionality, safety compliance, and usability
* Support smooth transition from construction to operations and formal asset transfer to the client


**Reporting \& Documentation**
* Track and report progress on handover activities, closeout milestones, and key risks/issues
* Maintain structured documentation ensuring traceability and completeness of all closeout records


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering (mandatory)
* Minimum 15\+ years of experience in civil infrastructure projects and construction delivery/execution
* Proven experience in project handover, closeout, or completion phases for large\-scale infrastructure (roads, utilities, tunnels or similar)
* Experience working within PMC, consultancy, or contractor environments
* Strong understanding of construction lifecycle, project delivery, and handover/closeout processes
* Familiarity with inspection processes, testing coordination, and final approvals
* Experience managing multiple contractors and stakeholders on complex infrastructure projects
* Strong stakeholder management and coordination capabilities across multidisciplinary teams
* Ability to manage complex interfaces and resolve project\-related challenges effectively
* Strong problem\-solving skills with high attention to detail
* Excellent communication, reporting, and documentation skills

Mace combines construction expertise with consultancy to unlock potential in every person or project and redefine the boundaries of ambition. Our values shape the way we consult and define the people we want to join us on our journey.
   

  

**The Project**
 This is an opportunity to work on one of the largest programmes in Saudi Arabia. This unique project consists of major mixed\-use development including sports facilities, entertainment and arts along with all associated infrastructure.
   

  

 The Recovery Director shall be responsible for leading and driving the recovery of a distressed or underperforming project through the proactive monitoring, management and coordination of the Main Contractor, subcontractors, consultants and associated stakeholders.
   

  

 The role is focused on restoring confidence in project delivery by implementing robust planning, progress monitoring, resource management, coordination, reporting and recovery initiatives to ensure achievement of contractual milestones, sectional completion dates, operational readiness requirements and overall project completion.
   

  

**You'll Be Responsible For**
* Review and assess the contractor’s baseline programme, recovery programme, critical path, sequencing and milestone strategy.
* Monitor progress against approved schedules, contractual milestones, and recovery targets. Identify delays, productivity issues, logic deficiencies, coordination failures and resource constraints impacting delivery.
* Develop, implement, and monitor project recovery and mitigation strategies. Validate programme updates, look\-ahead schedules and recovery initiatives submitted by the contractor.
* Monitor contractor and subcontractor performance across all disciplines and work fronts. Identify underperforming subcontractors and recommend corrective actions or replacement strategies where required.
* Ensure subcontractor interfaces, work sequencing and trade coordination are effectively managed.
* Chair and lead recovery, coordination and performance meetings.
* Monitor workface availability, access constraints, design impacts, procurement delays, testing and commissioning readiness and authority approvals.
* Coordinate with consultants, designers, contractors, operators and authorities to remove obstacles to delivery.
* Support assessment of recovery\-related costs, acceleration measures and mitigation proposals.
* Provide input into contractual notifications relating to delays, non\-performance, or recovery obligations.
* Monitor impacts to sectional completion, taking over milestones, operational readiness and stakeholder interfaces.


**You’ll Need To Have**
* Degree qualified in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, or related discipline.
* Minimum 15\+ years’ experience in large\-scale construction and project delivery.
* Strong understanding of Primavera P6, critical path analysis, recovery planning, construction sequencing, testing and commissioning, operational readiness and contract administration.
* Demonstrated experience managing contractors and subcontractors on large multidisciplinary projects.
* Experience within hospitality, entertainment, infrastructure, or giga\-project environments preferred.
* Experience within delivery partner / PMC environments preferred.
* Necessary visa criteria for the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and have relevant work experience working on high valued projects/programmes for a project management consultancy business, which are required for immigration and client approval.


**Our values**
**Safety first \- Going home safe and well:** 
 We champion a safe, diverse, and inclusive working environment, understanding the importance of well\-being in every team.
   

  

**Client focus \- Deliver on our promise:** 
 We own the quality of deliverables and strategic outcomes and build long\-term relationships with our clients.
   

  

**Integrity \- Always do the right thing:** 
 We influence positive outcomes within our industry while always aligning with our compliance obligations.
   

  

**Create opportunity \- For our people to excel:** 
 We champion a continuous improvement culture throughout all activities, inspiring our people and teams to develop.
   

  

 Mace is an inclusive employer and welcomes interest from a diverse range of candidates. Even if you feel you do not fulfill all the criteria, please apply, as you may still be the best candidate for this role or another role within our organisation.
   

  

 We are also open to discussing part\-time, flexible and hybrid working options if suitable within the role.

data.jd_text:
James L Williams Middle East is seeking an experienced and proactive
 **Project HSE Manager** 
 to join our Projects team and lead Health, Safety \& Environmental (HSE) operations across major construction projects.
   

  

 This role is responsible for ensuring the successful implementation of project HSE strategies, fostering a strong safety culture, and maintaining compliance with company standards, client requirements, and regulatory obligations throughout the project lifecycle.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Manage and oversee all Health, Safety \& Environmental (HSE) activities across designated project(s), ensuring compliance with the JLW Health, Safety \& Environmental Management System (HSEMS).
* Ensure compliance with company HSE policies, procedures, safe work procedures, client\-specific HSE requirements, and applicable legislation.
* Develop and implement project safe systems of work, environmental procedures, and support the preparation of Project HSE Plans.
* Review HSE manuals, method statements, work permit procedures, safety equipment requirements, and other HSE documentation to ensure compliance with established standards.
* Lead and participate in the investigation of project accidents and incidents, ensuring reports are prepared and corrective and preventive actions are implemented.
* Direct and coordinate the activities of the Project HSE team, ensuring effective implementation of HSE requirements across all project activities.
* Work closely with Project Management, Clients, Project HSE Officers, and QA/QC teams to establish, implement, and maintain HSE procedures and documentation.
* Promote HSE awareness across the project by developing a positive safety culture through training, communication, and engagement initiatives.
* Prepare and maintain project HSE records, statistics, reports, and performance data.
* Assess subcontractors' and suppliers' compliance with project HSE requirements and monitor their performance against approved Risk Assessment and Method Statements (RAMS).
* Support project management in preparing project\-specific HSE procedures, method statements, and risk assessments.
* Plan and conduct HSE inspections and audits, prepare reports, and monitor the timely closure of corrective actions.
* Prepare and coordinate project HSE training plans and oversee HSE Awards and Recognition Programs.
* Monitor the implementation of ESSW manuals and procedures during testing and commissioning activities to ensure compliance with project HSE requirements.


**Requirements**
* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Science, or a related discipline. Alternatively, Level 5/6 Diploma in Occupational Health \& Safety.
* Minimum 8–10 years of experience in HSE management within MEP and construction projects.
* Mandatory NEBOSH General Certificate (GC/IGC).
* Fully conversant with HSE Digital Management Systems and Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Access, PowerPoint).
* Strong knowledge of HSE Management Systems, risk assessments, safe systems of work, and HSE procedures.
* Experience in leading project HSE teams, inspections, audits, and incident investigations.
* Strong communication, interpersonal, and leadership skills.
* Ability to develop and implement HSEMS standard operating procedures.
* Valid driving license (mandatory).

Join Qiddiya Investment Company as a
 **Director \- Risk** 
 , where you'll play a vital role in our development management team meeting initiatives across various projects in the dynamic hospitality sector. In this exciting position, you will be instrumental in establishing and maintaining robust risk registers and reports that support sound decision\-making and strategic objectives across our diverse projects.
   

  

 The
 **Director \- Risk** 
 will be responsible for developing, implementing, and overseeing comprehensive risk management strategies that align with the company's objectives, particularly in the context of large\-scale development and construction projects. This role requires a deep understanding of risk management across various stages of project development, including planning and construction. The Director will ensure that risks are proactively identified, assessed, mitigated, and monitored to protect the Qiddiya's interests and ensure successful project delivery.
   

  

**Essential duties and responsibilities:**
* Establish the Qiddiya Program risk management framework, procedures, templates and processes, and seek continuous improvement
* Oversee the identification and assessment of risks associated with real estate development and construction projects, including financial, operational, technical, and legal risks
* Conduct regular risk assessments and scenario analyses for ongoing and future projects to understand potential exposures
* Ensure risk registers and databases are accurately maintained and regularly updated
* Design and implement risk mitigation strategies for high\-impact risks, ensuring corrective actions are taken to minimize or eliminate risk exposure
* Work closely with project teams to ensure risk management practices are embedded in project execution
* Lead regular risk reporting including the development of key risk indicators (KRIs) to monitor the risk profile of project
* Ensure that risks are tracked and reported through all phases of project lifecycles and that any emerging risks are promptly escalated
* Provide periodic updates and insights on evolving risks and potential future threats to project success
* Lead and mentor the risk management team, promoting a culture of continuous learning and improvements
* Provide the leadership to guide the Qiddiya Program and Portfolios in implementing the risk management plan
* Lead implementation of the Program and Project(s) risk management plan and produce Portfolio and Project Risk Register(s)
* Lead creation of the Program Risk Register and Program Risk Dashboard and other reports as may be specified, or ad hoc reports as required
* Ensure that the appropriate risk data is captured and that risk assessments are carried out on all aspects of the Qiddiya Program and Projects
* Provide leadership to ensure that risk treatments are identified, and effective monitoring and review processes are undertaken across the Qiddiya Program and Projects
* Implement the necessary training and provide support to the Qiddiya Program and Project team(s)
* Identify changes to the risk profile, personnel, the work, or the work environment that may change the effectiveness of risk treatments
* Monitor compliance against best practice standards and codes across the Qiddiya Program, including auditing the risk management plans, procedures and processes of the Executive Portfolios and assessing Risk Maturity in each area
* Review and approve Quantitative Risk modelling, including the Quantitative Schedule Risk Analysis (QSRA) and Quantitative Cost Risk Analysis (QCRA) reports
* Collaborate with project teams to integrate risk controls into project plans, schedules, and budgets


**Requirements**
**Qualifications**
 Bachelor's degree in risk management, construction management, Business Studies, Finance or another relevant field.
   

  

**Professional Certifications**
 Professional certification such as Chartered Risk Analyst (CRA), certified Risk Management Professional (CEMP), or Project Management Professional (PMP) are preferred
   

  

**Years Of Experience**
 10\-15 years' experience in risk management with significant experience in real estate development, construction, or large\-scale infrastructure projects including at least 5 years in mega project construction/ development.
   

  

 Proven track record of successfully implementing risk management strategies at the senior level.
   

  

**Skills**
 Strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to influence and guide project teams.
   

  

 Analytical and strategic thinker with a proactive approach to risk management.
   

  

 In\-depth knowledge of risk management tools, frameworks, and regulatory requirements specific to construction and development projects.
   

  

 Ability to work under pressure, manage competing priorities, and meet tight deadlines.
   

  

**Competencies**
 Strong decision\-making and problem\-solving abilities.
   

  

 Effective collaboration and stakeholder management skills.
   

  

 Strategic vision and forward\-thinking risk management approach.
   

  

 Financial acumen and understanding of project financing risks.
   

  

 Working knowledge of Active Risk Management (ARM) software is preferred.

The Opportunity
   

  

 We are seeking an Account Director with expertise in public affairs, government relations, and strategic communications. This professional will have a strong background in policy advocacy, issues management, stakeholder engagement, and project leadership. The successful candidate will join our growing Public Affairs practice in Riyadh, contributing to high\-profile campaigns that align with Saudi Arabia’s Vision 2030 and other national priorities.
   

  

 What we’re looking for:
   

 We are seeking a proactive, high‑performing Public Affairs professional who can operate confidently as both a leader and a team player, a balance widely recognized as essential for effective performance and for driving collective success. You bring the ability to lead with purpose while collaborating seamlessly within a broader team environment, reflecting modern leadership expectations where leaders also act as active players when needed.
   

 You have a strong track record in public affairs, issues management, and strategic communications, with a deep understanding of Saudi Arabia’s regulatory and policy landscape. You excel at building trusted relationships with government stakeholders, clients, and partners, and you bring the judgment and agility required to navigate complex, fast‑moving policy environments. You inspire confidence, elevate team performance, and deliver high‑impact results while growing across sectors and communication channels.
   

 Responsibilities:
   

 \- Design and Lead strategic public affairs programs that shape policy conversations and advance organizational priorities, aligning with the core PA function of directing information and stakeholder engagement.
   

  

 \- Monitor, analyze, and interpret regulatory and policy developments in Saudi Arabia to provide clear, actionable insights aligned with strategic communication goals
   

  

 \- Build and maintain trusted relationships with government entities, industry stakeholders, and partners to support effective issue management and influence public perception.
   

  

 \- Develop integrated communication strategies across traditional media, digital platforms, and stakeholder channels to support credibility and reputation management, consistent with Public Affairs Officer roles.
   

  

 \- Provide strategic counsel on emerging issues, risks, and opportunities, supporting leadership decision‑making and enhancing the organization’s public positioning
   

  

 \- Collaborate closely with cross‑regional teams to ensure alignment between global and regional public affairs priorities, reflecting modern PA team structures and leadership expectations.
   

  

 \- Prepare and oversee the development of briefing materials, policy positions, and stakeholder engagement plans to ensure consistent high‑quality outputs that strengthen the organization’s narrative.
   

  

 \- Support multi‑stakeholder initiatives, events, and advocacy efforts that advance business objectives and reinforce organizational credibility across key audiences.
   

  

 Qualifications
   

 \- Experience: 10\+ years in public affairs, government relations, policy advocacy, or strategic communications, with strong preference for experience navigating Saudi Arabia’s policy and regulatory environment.
   

  

 \- Education: Bachelor’s degree in Public Policy, Political Science, Communications, International Relations, or a related field.
   

  

 \- Language Skills: Full professional fluency in Arabic and English (written and spoken).
   

  

 \- Policy \& Cultural Insight: Deep understanding of Saudi Arabia’s political ecosystem, policymaking processes, government stakeholders, and national initiatives such as Vision 2030\.
   

  

 \- Policy Writing \& Analysis: Strong ability to craft policy positions, briefing notes, and advocacy messaging, backed by sharp analytical skills and the ability to simplify complex issues.
   

  

 \- Leadership: Proven track record leading public affairs teams, managing multi‑market workstreams, and guiding stakeholder engagement strategies.
   

  

 \- Stakeholder \& Media Engagement: Experience engaging with government ministries, regulators, industry bodies, and media; comfortable drafting public statements, managing narratives, and supporting issue management.
   

  

 \- Project \& Issue Management: Ability to manage fast‑moving policy files, coordinate cross‑functional inputs, and deliver high‑quality outputs under pressure.
   

  

 \- Industry Knowledge: Experience working across sectors such as healthcare, technology, energy, transportation, or government sectors is a plus.
   

  

  

 Careers at APCO
   

 Through our recruitment, hiring and retention efforts, APCO is committed to building teams to bring the best possible expertise and robust perspectives to our clients. We embrace differences in experience, viewpoint and ideas, starting with our values and extending to our behaviors, policies and practices. We aim to create a positive work experience and welcoming environment where everyone feels they belong and can thrive.

 The role requires a combination of deep technical sustainability expertise, strong client relationship skills, business development capabilities, and experience leading multidisciplinary teams to deliver complex engagements.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Client Leadership \& Engagement Delivery**
* Lead large\-scale sustainability, ESG, climate, and responsible business transformation engagements.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to senior executives, board members, regulators, and government stakeholders.
* Oversee engagement quality, risk management, commercial performance, and client satisfaction.
* Provide strategic guidance on sustainability strategy, ESG governance, climate risk, decarbonization, sustainability reporting, and related regulatory requirements.


**Business Development \& Growth**
* Drive revenue growth and market expansion for the KSA CCaSS practice.
* Identify, shape, and convert new opportunities across public and private sector clients.
* Lead proposal development, RFP responses, and strategic pursuits.
* Build and strengthen relationships with key client stakeholders and alliance partners.
* Contribute to account planning and cross\-service line collaboration.


**Technical Leadership**
 The Director will be expected to lead and support services across areas including:
   

  

* Sustainability and ESG strategy
* Climate change and decarbonization
* Sustainability reporting and assurance
* ESG governance and operating models
* Sustainable finance and responsible investment
* Impact assessment and measurement
* Environmental and social advisory programs


 These focus areas align with EY CCaSS solution clusters including Sustainability Advisory, Climate \& Decarbonization, Environment, Health \& Safety (EHS), and Sustainability Reporting \& Assurance.
   

  

**Team Leadership**
* Coach, mentor, and develop managers and senior managers.
* Contribute to recruitment, talent development, and performance management activities.
* Build a high\-performing sustainability team in line with EY's growth ambitions in Saudi Arabia.
* Promote collaboration across MENA and global sustainability teams.


**Thought Leadership**
* Represent EY at industry events, client workshops, and conferences.
* Contribute to market insights, thought leadership publications, and sustainability research.
* Support the development of innovative sustainability solutions aligned with evolving market needs.


**Requirements**
**Experience**
* 12–15\+ years of relevant professional experience.
* Significant experience in sustainability, ESG, climate change, public sector transformation, strategy consulting, environmental advisory, or related fields.
* Proven track record leading complex consulting engagements and managing senior client relationships.
* Demonstrated business development and sales experience with responsibility for revenue generation.


**Education**
* Bachelor's degree in Sustainability, Environmental Sciences, Engineering, Economics, Business, Public Policy, Finance, or a related discipline.
* Master's degree preferred.
* Professional sustainability credentials (GRI, ISSB, SASB/FSA, TCFD, GHG Protocol, CFA ESG, LEED, etc.) are desirable.


**Key Skills**
* Sustainability strategy and ESG transformation
* Climate risk and decarbonization
* Program and project leadership
* Government and public sector experience
* Executive stakeholder management
* Commercial acumen and market development
* Proposal and pursuit leadership
* Team leadership and coaching
* Strong communication and presentation skills
* Arabic and English proficiency preferred


**What We Are Looking For**
 We are seeking a commercially minded sustainability leader who combines deep technical expertise with the ability to develop client relationships, identify growth opportunities, and build high\-performing teams. The successful candidate will be a market\-facing leader capable of supporting EY's continued expansion across Saudi Arabia's sustainability and transformation agenda.

data.title: Associate Director, Business Development, Saudi Arabia
data.raw_snippet: Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how mi
data.jd_text:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI\-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting\-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Anduril's Middle East team delivers cutting\-edge platforms, software\-first systems, and integrated effects from across Anduril's portfolio to regional customers, with the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA) serving as our primary growth anchor. The team adapts and applies Anduril's core hardware and software products to serve the unique national security and defense requirements of Saudi Arabia and the broader GCC. As this team rapidly expands its footprint in Riyadh, this role requires an applicant willing to take on diverse responsibilities. The Business Development (BD) team is responsible for identifying, shaping, capturing, and growing new opportunities and capabilities for the company. BD team members serve as the bridge between Saudi defense stakeholders and the broader Anduril team; they convey local operational requirements to our global enterprise while serving as the Anduril brand ambassador in\-Kingdom. They partner extensively with engineering and program management to ensure Anduril products exceed regional mission demands and align with KSA’s defense modernization goals.
   

  

**About The Job**
 We are looking for an Associate Director, Business Development (BD) based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, to identify, shape, and capture opportunities to grow revenue within the Kingdom and the wider region. You will serve as the critical link between Saudi defense prospects/clients and our global product teams, translating local operational needs into the Product and Engineering pipelines to ensure Anduril’s suite of autonomous systems meets the Kingdom’s security demands. This role requires a high degree of initiative, localized cultural fluency, and a deep understanding of Saudi procurement. You will have direct ownership of shaping, capturing, and executing business development opportunities in alignment with Saudi Vision 2030 defense localization objectives.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Find, pursue and close business within Saudi Arabia. This will involve extensive travel within the Kingdom, high\-level engagement at regional defense exhibitions (such as the World Defense Show), and deep responsibility for navigating KSA budget cycles and ministerial approval processes. Success will be achieved by developing deep relationships within the Ministry of Defense (MoD), Ministry of National Guard (MNG), Ministry of Interior (MoI), and presidency forces. You will monitor local buying cycles, lead specific proposal and capture efforts, and generate highly targeted growth strategies based on KSA’s threat landscape and strategic priorities.
* Develop capture strategies. Provide cohesive business plans and execution models that outline acquisition paths, create clear alignment to Saudi investment strategies, and drive towards programs of record. Success will be achieved by engaging key stakeholders—including the General Authority for Military Industries (GAMI) and Saudi Arabian Military Industries (SAMI)—to shape requirements, secure relevant funding, and develop localized industrialization and supplier strategies for competitive captures.
* Drive product adoption and program transition. Anduril thrives by developing new technologies for our clients' most pressing operational challenges, particularly in UAS, Counter\-UAS, and border security. You will drive the transition of nascent concepts into KSA operations through early\-stage pilot programs, field trials, and collaborative R\&D. Internally, you are charged with translating Saudi defense challenges back into our engineering organization, ensuring our product suite remains best\-in\-class for the region’s unique desert and maritime operating environments.
* Grow existing business. While the primary role is capturing new business, you will represent all Business Lines across Anduril's portfolio. You will partner with local execution teams, joint venture partners, and product engineers to scale our footprint with existing Saudi clients. This involves not only expanding current contracts but leveraging established relationships to explore new capabilities, sensor integrations, and localized software\-defined command and control (C2\) solutions.
* Communicate our value to clients. BD team members are brand ambassadors who represent Anduril to Saudi decision\-makers, local industrial partners, and the regional public. You must project the company's ethos, clearly communicating our software\-first approach, speed of innovation, and competitive edge in localized co\-production and technology transfer.


**Required Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of business development, military operational, or strategic sales experience interfacing directly with Saudi government decision\-makers (i.e. MoD, MNG, MoI, security forces), with deep expertise in GAMI regulations, localization mandates, and Saudi procurement processes.
* The ideal candidate will be a proven growth leader with prior experience in commercial or defense capture and sales within the Kingdom, demonstrating a track record of building, executing, and winning defense contracts under Saudi Vision 2030 guidelines.Prior acquisition or operational experience in\-Kingdom, with a strong understanding of Saudi Arabia’s strategic security priorities and threat environment.
* An aptitude and appetite to thrive within organizations with nascent structure, high\-ownership culture, and a "whatever it takes" environment.
* A knack for knocking out deliverables in an ambiguous environment, while maintaining a level\-head, strong interpersonal skills, and the cultural gravitas required to navigate senior\-level Saudi defense environments.
* Excellent writing and communication skills with experience briefing senior military commanders and executive leadership.
* Bachelor's degree from an accredited university.
* Ability to travel 50%\-75% (predominantly within KSA and the Middle East, with occasional travel to US HQs).
* Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S., Canada, U.K., Australia, New Zealand, or Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA) government security clearance.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience shaping and leading capture efforts directly involving SAMI (Saudi Arabian Military Industries) or local Saudi defense\-industrial partners.
* Prior experience working with Foreign Military Sales (FMS), Direct Commercial Sales (DCS), and Saudi direct commercial procurement, including navigating ITAR, licensing, and technology releasability.
* Demonstrated knowledge of KSA defense modernization programs, with a history of zero\-to\-one program growth in the Middle East.
* Demonstrated high\-energy, high\-ownership individual who will drive performance and exhibit strong management skills with a high level of emotional intelligence and cultural awareness. Must be able to work in a fast\-paced, highly entrepreneurial environment, and adapt global technologies to the local market.
* Riyadh\-based or willing to permanently relocate to Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
* Currently has and is able to maintain an active U.S., Canada, U.K., Australia, New Zealand or Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA) security clearance.
* Strong bilingual communication skills; fluency in both written and spoken Arabic and English.


**Benefits**
 The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top\-tier benefits for full\-time employees, including:
   

  

 At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next.
 *For more information, Explore Our Benefits.*
**Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams**
 Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.
   

  

 To Ensure Your Safety And Help You Navigate Your Job Search With Confidence, Please Keep The Following Critical Points In Mind
   

  

* No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.
* Please always verify communications:
+ Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
+ Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

* Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.
* What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.


**Data Privacy**
 To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant\-privacy\-notice/.
   

  

 By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third\-party service provider to conduct pre\-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third\-party service provider provides risk\-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public\-record information, and other lawful open\-source or commercial data sources. This third\-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.
