**Why Join Us?** 




 At Rosewood Doha, we create an environment where passion meets purpose – and where careers have meaning.
 



 Guided by our philosophy of Relationship Hospitality and our culture of Make the Place, we believe in enriching lives, starting with yours. We empower you to bring your true self, grow with confidence, curate the extraordinary and leave your legacy.
 



 You’ll be part of a diverse, inclusive and supportive community that invests in your development, celebrates achievements and inspires you to Discover Your Calling.
 



 Together, we push boundaries, explore the uncharted and shape the future of luxury lifestyle experiences.
 



**About Rosewood Doha:** 




 Rosewood Doha is a landmark destination inspired by Qatar’s coral reefs, bringing together ultra\-luxury hospitality, residential living, culinary experiences, holistic wellness, differentiated retail and events within one integrated ecosystem. The property includes a 155\-key hotel, 162 serviced apartments and 276 private residences, alongside a diverse collection of restaurants and lounges, expansive event spaces and curated lifestyle experiences. Our destination also houses Asaya, Qatar’s first members\-only social wellness club, complemented by Rosewood’s signature Manor Club for Club Room and Suite guests.
 



 Since opening in July of 2025, Rosewood Doha has been recognized with multiple international and regional accolades, including distinctions from the Michelin Guide, Forbes Travel Guide and Qatar Tourism \- reflecting the scale, ambition and standards of excellence behind the destination. As part of the global Rosewood Hotels \& Resorts portfolio, the property represents a new generation of luxury that goes beyond traditional hospitality into lifestyle, community and experience\-driven destinations.
 



**Our Associate Experience:** 




 We believe exceptional work deserves exceptional care. At Rosewood Doha, we offer a thoughtfully designed associate experience that supports your wellbeing, growth and life beyond work. This includes:
 



 \-
 
     
 
 A competitive salary and benefits package
 



 \-
 
     
 
 High\-quality associate accommodation in prime locations in the heart of Lusail and the Pearl
 



 \-
 
     
 
 A birthday day off (because your milestones matter!)
 



 \-
 
     
 
 Personalized development plans and continuous learning opportunities to support your career journey
 



 These benefits reflect our commitment to creating an environment where you thrive – professionally and personally – while building a meaningful career with us.
 



**Your Role:** 




 Guest Satisfaction:
 


* Ensures that all associates deliver the brand promise and provide exceptional guest service at all times.
* Ensures that associates also provide excellent service to internal customers in other divisions as appropriate.
* Spends time in public areas observing associate\-guest interaction and talking with guests, works through Department Heads to coach associates in guest service skills as necessary.
* Ensures that all guest and internal customer complaints are resolved in a quick and efficient manner.
* Maintains positive guest and colleague interactions with good working relationships.



 Finance / Administration:
 


* Maximizes associate productivity using multi\-skilling, multi\-tasking and flexible scheduling to meet the financial goals of the business as well as the expectations of the guests.
* Ensures that each profit center (e.g. Outlet, Bar, Events) is operated in line with maximizing profit while delivering on the brand promise.
* Ensures that each cost center operates with the lowest possible cost structure while also delivering on the brand promise to the guest.
* Assists in the preparation of the Annual Business Plan for Food and Beverage.
* Assists in the monthly reforecast, involves the respective Department Heads as appropriate.
* Manages costs proactively based on key performance indicators, works with the respective Department Heads as appropriate.
* Ensures that all hotel, company and local rules, policies and regulations relating to financial record keeping, money handling and licensing are adhered to.
* Assists in the inventory management and ongoing maintenance of hotel operating equipment and other assets. In particular, high use assets such as chinaware, glassware and flatware.
* Participates in weekly yield and revenue management meetings actively, oversees the appropriate pricing structures to maximize yield and overall profits in Restaurants and Events.
* Responsible for control of beverage program including recipes, inventory, and progressive menu development.
* Reviews uniform replacement schedule as well as coordinating upgrade reviews with Director of Food and Beverage.
* Oversees the preparation, reviews and updates individual Departmental Operations Manuals.
* Conducts annual performance development discussions with key Food and Beverage associates and supports them in their professional development goals. Ensures that they in turn conduct annual performance development discussions with their associates.
* Assists in the development of departmental training through ongoing feedback and monthly feedback and meetings.
* Ensures that each department head plans and implements effective training programs for their associates in coordination with the Training Manager and their Departmental Trainers
* Conducts regular divisional communications meetings and ensures that departmental briefings and meetings are effective and conducted as necessary.
* Ensures the smooth operation of the Food \& Beverage division in the absence of the Director of F\&B.
* Collaborates with the culinary division as necessary, ensuring operational requirements are met and providing reasons as needed.



 Marketing:
 


* Assists in the preparation, utilization, and update of the Annual Marketing Plan, broken down as necessary by department.
* Evaluates local, national, and international market trends, vendors and other hotel/restaurant operations constantly to make sure that the hotel’s operations remain competitive and cutting edge.
* Encourages Department Heads to look for Marketing and Public Relations opportunities to increase awareness and ultimately business.
* Ensures that the Food and Beverage activities are aligned with the respective Corporate Strategy, and that the Hotel actions have been implemented where appropriate.



 Operations:
 


* Ensures that all company minimum brand standards have been implemented, and that optional brand standards have been implemented where appropriate.
* Monitors all operations, especially during peak business periods, working through the respective Department Head to adjust where necessary.
* Ensures that all Food and Beverage Fundamentals are introduced, implemented, and consistently maintained.
* Ensures that the Food and Beverage Division responds to the results of the Consumer Audit and to ensure that the relevant changes are implemented.
* Works closely with other Executive Committee members in a supportive and flexible manner, focusing on the overall success of the hotel and the satisfaction of hotel guests.
* Ensures that Food and Beverage associates work in a supportive and flexible manner with other departments, in the spirit of “We work through Teams”.
* Ensures that all associates are up to date with the availability of seasonal and new products on the market.
* Tastes and monitors the food and beverage products served throughout the operation, provides feedback where appropriate.
* Oversees the punctuality and appearance of all Food and Beverage associates, making sure that they wear the correct uniform and maintain a high standard of personal appearance and hygiene, according to the hotel and department’s grooming standards.
* Maintains and assists in outlets during the absence of respective managers.

data.jd_text:
Akura Medical, a Shifamed portfolio company, is advancing a differentiated platform for the treatment of venous thromboembolism (VTE), which affects up to 900,000 Americans each year. The company recently received US IDE approval for its QUADRA\-PE study evaluating the Katana™ Thrombectomy System in acute pulmonary embolism patients. In parallel, Akura Medical is developing NavIQ™, a software platform that transforms CT angiograms into 3D pulmonary vascular models to enhance visualization, procedural planning, and clot assessment towards better safety, efficacy, and ease of use. Akura has recently completed a $53 million first close of its Series C financing, led by the Qatar Investment Authority, supporting the launch of a joint venture and a new R\&D and manufacturing center in Doha, Qatar.
 



  





**About Shifamed** 




 Founded in 2009 by serial entrepreneur Amr Salahieh, Shifamed LLC is a privately held medical device innovation hub focused on the development of novel medical products to address clinical needs in the rapidly evolving fields of cardiology and ophthalmology.
 



  





 Description:
 



 This position is responsible for the development, implementation, and management of quality systems and practices. This position will oversee and ensure that the development, manufacture, testing and release of products are performed according to the applicable federal and state regulations, international standards, and the Company’s Quality Policy.
 



  





 Responsibilities, Skills \& Hands\-On Experience:
 


* Ensure compliance with applicable Quality System Regulations and standards, including FDA QSR, ISO 13485, MDR, GMP, and Design Controls.
* Partner with R\&D and Operations to establish and maintain quality requirements throughout product development, transfer, manufacturing, and post\-market activities.
* Lead and maintain Design History Files (DHF), Risk Management Files, and associated quality documentation for products and processes.
* Develop and implement quality engineering activities including design verification/validation, process validation, equipment qualification, test method validation, and first article inspections.
* Support manufacturing quality activities including inspection processes, nonconformance investigations, CAPA, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Develop, maintain, and oversee manufacturing and quality documentation including procedures, inspection instructions, Lot History Records, and Bills of Materials.
* Manage supplier quality activities including supplier qualification, audits, source inspections, supplier controls, and ongoing quality performance monitoring.
* Prepare for, host, and support internal, customer, supplier, and regulatory audits and inspections.
* Coordinate quality system training and promote company\-wide quality system awareness and compliance.
* Support complaint handling, MDR/vigilance reporting, field actions, and investigation of product or process failures.
* Serve as Quality representative on cross\-functional project teams and act as site Management Representative and/or Quality signature authority as required.
* Lead and manage Quality Assurance resources to ensure effective execution of quality system and regulatory compliance activities.
* Other duties as assigned.



  





 Education \& Work Experience:
 


* Bachelors or Masters in Engineering or scientific discipline, or equivalent relevant work experience
* 15\+ years of Quality or Technical Management experience in the medical device industry or a related field.
* Previous direct people management experience.
* Previous experience bringing a company into regulatory compliance and approval, preferred.
* Solid knowledge of FDA regulations and interpretation of FDA regulations, guidelines, and policy statements.
* Solid knowledge of international regulations, standards, and guidelines (i.e. MDR, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, IEC 60601 and collateral standards, IEC 62304, IEC 62366, FDA guidance documents for cybersecurity).
* Ability to train others in processes and procedures.
* Excellent communications skills (both written and verbal) required.
* Ability to work effectively across functional lines to reach effective outcomes for the business.
* Ability to travel as required.



  





 Our salary ranges are calculated by role, level, and location. Please note that your position within that range will be determined by your job\-related knowledge, location, skills, experience, relevant education, and training/certifications.
 



  





 NOTICE TO CANDIDATES: Please be aware that Shifamed and its portfolio companies do not conduct interviews or extend offers through mobile web chat applications. Please report any such occurrences to hr@shifamed.com.

data.jd_text:
The
 **Airfield Driving Program Manager** 
 is responsible for planning, implementing, and overseeing the Airfield Driving Program (ADP) at Al Udeid Air Base. This role ensures the safe, compliant, and effective operation of vehicles and equipment on the airfield in accordance with U.S. Air Force, DoD, host\-nation, and installation\-specific regulations. The manager serves as the primary subject matter expert (SME) for airfield driving operations and provides leadership, training oversight, and compliance management for all authorized airfield drivers.
   

  

**Essential Job Functions**
* Lead and manage the installation Airfield Driving Program in accordance with applicable Air Force Instructions (AFIs), DoD directives, and local operating procedures.
* Serve as the primary point of contact and subject matter expert for all airfield driving matters.
* Develop, maintain, and enforce airfield driving policies, procedures, and standard operating instructions (SOIs).
* Oversee airfield driving training, testing, certification, and licensing processes for military, civilian, and contractor personnel.
* Coordinate closely with Airfield Management, Safety, Security Forces, Wing Safety, and host\-nation partners to ensure safe airfield operations.
* Conduct periodic program reviews, audits, and inspections to ensure compliance and identify risk mitigation measures.
* Investigate airfield driving incidents, violations, and mishaps; prepare reports and recommend corrective actions.
* Maintain accurate records of driver qualifications, training, suspensions, revocations, and reinstatements.
* Advise leadership on airfield driving trends, hazards, and best practices.
* Supervise and mentor assigned staff or instructors supporting the Airfield Driving Program.
* Ensure compliance with force protection, safety, and operational risk management (ORM) principles.


**Education \& Experience**
* High School Diploma or equivalent.
* Minimum of 1 year of experience as a licensed airfield driver with no previous record or revocations.
* Strong knowledge of airfield layouts, markings, lighting, signage, and controlled movement areas.
* Proven ability to interpret and apply Air Force and DoD aviation regulations and guidance.


**Additional Requirements**
* Must possess a valid U.S. Driver’s License
* Possess a valid U.S. Passport (preferred)
* Must be able to meet all current USCENTCOM Deployment Policy Requirements, as outlined in the USCENTCOM APR 23 MOD EIGHTEEN TO USCENTCOM INDIVIDUAL AND INDIVIDUAL\-UNIT DEPLOYMENT POLICY
* Able to obtain and maintain a valid Residency Visa for Qatar
* Must be able to work in extreme environmental conditions including dust and high temperatures.
* Must be able to endure long hours, exposure to weather and hazardous conditions.


**TRAVEL:** 
 100%, in deployed location.
   

  

**SECURITY CLEARANCE:** 
 Must have and maintain a DoD Secret Clearance.

Role Summary
 



  





 The Service Delivery Manager (SDM) is responsible for leading the end\-to\-end delivery of Enterprise ICT Managed Services, ensuring operational excellence, contractual SLA/KPI achievement, customer satisfaction, and continual service improvement within a 24x7 mission\-critical environment. The role is accountable for service governance, service assurance, operational performance, executive stakeholder management, and the leadership of multidisciplinary technical teams.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



  




* Lead the delivery of Enterprise ICT Managed Services in accordance with contractual SLAs, KPIs, and operational governance frameworks.
* Manage end\-to\-end Service Delivery, Incident Management, Major Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, and Continual Service Improvement (CSI).
* Ensure operational excellence across Network Operations, Service Assurance, Field Operations, and Technical Support functions.
* Drive service performance, operational efficiency, customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Act as the primary escalation point for service delivery and executive customer engagement.
* Lead operational governance meetings, service reviews, KPI reporting, risk management, and service improvement programs.
* Ensure compliance with ITIL best practices, operational procedures, and service governance standards.
* Manage cross\-functional teams, vendors, and stakeholders to ensure seamless service delivery.



 Mandatory Qualifications \& Experience
 



  




* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Telecommunications, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 12 years of experience within the Telecommunications industry, with a strong focus on Enterprise ICT Managed Services.
* Minimum 5 years of experience as a Service Delivery Manager supporting large\-scale Telecom Managed Services operations.
* Mandatory experience working with a Tier\-1 Telecommunications Operator or a leading Telecom Managed Services Provider.
* Proven experience managing 24x7 Enterprise ICT Managed Services with contractual SLA, KPI, OLA, and governance responsibilities.



 Demonstrated expertise in: Service Delivery Management, Service Assurance, Incident Management, Major Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, Continual Service Improvement (CSI), and Customer \& Executive Stakeholder Management.
 



  





 Strong technical understanding of Enterprise ICT technologies, including: MPLS, SD\-WAN, Enterprise WAN, Internet Services, Data Centre \& Cloud Services, Collaboration Solutions, and Managed Security Services.
 



  




* Hands\-on experience with OpenText Service Manager, Oracle Siebel, or equivalent enterprise ITSM platforms.
* Strong leadership experience managing multidisciplinary technical and operational teams within a mission\-critical 24x7 environment.



 Mandatory Certifications
 



  




* ITIL 4 Managing Professional (MP) or ITIL 4 Strategic Leader (SL).
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.



 IMPORTANT \- HOW TO APPLY: Applicants must combine their CV and copies of all certifications (ITIL 4 MP/SL, PMP, and any other relevant certifications) into a SINGLE PDF file and upload it as their resume/CV attachment. Applications without certification copies attached to the CV may not be considered.

**Role** 




 Procurement Manager

**Role Purpose** 




 The Procurement Manager is responsible for leading and delivering effective procurement across the Society portfolio, ensuring we source high\-quality goods and services that represent best value while protecting our premium brand standards. This role plays a key part in supporting our growth as Qatar's leading multi\-brand wellness and lifestyle group by building strong supplier partnerships, driving commercial efficiencies, and enabling the seamless delivery of products and services that underpin an exceptional member experience. The Procurement Manager reports directly to the Operations Director and leads a team comprising the Procurement Officer, Facility Management Supervisor, and Warehouse Supervisor.
 



  
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Strategy \& Planning** 




 • Develop and deliver a Group procurement strategy aligned to business objectives, growth plans, and Society's premium brand standards.
 



 • Build and maintain a procurement roadmap covering all categories — fitness equipment, F\&B, spa \& wellness, facilities, maintenance, retail, IT, and professional services.
 



 • Identify opportunities for consolidation, cost optimisation, and total cost of ownership improvements across all spending categories.
 



 • Contribute to annual budget planning alongside Finance and Operations, ensuring procurement commitments are accurately reflected.
 



**Sourcing \& Supplier Management** 




 • Lead competitive sourcing processes (RFI, RFQ, RFP) across all procurement categories, ensuring transparency and best value.
 



 • Identify, qualify, and onboard suppliers capable of meeting Society's quality, sustainability, performance, and compliance standards.
 



 • Maintain a curated supplier register for Qatar and GCC markets, including preferred and approved vendor lists.
 



 • Manage the full supplier lifecycle — onboarding, performance monitoring, review, renewal, and exit — with clear KPIs and SLAs.
 



 • Build and sustain strategic supplier partnerships, acting as the primary relationship owner for key Group accounts.
 



**Contract Negotiation \& Commercial Management** 




 • Negotiate commercial terms, pricing structures, payment terms, and contractual obligations across all supplier agreements.
 



 • Own the Group's supplier contract library, ensuring all agreements are current, compliant, and commercially advantageous.
 



 • Work closely with Finance and, where required, legal counsel on contractual risk, warranties, indemnities, and dispute resolution.
 



 • Monitor spend against contracts and budgets, escalating variances and recommending corrective actions.
 



**Facilities, Maintenance \& Capital Projects** 




 • Procure planned and reactive maintenance services, engineering support, and specialist contractors across all sites.
 



 • Support capital projects including club refurbishments, new location openings, and fitness equipment upgrades.
 



 • Work in partnership with the Facility Management Supervisor to ensure all facilities\-related procurement is delivered on time and within budget.
 



 • Ensure compliance with Qatar health, safety, and building regulations across all contractor and supplier engagements.
 



**Operations \& Category Management** 




 • Manage procurement across key categories: gym equipment, F\&B supplies, spa products, retail merchandise, uniforms, IT hardware and software, marketing materials, and professional services.
 



 • Coordinate with the Warehouse Supervisor to ensure stock levels, receiving processes, and inventory management align with operational requirements.
 



 • Manage import logistics, customs clearance coordination, and supplier lead times to minimise supply chain disruption.
 



 • Drive continuous improvement in procurement processes, systems, and controls.
 



**Governance \& Compliance** 




 • Ensure all procurement activity complies with Qatar commercial law, Group financial policies, and Al Mana Group governance frameworks.
 



 • Maintain accurate procurement records, spend analytics, and reporting for the Operations Director and Finance Manager.
 



 • Implement and enforce purchasing controls, authorisation limits, and approval workflows.
 



**Team Leadership** 




 • Lead, develop, and performance\-manage the Procurement Officer and Warehouse Supervisor.
 



 • Set clear objectives, provide regular feedback, and support the professional development of direct reports.
 



 • Foster a collaborative, high\-performance culture within the procurement function.
 



  
 



**What Success Looks Like (KPIs)** 




 • Cost savings and value delivered against procurement budget targets.
 



 • Supplier performance: SLA and KPI compliance across key categories.
 



 • Contract coverage: percentage of spend under active, managed contracts.
 



 • PPM completion rate and reactive maintenance SLA compliance (via Facility Management Supervisor).
 



 • Procurement cycle time: speed from requisition to purchase order.
 



 • 100% compliance with Qatar commercial regulations and Al Mana Group governance standards.
 



 • Procurement Officer and Warehouse Supervisor team engagement and development.
 



  
 



**Experience \& Qualifications** 




**Experience** 




 • Minimum 5 years' experience in a Procurement Manager or Senior Procurement role, ideally within multi\-site leisure, hospitality, fitness, or retail operations.
 



 • Demonstrated expertise in end\-to\-end procurement: strategy, sourcing, supplier management, contract negotiation, and performance monitoring.
 



 • Strong background procuring across multiple categories — gym equipment, facilities, maintenance, F\&B, retail, spa \& wellness, IT, and professional services.
 



 • Experience managing complex supplier contracts and negotiating commercial agreements in a GCC or international environment.
 



 • Proven experience managing procurement budgets and delivering cost savings without compromising quality or brand standards.
 



 • Track record of leading and developing a small procurement or operations team.
 



 • Experience working cross\-functionally with Finance, Operations, and Facilities teams.
 



 • Familiarity with Qatar or GCC supplier markets, import/logistics processes, and relevant commercial regulations is highly desirable.
 



 • Experience with procurement technology (ERP systems, e\-procurement platforms, spend analytics tools) is advantageous.
 



**Qualifications** 




 • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Finance, or a related field.
 



 • CIPS Level 4 or above (Chartered Institute of Procurement \& Supply) — or working towards. CIPS Level 5/6 (MCIPS) is highly desirable.
 



 • Additional qualifications in facilities management, project management (PRINCE2\), or health \& safety (NEBOSH/IOSH) are advantageous.
 



 • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (advanced), ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, or equivalent), and contract management software.
 



  
 



**Key Competencies** 




 • Commercial acumen — confident negotiator with a strong grasp of cost drivers, contract structures, and value optimisation.
 



 • Strategic thinking — ability to set and deliver a procurement strategy that supports business growth and brand excellence.
 



 • Supplier relationship management — skilled at building and sustaining partnerships with suppliers at all levels.
 



 • Analytical capability — strong spend analysis, cost modelling, and data\-driven decision\-making skills.
 



 • Leadership — confident team leader who sets clear direction, develops capability, and holds people accountable.
 



 • Stakeholder management — credible and influential at all levels across the Group.
 



 • Attention to detail — rigorous approach to contract review, spend tracking, and compliance.
 



 • Organisation \& prioritisation — able to manage a broad workload across multiple categories and sites simultaneously.

data.jd_text:
**POSITION OVERVIEW** 




  





 The Data Center Technical Manager is a senior engineering role within UCC Holding's Power \& Digital delivery division. The role is responsible for the end\-to\-end technical integrity of data center projects from front\-end definition through to construction handover, ensuring that power, cooling, civil, and ICT systems are designed to hyperscale and colocation standards and are fully constructable and operable at commissioning.
 



 Working in close alignment with the COO, Data Center Executive Director and the project execution team, the Technical Manager serves as the day\-to\-day technical authority on assigned projects, owning design standards, discipline coordination, OEM interfaces, and technical risk management across the full delivery lifecycle.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




**Technical Leadership \& Design Management** 



* Lead multi\-disciplinary engineering teams across power, cooling, civil/structural, and ICT disciplines
* Own technical standards and design basis documentation through to FEED
* Ensure all designs are constructable, installation logic aligned, and ready for site execution
* Manage inter discipline coordination and clash resolution using 3D plant modelling tools (REVIT, etc.)



**Power Systems** 



* Oversee HV/MV/LV power architecture design including utility intake, MV switchgear, transformers, and LV distribution
* Manage UPS, battery storage, and generator system design and OEM interfaces
* Ensure power redundancy models are correctly implemented, targeting AI\-ready campuses
* Coordinate protection, metering, and power quality studies with specialist consultants



**Cooling \& MEP** 



* Lead cooling system design including air\-side economization, chillers, air cooling, and liquid cooling for high\-density AI compute
* Target PUE benchmarks in line with hyperscale client requirements; industry benchmark for AI campuses is 1\.2–1\.4 PUE
* Oversee plumbing, drainage, HVAC, and fire suppression system design and integration
* Interface with energy modelling teams to validate system performance and efficiency projections



**Civil, Structural \& Building** 



* Manage civil and structural design scope including foundations, raised floor systems, data halls, and façade
* Ensure structural designs accommodate equipment loadings, seismic considerations, and phased capacity expansion
* Oversee M\&E services coordination within building fabric to eliminate site clashes and rework



**ICT, Cabling \& Connectivity** 



* Oversee ICT infrastructure design including structured cabling, fiber backbone, and carrier\-neutral meet\-me rooms
* Ensure DCIM\-readiness is embedded in design from the outset to support operational efficiency post\-handover
* Coordinate with network operators and hyperscale clients on connectivity and meet\-me room requirements



**Commissioning Alignment** 



* Engage the commissioning team from FEED stage to ensure testability and safe energization sequences are designed in
* Define and review CX documentation including CX plans, ITPs, FAT and SAT procedures
* Ensure technical handover packages are complete, accurate, and meet client O\&M requirements



**HSE \& Quality** 



* Embed safety by design principles across all engineering disciplines
* Own HAZOP/HAZID planning and chairing, ensuring action close\-out is tracked
* Manage quality assurance processes for design deliverables including review gates, checking, and sign\-off



**Client \& Stakeholder Management** 



* Act as primary technical interface with hyperscale and colocation clients during design development
* Lead technical clarification meetings with clients, authorities, and utility providers
* Represent UCC in technical workshops with OEMs, specialist consultants, and external design teams



  





**QUALIFICATIONS \& EXPERIENCE** 




**Essential** 



* Degree in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, or a related discipline (BEng / MEng)
* 10\+ years of engineering experience in mission\-critical facilities or data center projects
* Demonstrated experience delivering hyperscale or large\-scale colocation data center projects
* Deep working knowledge of data center power architecture
* Strong cooling systems experience
* Proven ability to lead multi\-disciplinary design teams of 10\+ engineers
* Experience with FEL/FEED\-driven delivery models
* Proficiency in design tools including AutoCAD, REVIT, or equivalent
* Working experience in the Middle East or comparable international markets



**Desirable** 



* LEED, BREEAM, or equivalent sustainability certification experience
* Familiarity with hyperscale client design standards (Google, Microsoft Azure, Meta, AWS, Oracle)

data.title: Senior Lead Auditor Industrial Construction
data.raw_snippet:
**Job Purpose** 




 The Senior Lead Auditor – Industrial Construction is responsible for leading and executing complex risk\-based internal audit engagements across construction, engineering, project management, technology and related business processes. The role provides independent and objective
data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose** 




 The Senior Lead Auditor – Industrial Construction is responsible for leading and executing complex risk\-based internal audit engagements across construction, engineering, project management, technology and related business processes. The role provides independent and objective assurance on the adequacy and effectiveness of governance, risk management, internal controls, compliance, project controls, and compliance controls. The position is expected to identify control weaknesses, assess operational and construction risks, recommend practical improvements, and support management in strengthening accountability, compliance, cost control, project governance, and system reliability.
 



**3\. Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities** 




**Audit Planning and Execution** 



* Lead construction, project, operational, construction, compliance, and risk\-based audit engagements in accordance with the approved annual audit plan and internal audit methodology.
* Develop audit programs, risk\-control matrices, testing procedures, work plans, and audit scopes aligned with business risk, project complexity, and technology dependencies.
* Conduct walkthroughs, interviews, process reviews, data analysis, sampling, testing, and evidence validation to assess the design and operating effectiveness of controls.
* Ensure audit workpapers are complete, accurate, properly referenced, and supported by sufficient and appropriate audit evidence.
* Coordinate with process owners and project stakeholders to obtain required documentation, clarify audit observations, and validate facts prior to report finalization.



**Construction, Engineering, and Project Audit** 



* Review the effectiveness of controls across construction project lifecycle activities, including tendering, estimation, budgeting, contract administration, procurement, subcontractor management, project execution, cost control, billing, claims, variations, and project close\-out.
* Assess compliance with approved project budgets, contracts, delegation of authority, procurement procedures, site instructions, change management procedures, and project governance requirements.
* Evaluate project controls relating to cost, schedule, quality, scope, risk, progress measurement, earned value, material management, manpower utilization, and equipment deployment.
* Review contractor and subcontractor payments, progress certifications, variation orders, claims, back charges, retention, advance payments, and supporting documentation.
* Identify risks relating to cost overruns, delays, weak documentation, contract leakage, non\-compliance, duplicate payments, unauthorized commitments, and ineffective project monitoring.



**Risk, Governance, and Compliance** 



* Identify key operational, financial, contractual, compliance, fraud, cybersecurity, and technology risks and assess whether controls are appropriately designed and operating effectively.
* Evaluate compliance with government regulations (engineering, construction, HSE), company policies, delegation of authority, approval matrices, project governance requirements, contractual obligations, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Support fraud risk assessments, special reviews, and investigations relating to construction projects, procurement activities, contractor claims, system access, or technology misuse, where required and authorized.
* Provide practical and value\-adding recommendations to address control deficiencies, reduce risk exposure, improve project governance, and strengthen technology control environments.
* Monitor agreed management action plans and follow up with responsible owners to ensure audit findings are addressed within agreed timelines.



**Reporting and Stakeholder Management** 



* Prepare clear, concise, and well\-supported audit reports highlighting observations, risk ratings, root causes, business impact, recommendations, agreed management actions, owners, and target completion dates.
* Discuss audit findings with project teams, business process owners, and senior management in a professional and constructive manner to ensure factual accuracy and practical resolution.
* Escalate significant project risks, control breakdowns, suspected fraud indicators, and high\-risk findings to the Head of Internal Audit / Audit Director, as required.



  





**Team Leadership and Quality Assurance** 



* Lead, guide, and review the work of assigned auditors to ensure audit objectives are achieved and deliverables meet internal audit quality standards.
* Coach junior auditors on construction audit techniques, technology audit testing, audit documentation, stakeholder communication, and report writing.
* Ensure audit engagements are completed within agreed timelines, budgeted hours, and required quality standards.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of audit tools, templates, risk assessment processes, data analytics, project audit procedures, and technology audit methodologies.
* Maintain current knowledge of construction industry practices, project controls, contract management, IT governance, cybersecurity, data analytics, and regulatory developments relevant to the organization.



**4\. Decision\-Making Authority** 



* Recommend audit scope, testing approach, risk ratings, and control improvement actions for review and approval by the Head of Internal Audit / Audit Director.
* Escalate significant construction, project, contract, technology, cybersecurity, compliance, and fraud\-related risks in accordance with internal audit protocols.
* Prioritize audit fieldwork activities and allocate tasks to assigned auditors within approved engagement plans.
* Provide professional audit conclusions based on audit evidence gathered, while final audit report issuance remains subject to internal audit leadership approval.



**5\. Key Internal and External Interfaces** 



* Internal: Construction, Engineering, Project Controls, Contracts, Procurement, Finance, Legal, Governance, Risk and Compliance, HR, and Business Unit Management.
* External: External auditors, consultants, contractors, subcontractors, technology vendors, regulatory advisors, and relevant authorities, where applicable and as authorized.



**6\. Qualifications, Experience, and Certifications** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field within Industrial Construction. A master’s degree is an advantage, as is a specialization in main pipelines and energy infrastructure.
* Professional certification such as CIA, PMP, RICS or equivalent is preferred.
* Prior hands\-on experience operating within the CIS (Commonwealth of Independent States) market is essential.
* Minimum of 8–10 years of relevant experience in internal audit, project audit, construction audit with at least 3 years in a lead audit or supervisory capacity.
* Strong experience auditing construction and project processes, including contract administration, procurement, subcontractor management, project cost control, claims, variations, progress certification, and project governance.
* Experience in large, diversified, project\-based, construction, engineering, infrastructure, energy or multinational organizations is an advantage.
* Hands\-on experience with ERP systems, project management systems, document management platforms, and data analysis tools. Experience with SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, Primavera, Power BI, or similar systems is preferred.



**7\. Required Knowledge, Skills, and Competencies** 



* Strong understanding of construction operations, project controls, contracts, procurement, commercial management, internal controls, and risk\-based auditing.
* Strong ability to read and analyze project documentation. Proven track record of verifying construction compliance with project designs and engineering standards. Deep understanding of and strict adherence to industrial HSE policies.
* Excellent command of both Russian and English (written and spoken) is strictly required.
* Ability to interpret project budgets, contracts, variation orders, claims, payment certificates, system logs, workflow approvals, access rights, policies, procedures, and technical documentation.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, investigation, root\-cause analysis, and data interpretation skills.
* Strong report writing skills with the ability to present complex construction and technology issues clearly, accurately, and professionally.
* High level of integrity, independence, confidentiality, professional skepticism, and attention to detail.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to challenge constructively and influence corrective actions.
* Ability to manage multiple audits, deadlines, and priorities in a fast\-paced, project\-driven environment.
* Leadership capability to guide audit teams, review workpapers, and ensure high\-quality audit deliverables.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, especially Excel, Word, and PowerPoint. Data analytics capability is an advantage.



**8\. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)** 




  




* Quality, accuracy, and completeness of audit workpapers, testing results, and audit reports.
* Number and significance of construction, project, contract, technology, cybersecurity, and compliance risks identified and resolved.
* Timely closure of agreed management action plans and follow\-up audit findings.
* Practicality and effectiveness of audit recommendations in improving project governance, cost control, compliance, and technology control environments.
* Stakeholder satisfaction with the clarity, relevance, and value of audit outputs.
* Effectiveness in leading assigned audit teams and maintaining internal audit quality standards.
* Compliance with internal audit methodology, professional standards, and ethical requirements.



**9\. Working Conditions** 



* Office\-based role with regular visits to project sites, construction locations, branches, subsidiaries or business units as required by the audit plan.
* May require extended working hours during critical audit periods, project reviews, system reviews, investigations, reporting deadlines, or special assignments.

 Identify strategic partnerships and new business opportunities that strengthen the investment platform.
 



  





 Leadership
 


* Build and lead a high\-performing investment organization.

 Listed Funds

 Candidates coming from primarily buy\-side backgrounds should be able to demonstrate why their experience equips them to successfully lead a commercially focused investment platform with strong institutional client engagement and product development responsibilities.

data.jd_text:
**About QNB**
 Established in 1964 as the country’s first Qatari\-owned commercial bank, QNB Group has steadily grown to become the largest bank in the Middle East and Africa (MEA) region.
   

  

 QNB Group’s presence through its subsidiaries and associate companies extends to more than 31 countries across three continents providing a comprehensive range of advanced products and services. The total number of employees is more than 28,000 serving up to 20 million customers operating through 1,000 locations, with an ATM network of 4,300 machines.
   

  

 QNB has maintained its position as one of the highest rated regional banks from leading credit rating agencies including Standard \& Poor’s (A), Moody’s (Aa3\) and Fitch (A\+). The Bank has also been the recipient of many awards from leading international specialised financial publications.
   

  

 Based on the Group’s consistent strong financial performance and its expanding international presence, QNB currently ranks as the most valuable bank brand in the Middle East and Africa, according to Brand Finance Magazine.
   

  

 QNB Group has an active community support program and sponsors various social, educational and sporting events.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The incumbent will be responsible for proactively managing QNB Group’s selected Corporate Banking portfolio, Branches and affiliates (the “Selected Portfolio”) in order to achieve the function’s set targets for revenue, profit, profitability and volumes, in compliance with established QNB Group credit policies, procedures, standards, regulatory requirements and best international market practice.
   

  

 The individual will also be involved in the formulation of corporate branch strategies and the implementation of the GCIB initiatives (including GWB and GAM) across his portfolio. As well as, identify potential new business opportunities for other business area functions or branches within the QNB Group, aligned to the approved Global Account Management concept and co\-ordinate with them to facilitate Group synergies and cross selling of products and services. To improve QNB’s profitability, revenue generation as well as service and delivery enhancement, in order to ensure that clients banking’ needs are comprehensively identified and efficiently met, within the QNB Group, on a priority basis.
   

  

 Main Responsibilities
   

  

* Ensure implementation of the strategies and plans to achieve all volume, revenue, and profit targets for the Selected Portfolio function.
* Support the EVP International Corporate in the development of Key Performance Indicators for the systematic performance monitoring, quality measurement and performance evaluation of the Selected Portfolio function
* Meet target budgets for Selected Portfolio’s client relationships comprising assets and liability product sales and profits for the Selected Portfolio function, in accordance with QNB’s overall corporate budget and strategy.
* Coordinate periodically between Selected Portfolio, Group’s corporate branches network and subsidiaries to review financial performance and ensure achievement of budget and financial objectives
* Implements KPI’s and best practices for International Corporate Relationship Management.
* Promote cost consciousness and efficiency and enhance productivity, to minimise cost, avoid waste, and optimise benefits for the bank.
* Act within the limits of the powers delegated to the incumbent and delegate authority to the respective staff and monitor exercise of the same.
* Demonstrate clear understanding of the important factors behind the bank's financial \& non\-financial performance.
* Coordinate and liaise activities with international and regional Branches, Retail, Treasury and Head Office support functions including but not limited to GSF and GTB, QNB Capital and QNBFS (“QNB Functions”) to provide support and cross selling opportunities intra QNB Group departments, units and functions.
* Ensure provision of a focal ‘one point of contact’ to Selected Portfolio of clients and ensure superior customer service and a customer friendly approach to proactively meet their needs and resolve their queries.
* Assist customers in all their queries on Bank’s product and seek solution to their requests.
* Maintain, develop and enhance core bank relationships with the existing clients as well as identify, market and build effective new bank relationships.
* Maintain activities in accordance with Service Level Agreements (SLAs) with internal departments/units to achieve improvements in turn\-around time.
* Build and maintain strong and effective relationships with QNB Functions in order to achieve the QNB Group’s goals and objectives, including cross\-selling targets.
* Provide timely and accurate information to the external and internal auditors and the Group’s compliance function when required.
* Implement the approved corporate banking strategy within the function to achieve and exceed the business objectives.
* Maintain, conduct and ensure that activities of the Selected Portfolio comply with regulatory policies and procedures and best market practice.
* Manage, coach and motivate the team of Selected Portfolio’s VPs, AVPs, Managers and Associates to maintain and improve service quality and ensure that the Selected Portfolio meets their set financial and non\-financial targets.
* Continuously monitor, manage and evaluate the Selected Portfolio credit profile to ensure targets are met and any necessary corrective measures are implemented on a timely basis, as required. The portfolio should be managed in accordance within the Bank’s prescribed risk management parameters.
* Review, conduct due diligence and credit assessment, and recommend approval of credit proposals to the relevant approving authority.
* Ensure each VP International Corporate Relationship management has a balanced portfolio and continuously monitor to ensure that each portfolio is destined to achieve its set target and, if appropriate, take corrective action to redirect portfolio management if there is insufficient progress towards the achievement of its set target.
* Provide technical expertise and guidance to Selected Portfolio’s VPs and AVPs to ensure their credit proposals adequately address all relevant risk factors and meet minimum acceptable standards.
* Monitor / develop the Selected Portfolio function’s database ensuring that function personnel perform sales activity in accordance with incumbent’s directives and timely update the database of client contacts.
* Perform / assign function personnel to systematically visit client premises, conduct meetings and prepare / deliver presentations.
* Ensure that all requisite facility and account documentation are collected by function personnel and are timely transferred for credit review and safe custody.
* Ensure all necessary procedures are in place to identify and timely report any customer related negative developments and early signals regarding potentially problematic accounts / relationships and ensure that suitable remedial action is taken by function personnel.
* Ensure that function’s personnel perform cross selling activities to enhance QNB’s overall relationship with customers by coordinating activities with QNB Functions.
* Supervise the roll\-out of conventional corporate banking products targeted to Selected Portfolio clients.
* Develop and maintain professional relationships with key managers of existing and potential clients to provide a broader range of communication, service consistency and proactive response to client’s needs.
* Work in liaison with Group Communications and the Marketing \& Product Management Unit to devise Selected Portfolio specific marketing strategies, client target lists etc. to defend and increase QNB’s current market share.
* Track and report on transaction volumes, budget performance and client\-wise overall portfolio profitability and periodically report to EVP International Corporate and to other executive management of the Group to assess the performance of the Selected Portfolio customer base, as requested.
* Recommend all administrative operational aspects of unit personnel (e.g. leave schedule, training, appraisal etc.) in accordance with established HR policies and procedures.
* Oversee recruitment, provide motivation, guidance to employees and reinforce high standards concerning performance, and adherence to the Bank’s values and mission.
* Encourage, solicit and reward innovative ideas even in day\-to\-day issues.
* Continuous Improvement:
* Set examples by leading improvement initiatives through cross\-functional teams ensuring successes.
* Identify and encourage people to adopt practices better than the industry standard.
* Continuously encourage and recognize the importance of thinking out\-of\-the\-box within the team.


**Education And Experience Requirements**
* University graduate preferably with a Major in in the banking industry, preferably with local / gulf / regional responsibility (dependent on the portfolio coverage) experience. Masters preferred
* At least 15 years’ experience of relevant experience, preferably within a highly rated international bank
* Well\-informed of the market competitive structures, industry practices and any regulations relevant to regional and International Corporate clients segment.
* Informed of the market competitive structure, industry practices and compliance and regulatory requirements of Selected Portfolio countries.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills (including report writing) in English and Arabic.
* Excellent people relationship skills and awareness of risk management concept and practices.
* Understanding of the relevant laws, regulations and practices pertaining to Corporate Banking products.
* Ability to make decisions and follow through with initiatives.
* Personal integrity and self\-management.
* Planning, organizing, and analytical ability.
* Results oriented.
* Ability to motivate and lead teams from diverse cultural backgrounds.
* Familiar with the balanced scorecard approach.
* Strong customer service orientation.
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to communicate both verbally and in writing with all levels of management.


 Note: you will be required to attach the following:
   

  

* Resume/CV
* Copy of Passport or QID
* Copy of Education Certificate

**About the role:** 




  





 The Technical Manager leads the multidisciplinary technical function of the project, ensuring that engineering, architectural, structural and MEP works are reviewed, coordinated and executed in accordance with the Contract Documents, project specifications, applicable codes and the original design intent.
 



 The role requires sound engineering judgment to evaluate contractor proposals, resolve multidisciplinary technical issues, manage design changes and technical risks, and provide clear engineering recommendations to the Project Director, Employer and Engineer throughout the project lifecycle.
 



  





**Job Responsibilities:** 




  





 •Lead the technical review of shop drawings, material submissions, RFIs, engineering calculations, method statements and specialist contractor submissions.
 



 •Review contractor design proposals, value engineering submissions and alternative technical solutions while maintaining compliance with the Contract Documents and design intent.
 



 •Coordinate multidisciplinary reviews involving Architecture, Structure, Civil, Infrastructure, MEP and specialist systems.
 



 •Identify design deficiencies, constructability issues, coordination conflicts and technical risks before implementation.
 



 •Lead technical workshops and resolve interface issues between consultants, contractors, subcontractors and suppliers.
 



 •Review delegated design packages submitted by specialist contractors.
 



 •Assess the impact of design changes on safety, functionality, operation, maintenance, programmer and cost.
 



 •Provide technical guidance to Resident Engineers, discipline engineers and inspectors.
 



 •Coordinate technical matters with the Employer, Engineer, Authorities and Design Office.
 



 •Review temporary works proposals for technical adequacy.
 



 •Ensure compliance with approved drawings, specifications and applicable codes.
 



 •Prepare technical reports, engineering assessments and formal correspondence.
 



 •Support the Project Director in resolving complex technical issues.
 



  





**Required Experience:** 




  





 •Minimum 15 years' post\-graduate engineering experience.
 



 •Minimum 8 years in a Technical Manager or Senior Technical Engineer role.
 



 •Experience on large mixed\-use developments, shopping malls, high\-rise buildings, hotels or similar mega projects.
 



 •Demonstrated experience managing multidisciplinary technical reviews during construction.
 



 •Experience coordinating with international consultants, specialist subcontractors and authorities.
 



 •Previous GCC experience, preferably in Saudi Arabia.
 



  





**Education** 




 •Bachelor's Degree in Civil or Architectural Engineering.
 



 •Master's Degree in Engineering or Construction Management is desirable.
 



  





**Certifications** 




 •Membership of the Saudi Council of Engineers (SCE) or an equivalent recognized professional engineering body (e.g., CRPEP for Bahrain).
 



 •Additional professional certifications and continuous professional development are desirable.
 



**Skills** 




 •Strong multidisciplinary engineering knowledge covering Structural, Architectural and MEP systems.
 



 •Thorough understanding of constructability, engineering coordination and building system integration.
 



 •Ability to review engineering calculations and specialist design submissions.
 



 •Sound knowledge of delegated design responsibilities.
 



 •Good understanding of construction methodologies and sequencing.
 



 •Ability to identify technical risks and develop practical engineering solutions.
 



 •Working knowledge of BIM coordination and multidisciplinary model review.
 



 •Excellent technical report writing.

data.jd_text:
**Role Summary** 




  





 The Microwave Project Manager is responsible for the end\-to\-end planning, execution, and delivery of microwave transmission and backhaul network projects within telecom environments. The role ensures the successful deployment of point\-to\-point and point\-to\-multipoint microwave links, IP/MPLS backhaul integration, and transmission network upgrades, while maintaining high standards of quality, safety, regulatory compliance, and timely delivery.
 



 The role requires strong coordination across RF planning, transmission engineering, civil works, and field deployment teams, as well as effective management of vendors, subcontractors, and equipment suppliers.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Lead the end\-to\-end delivery of microwave transmission and backhaul network projects.
* Define project scope, schedules, budgets, resource plans, and delivery milestones.
* Manage deployment of microwave infrastructure including:



 Point\-to\-point microwave links
 



 Point\-to\-multipoint systems
 



 IP/MPLS backhaul integration
 



 Transmission network upgrades and capacity expansions
 


* Coordinate closely with RF planning, transmission engineering, civil works, and field implementation teams.
* Oversee site acquisition activities, technical site surveys, and line\-of\-sight (LOS) analysis.
* Manage tower infrastructure works including installation, alignment, and commissioning of antennas and microwave equipment.
* Ensure seamless integration of microwave backhaul with core and access network elements.
* Monitor and control project risks, issues, dependencies, and performance metrics.
* Manage relationships with vendors, subcontractors, and equipment suppliers to ensure quality and compliance.
* Ensure adherence to regulatory requirements, including spectrum licensing and telecom authority approvals.
* Track project progress and provide accurate status reports to internal stakeholders and clients.
* Ensure delivery within agreed timelines, budget constraints, and quality standards.



  





**Required Qualifications** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Proven experience in telecom project management, with strong focus on microwave transmission or backhaul networks.
* Solid understanding of microwave technologies, transmission systems, and telecom network architecture.
* Project management certification such as PMP or PRINCE2 is preferred.



  





**Key Skills** 



* Microwave transmission systems (SDH, IP\-based microwave, hybrid networks)
* RF planning, link budgeting, and path analysis
* Project planning, scheduling, and execution control
* Vendor, subcontractor, and stakeholder management
* Risk, issue, and change management
* Budgeting, cost control, and financial tracking
* Strong leadership, communication, and coordination skills



  





**Work Environment** 



* Combination of office\-based project planning and field/site execution activities
* Regular coordination with telecom operators, infrastructure providers, and regulatory bodies
* Frequent site visits, including remote and outdoor locations as required

data.jd_text:
**Role Summary** 




 The Telecom Core Project Manager is responsible for the end\-to\-end delivery of compact and virtualized core network solutions, including LTE/5G core\-in\-a\-box and cloud\-native core platforms. The role focuses on deploying, integrating, and optimizing core network functions for enterprise customers, private LTE/5G networks, and rapid or remote deployment scenarios.
 



 This position ensures successful execution of complex telecom core projects, from planning and design through integration, testing, commissioning, and operational handover, while maintaining compliance with technical, security, and regulatory standards.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of compact core and virtualized core network projects.
* Define project scope, timelines, budgets, resource plans, and delivery milestones.
* Manage deployment of compact and cloud\-native core network solutions, including:
* Evolved Packet Core (EPC)
* 5G Core (5GC) network functions
* Private LTE and private 5G network solutions
* Coordinate cross\-functional teams including core network engineers, RAN engineers, IT/cloud specialists, and system integrators.
* Oversee integration of core network systems with:
* Radio Access Network (RAN)
* Transport and backhaul networks
* OSS/BSS and service management platforms
* Manage installation, configuration, integration, testing, and commissioning activities.
* Ensure adherence to telecom standards, cybersecurity policies, and regulatory compliance requirements.
* Identify, assess, and mitigate project risks, issues, and interdependencies.
* Manage vendors, OEMs, system integrators, and third\-party partners throughout the project lifecycle.
* Track project progress and provide regular reporting to internal stakeholders and customers.
* Ensure successful project delivery aligned with customer expectations, quality standards, and contractual obligations.



  





**Required Qualifications** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
* Proven experience in telecom project management with a strong focus on core network deployments.
* Solid understanding of LTE and 5G core network architecture, including virtualization and cloud\-native technologies.
* Experience with NFV, containerized network functions, and cloud orchestration environments.
* Project management certification such as PMP or PRINCE2 is preferred.



  





**Key Skills** 



* LTE/EPC and 5G Core (5GC) technologies
* Network function virtualization (NFV), containers, and Kubernetes
* Cloud platforms and telecom cloud architectures
* IP networking and telecom protocol understanding
* End\-to\-end project planning and lifecycle management
* Vendor, OEM, and stakeholder management
* Risk, issue, and change management
* Strong leadership, communication, and coordination skills



  





**Work Environment** 



* Primarily office\-based with close coordination across engineering, IT, and delivery teams
* Exposure to data center environments, enterprise sites, and private network deployments
* Occasional travel required for site deployment, integration, and customer engagement activities

data.jd_text:
**Construction Project Manager \- Marine**
**Division: Nass Contracting**
**Location: Bahrain**
**Role Summary**
 The Construction Project Manager \- Marine is responsible for planning, managing, and delivering marine construction projects safely, on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards. The role oversees all phases of project execution, including planning, procurement, resource management, construction activities, stakeholder coordination, and project close\-out. The Project Manager will lead multidisciplinary teams and maintain strong relationships with clients, consultants, subcontractors, and regulatory authorities to ensure successful project delivery.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the planning, execution, monitoring, and completion of marine construction projects in accordance with contractual, technical, and commercial requirements
* Develop and maintain project schedules, budgets, resource plans, and cash flow forecasts
* Coordinate marine construction activities, including marine infrastructure, quay walls, jetties, breakwaters, dredging, reclamation, marine piling, and offshore civil works
* Ensure compliance with project specifications, company standards, local regulations, and international marine construction best practices
* Manage project risks and implement mitigation strategies to minimize delays, cost overruns, and operational challenges
* Lead project teams, including engineers, supervisors, planners, quantity surveyors, and subcontractors, fostering a high\-performance and collaborative work environment
* Coordinate procurement activities and ensure timely availability of materials, equipment, marine vessels, and subcontractor resources
* Review and approve project methodologies, work plans, method statements, and construction sequences
* Ensure strict compliance with Health, Safety, Environment (HSE), and Quality Management System (QMS) requirements
* Manage client communications, consultant coordination, and stakeholder engagement throughout the project lifecycle
* Administer contracts, evaluate variations, manage claims, and support commercial negotiations
* Identify opportunities for value engineering and continuous process improvement
* Conduct regular project review meetings and ensure timely resolution of technical and operational issues
* Oversee project commissioning, handover, documentation, and successful project close\-out


**Qualifications And Skills**
* Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Marine Engineering, Construction Management, or a related engineering discipline
* Minimum of 10\-15 years of experience in construction project management, with at least 5 years managing marine infrastructure projects
* Proven experience delivering projects such as ports, harbors, marine piling, dredging, reclamation, or offshore civil works
* Strong knowledge of project management principles, construction methodologies, contract administration, and cost control
* Proficiency in project management software such as Primavera P6 and Microsoft Project
* Strong commercial awareness with experience in budgeting, forecasting, procurement, and claims management
* Excellent leadership, communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities with the capacity to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment
* Professional certifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent are considered an advantage

 Liaise with custom authorities, B2B shipping clients, and government agencies to prevent operational bottlenecks.

 Absolute mastery of Terminal Operating Systems (TOS), automated container handling, and port management software.
* **Crisis Management:** 
 High psychological resilience to manage industrial dockyard emergencies and extreme weather operations.

data.jd_text:
**The kind of PM we're looking for**
 You've got 2\-4 years under your belt at an independent pharma or healthcare agency, enough to know how MLR works, what a tight timeline actually means, and how to keep five things moving without losing the thread on any of them. You're not a coordinator looking to level up, and you're not a senior PM who needs to own the strategy. You're in that sweet spot where execution is your superpower and you genuinely love it.
   

  

 You thrive when the environment is lean, the team is direct, and no one's waiting on three layers of approval to make a call. If you've come from a large networked agency, this might feel different, in a good way, if you've been craving it.
   

  

**What you'll do**
* Plan and execute pharma marketing projects across cross\-functional teams, keeping everything moving from kickoff through delivery
* Build and own project timelines, tracking milestones, dependencies, and risks before they become problems
* Coordinate internal teams across creative, account, strategy, and analytics, you're the connective tissue
* Run status meetings, kickoffs, and checkpoints that are tight, useful, and don't waste anyone's time
* Maintain project documentation, status reports, and workflow trackers with obsessive consistency
* Monitor budget burn and flag scope shifts early, you catch things before they become conversations
* Keep projects inside established workflows and escalate when something's about to go sideways


**What This Role Is Not**
 This is not a budget ownership role. It's not scope negotiation or team management. And if your planning horizon is quarters rather than days, this won't be the right fit. This role is about execution, doing it well, doing it fast, and doing it with the kind of calm that steadies the people around you.
   

  

**What You Bring**
* 2\-4 years of project management or coordination experience inside a pharma or healthcare independent agency environment
* Hands\-on familiarity with Ziflow and Slack; comfort picking up new tools quickly
* The organizational instincts to track what others miss without being asked
* A communication style that keeps teams aligned, direct, clear, no noise
* A solutions\-first mindset: you don't just flag problems, you walk in with options
* Energy for execution, you're wired for the day\-to\-day, not the 30,000\-foot view


**Compensation \& Benefits**
* $91,000 to $110,000 USD
* Full medical and dental benefits
* 15 days vacation plus one additional day per year of service, unlimited flex time
* $500 home office stipend at time of hire
* Our hiring package is ever\-evolving to meet the needs of our team


**The environment**
 P10 is remote\-first, always has been. The team moves fast, the clients are direct, and the work is real. You'll report to our Project Director, and work inside a structure that's flat enough that your contributions are visible and your voice is heard.
   

  

 If you've been looking for a place where independent thinking is rewarded and nobody's waiting on a committee to make a call, this is it.
   

  

 Interested in working with us? Apply online today.
   

  

**Not an agency\***
 The layer\-laden teams. The prehistoric processes. The impersonal, ego\-driven dog\-and\-pony shows. Take what you think you know about agencies and burn it. P10 was born of the idea that if something isn’t working, or could work better, change it. And that’s exactly what we did. We know that what we’re not makes us who we are. And we’re not just another agency. We are people driven by a palpable passion and purpose, felt by our clients from the very first conversation.
   

  

 P10 brings together a team of diverse, remote\-only seasoned professionals to deliver exceptional value for our clients. Dare to do something different \- join us.
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
