**Position:** 
 Chief Executive Officer \- ITHCA Group
 



**Reporting to:** 
 Board of Directors
 



**POSITION SUMMARY:** 




 For the summary please refer to Jadarah during the application.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:** 




**Strategic Leadership and Governance** 




 • Define and articulate ITHCA’s vision, mission, and long\-term investment strategy in alignment with national technology and digital\-economy priorities, OIA’s direction, and the guidance of the Board.
 



 • Lead the preparation and execution of annual business and operating plans, ensuring effective performance against approved budgets and KPIs.
 



 • Establish and enforce group\-wide governance frameworks, policies, compliance systems, and accountability mechanisms across all subsidiaries, investees, and joint ventures.
 



 • Secure strategic alignment between the Group, OIA, and the Board on all major investment, divestment, and capital decisions.
 



 • Ensure transparency and timely reporting to the Board and its committees, including Executive, Audit \& Risk, and Investment committees.
 



**Portfolio Value Creation and Operational Governance** 




 • Develop and execute portfolio value\-creation initiatives to improve operational performance, commercial growth, technology capabilities, and enterprise value across the Group.
 



 • Govern through a holding\-company model—providing strategic guidance, oversight, and direction while empowering portfolio companies with operational autonomy within an agreed framework.
 



 • Exercise shareholder oversight through subsidiary Boards, governance frameworks, and performance management.
 



 • Monitor the strategic, financial, and operational performance of subsidiaries, investees, and joint ventures against approved KPIs (e.g., ROI, EBITDA), intervening only where performance or risk thresholds require.
 



 • Identify, enable, and leverage synergies, economies of scale, and best practice sharing across the Group and its portfolio.
 



 • Establish a clear delegation of authority so that operational decisions sit with subsidiary leadership while strategic, investment, and capital decisions are governed at Group level.
 



 • Ensure consistent group\-wide standards for risk management, cybersecurity, due diligence, and quality of investment execution.
 



**Portfolio, Investment and Financial Stewardship** 




 • Define the Group’s investment thesis and lead portfolio construction across long\-term, strategically significant technology and emerging technology assets.
 



 • Lead the origination, strategic analysis, and execution of major acquisitions, divestments, and entry/exit decisions, providing formal recommendations to the Board / Investment Committee for approval.
 



 • Govern portfolio\-level capital allocation with disciplined, risk\-adjusted return criteria; review and challenge asset\-level business plans and significant capital requests for alignment with the overarching portfolio strategy.
 



 • Develop and execute divestment and exit strategies—including IPOs, private placements, strategic partnerships, and portfolio restructuring—to recycle capital and maximize long\-term portfolio value.
 



 • Establish the financial framework, risk appetite, and return hurdles for all investments, ensuring capital is deployed in line with the approved strategy and long\-term value\-creation plan.
 



 • Ensure rigorous due diligence on all investments, with accurate financial reporting and compliance against agreed KPIs, budgets, and governance standards.
 



**Partnerships and Ecosystem Development** 




 • Originate and manage strategic partnerships, joint ventures, and alliances with international and local investors, technology operators, and government stakeholders.
 



 • Strengthen public–private partnerships that expand Oman’s technology and emerging technology footprint and attract foreign direct investment, technology transfer, and localization.
 



 • Build and maintain trusted relationships with OIA, government ministries and agencies (at Director\-General and Ministerial level), regulators, financial institutions, and global technology leaders.
 



 • Position ITHCA as the partner of choice for locating emerging\-technology capabilities and value chains within the Sultanate.
 



**Stakeholder Engagement and Public Representation** 




 • Serve as the principal spokesperson and ambassador for ITHCA, ensuring clear, consistent, and strategic communication that strengthens the Group’s reputation and leadership in the national technology and digital economy agenda.
 



 • Build and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with government entities, private\-sector partners, investors, financial institutions, and the wider innovation ecosystem to advance shared national priorities.
 



 • Represent ITHCA at local, regional, and international platforms, advocating for Oman’s digital economy, responsible investment, and emerging\-technology ambitions.
 



 • Oversee media relations, strategic communications, and crisis\-management programs to protect and elevate ITHCA’s brand, credibility, and stakeholder trust.
 



**People, Leadership and Culture** 




 • Build a high\-performance investment organization with institutional capabilities in investment management, portfolio value creation, governance, and strategic partnerships.
 



 • Lead and inspire subsidiary/investee leadership and Group functional heads, fostering a culture of accountability, innovation, and high performance.
 



 • Ensure all key leadership positions are adequately staffed, with robust succession planning and leadership development in place.
 



 • Oversee workforce sustainability and the development of national investment and technology talent.
 



 • Promote an agile, flexible, adaptable, and dynamic “One Group” culture that reflects Oman’s identity, embeds inclusion, and drives continuous improvement.
 



**National Impact and Sustainability** 




 • Deliver measurable impact on Oman’s economy—driving economic diversification, technology exports, private\-capital mobilization, localization, In\-Country Value, Omanisation, and the creation of high\-value technology jobs and capabilities.
 



 • Embed ESG and responsible\-investment principles across all investments and operations.
 



 • Support national digital sovereignty and position Oman within future emerging\-technology value chains, in alignment with Vision 2040\.
 



**Other Requirements** 




 • Based at ITHCA Group headquarters in Muscat, with domestic and international travel as required.
 



 • Upholds the highest standards of integrity, professionalism, and ethical conduct.
 



 • Undertakes additional duties and responsibilities as assigned by the Board of Directors.
 



**SKILLS, QUALIFICATIONS \& EXPERIENCE:** 




**Key Success Factors:** 




 • Strong portfolio performance and value creation, underpinned by disciplined, risk\-adjusted capital allocation and effective capital recycling.
 



 • High\-value investments, partnerships, and joint ventures successfully originated, executed, and sustained.
 



 • Effective group governance and clear strategic alignment with OIA and national priorities.
 



 • A high\-performing, well\-governed multi\-subsidiary organization with a strong leadership bench and succession pipeline.
 



 • Measurable national impact — economic diversification, In\-Country Value, Omanisation, and high\-value technology\-job creation.

**Skills and Competencies:** 




**Functional Competencies** 




 • Portfolio management and portfolio construction.
 



 • Capital allocation, corporate finance, and risk\-adjusted return management.
 



 • Investment governance and enterprise risk management.
 



 • Technology investment and portfolio value creation.
 



 • Building digital and technology industries and ecosystems.
 



 • Public–private partnerships and senior stakeholder management.
 



 • Board and corporate governance.
 



 • Transformation and change leadership.
 



**Behavioural Competencies** 




 • Visionary, decisive, and inspirational leadership.
 



 • Strong interpersonal, negotiation, and stakeholder\-management skills.
 



 • Flexibility, adaptability, creativity, and innovation.
 



 • High resilience and sound judgment under pressure, with strong public representation and advocacy skills.
 



**Education and Experience:** 




**Education** 




 • Advanced degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Technology, or a related field; an MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification is strongly preferred.

data.jd_text:
**Job Summary:** 
 The Chief Investment \& Finance Officer (CIFO) reports directly to the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) and serves as the CEO's principal deputy on all investment and financial matters. The role combines strategic investment management with corporate finance leadership and is responsible for maximizing shareholder value through disciplined capital allocation, financial stewardship, and execution of the Company's investment strategy.
 



**Tasks and Responsibilities:** 




  





**1\. Investment Management** 




**Investment Strategy** 



* Develop, maintain, and monitor the Company's long\-term investment strategy, ensuring alignment with the Board\-approved strategic plan.
* Establish measurable investment objectives and report progress against approved targets.
* Monitor market, industry, and macroeconomic developments to identify opportunities and emerging risks.



**Portfolio Management** 



* Prepare quarterly investment reports covering:
* Performance against approved targets.
* Financial performance and valuation.
* Approved key risk indicators.
* Cash flow performance.
* Return on investment.
* Strategic positioning.
* Growth potential (BCG Growth\-Share Matrix).
* Value enhancement and corrective action recommendations.



**Investment Pipeline** 



* Maintain a structured pipeline of investment opportunities.
* Provide quarterly updates on opportunities reviewed, investment rationale, due diligence outcomes, rejected opportunities, and recommendations for shortlisted investments.



**Strategic Investments** 



* Lead the execution and monitoring of up to three major strategic investments.
* Ensure investments are expected to generate returns above the Company's weighted average cost of capital over an average five\-year period.
* Develop and monitor performance improvement plans with the ENRC, where required.



**Portfolio Review** 



* Conduct periodic reviews of all investments.
* For investments projected to generate returns below 10% p.a. over five years, develop recovery plans or recommend divestment/exit strategies within five years.



**Greenfield \& Brownfield Investments** 



* Maintain at least one active Greenfield or Brownfield investment opportunity.
* Develop business cases, implementation plans, value creation plans, and exit strategies before approval.
* Ensure an expected investment exit horizon of approximately five years.



  





**2\. Finance Leadership** 




**Financial Planning \& Analysis** 



* Lead annual budgeting, long\-term financial planning, rolling forecasts, and scenario analysis across portfolio companies.
* Monitor performance against budgets and recommend corrective actions.



**Treasury \& Cash Flow Management** 



* Monitor forward\-looking cash flows and identify funding gaps proactively.
* Present financing and liquidity management strategies to the ENRC.
* Optimize capital allocation across the portfolio.



**Financial Reporting** 



* Ensure timely preparation of quarterly Board reports and annual statutory financial statements.
* Ensure compliance with IFRS, regulatory requirements, and corporate governance standards.



**Financial Controls \& Governance** 



* Maintain effective internal controls and strengthen financial governance.
* Support internal and external audits.
* Ensure compliance with applicable financial regulations.



**Commercial \& Contract Review** 



* Review significant commercial contracts and investment agreements.
* Assess financial implications and risks prior to execution.
* Support negotiations of strategic commercial arrangements.



**Banking \& Financing** 



* Manage relationships with banks, lenders, and financial institutions.
* Lead debt financing, refinancing, and capital\-raising activities.
* Negotiate financing facilities and optimize borrowing costs.



  





**Qualifications and Experience:** 



* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or Engineering.
* CFA, ACA, ACCA, CPA, CA, or equivalent internationally recognized professional qualification.
* MBA or Master's degree in Finance, Investment, or Business Administration.
 *(Preferred)*
* Mechanical or Industrial Engineering qualification in addition to finance credentials.
 *(Preferred)*
* Minimum 15 years of relevant professional experience, including 3\-5 years in a senior executive leadership role.
* Experience within an investment company, sovereign wealth fund, private equity firm, investment holding company, or diversified industrial group.
* Proven experience in investment portfolio evaluation and management.
* Experience leading mergers, acquisitions, and divestments.
* Strong expertise in corporate finance, valuation, financial modelling, and capital allocation.
* Experience working with Boards of Directors and Board Committees.
* Experience within industrial manufacturing businesses is highly desirable.



  





**Note: We thank all applicants for their interest, however only those candidates who are shortlisted will be contacted**

**Contracting \& Commercial Risk Management**

* Support dispute prevention and resolution strategies including arbitration, mediation, and litigation when necessary.



  





**Leadership \& Organizational Development**

**Stakeholder \& External Relationship Management**

data.raw_snippet: A new financial markets infrastructure venture is being established in Oman, backed by prominent institutional investors and operating under an international common law framework. data.jd_text:
A new financial markets infrastructure venture is being established in Oman, backed by prominent institutional investors and operating under an international common law framework. The platform is being built from scratch, to go\-live in 2027, and is designed to operate as a regulated financial market infrastructure from day one
 



  





 We are hiring a Regulatory and Risk Lead to head the second line of defence. The role is accountable for the enterprise risk framework, regulatory relationship and compliance, financial crime prevention, and oversight of information security. The intention is that the post\-holder progresses into the Head of Risk and Compliance role in the Run phase.
 



  





 The first\-line functions own the day\-to\-day execution and the controls that surround it. The Regulatory and Risk Lead independently reviews, challenges, and reports on that first\-line execution; sets the policy and framework standards within which it must operate; and owns the relationship with the regulator across all matters except specific operational regulatory reporting. The post\-holder must be willing and able to challenge their peers, including those above them, without flinching, and to escalate to the Board where necessary.
 



  





**What the role covers** 



* Designing the enterprise risk framework from a blank sheet: risk taxonomy, risk appetite, risk tolerances, key risk indicators, governance, and reporting
* Owning the day\-to\-day relationship with the regulator on all compliance and supervisory matters; leading the response to inspections and supervisory enquiries
* Owning the regulatory engagement plan: notifications, periodic submissions, supervisory meetings, thematic reviews, and ad hoc requests
* Providing second\-line oversight of adherence to CPMI\-IOSCO Principles for Financial Market Infrastructures; leading engagement with PFMI assessors and international supervisory bodies
* Designing and owning the financial crime framework: AML, counter\-terrorism financing, sanctions, and anti\-bribery and corruption; discharging or designating MLRO accountability
* Setting the information security policy framework and providing second\-line oversight of first\-line information security; owning regulator\-facing reporting on cyber matters
* Owning the policy framework: structure, hierarchy, ownership, review cycles, and attestation
* Providing independent second\-line reporting to the Board Risk Committee on risk, compliance, financial crime, and information security
* Line managing the Cybersecurity and Information Security Manager, KYC/Compliance Expert, and wider Risk and Compliance team as it builds



  





**Who we are looking for** 




 At least 12 years in risk, compliance, or regulatory roles in financial services, with substantial time in a second\-line capacity at a regulated firm. Direct, demonstrable experience as the second\-line risk and compliance owner, or a senior member of the second\-line function, at a
 



 financial market infrastructure, custody bank, exchange, payment system, or major regulated financial institution: this is non\-negotiable.
 



  





 Direct experience engaging with a senior financial\-services regulator on licensing, supervisory matters, inspections, and policy development. Working knowledge of CPMI\-IOSCO Principles for Financial Market Infrastructures. Direct experience designing and operating an AML and financial crime framework, including MLRO accountability or close support of an MLRO. Track record of independently challenging first\-line decisions and escalating to Board level where necessary. Fluent in English.
 



  





 A professional qualification (ICA Diploma, CISI, ACAMS, or equivalent) is an advantage. So is familiarity with the IFC Oman regulatory framework, direct experience in a CSD, CCP, or exchange, and Arabic language skills.
 



  





**What this is** 




 The second\-line function does not exist yet. The risk framework has not been written, the compliance monitoring plan has not been set, and the regulatory relationship is in its earliest stages. The person who takes this role will build all of it and carry it through licensing and into operation. If you are unquestionably credible with senior regulators, have the independence to challenge upward when the evidence demands it, and want to build a second\-line function at a regulated FMI from a blank sheet, this is worth a conversation.

**Job purpose** 




 Lead the development and execution of OQEP's Investor Relations and Stakeholder Management strategy under the direction of the Head of Investor Relations, serving as the trusted interface between OQEP and its investors, bondholders, analysts, rating agencies and other capital\-market stakeholders. The role builds and sustains strong, transparent and value\-adding relationships with the investment community, ensuring timely, accurate and consistent communication of OQEP's financial performance, strategy, ESG narrative and regulatory disclosures. It manages key capital\-market disclosures, investor targeting programs, roadshows, analyst outreach and rating agency engagement while providing strategic insight to senior leadership on market sentiment, peer positioning, share price drivers and investor expectations. The position acts as a trusted advisor by translating complex financial, operational and ESG information into clear, credible messaging that strengthens investor confidence, protects OQEP's market reputation and supports long\-term shareholder value. Through disciplined stakeholder engagement, structured investor communications and continuous improvement of IR processes and systems, the role enhances transparency, governance and OQEP's standing in local and international capital markets.
 



 The position will act in accordance with the OQEP’s Mission, Vision, Values \& Strategies, as well as, policies, guidelines, and international standards, supported by an IT Technology platform, QHSE \& Energy Management System requirements standards, Omani’s government \& other legal justifications, and best international practices in consonance with national objectives.
 



  





**Main tasks and responsibilities:** 




**Investors Relations and Stakeholder Management:** 



* Develop and maintain relationships with key stakeholders across the organization, including executives, department heads, and investors.
* Present business information in engaging and informative ways, such as dashboards, reports, and presentations.
* Partner with business units to understand their needs and objectives.
* Worked on managing and fostering finance processes and initiatives towards process automation and leaning the processes.
* Change Management PR with specialty in Media
* Support the development and implementation of financial plans and budgets.
* Analyze financial data to identify trends and opportunities, and communicate these insights to stakeholders.
* Identify and mitigate business/financial risks.
* Stay up\-to\-date on current business trends and regulations.
* Stakeholder Management: You'd build relationships with key stakeholders across the organization to understand their financial needs and concerns. This could include investors, creditors, customers, suppliers, and even employees.
* Project Management: There could be a project management aspect, ensuring financial tasks are completed on time and within budget.
* Maintain and cultivate relationships with domestic and international banks, investors, and credit rating agencies to develop and implement funding strategies.
* Stay updated regarding the latest financial and economic news for the country and the region.
* Prepare presentations for current and potential investors.
* Promote and encourage the continuous learning and development among team members including knowledge sharing ac vi es.
* Ensure work quality standards and deadlines are met.
* Promote and encourage the continuous learning and development among team members including knowledge sharing activities.
* Contribute to the development and implementation of departmental policies, systems, processes, procedures and controls. Continuously identify and recommend improvements while ensuring compliance with the group guidelines, international / local standards and relevant legislation.



  





**Reporting** 



* Critically evaluate the information gathered from multiple sources, on key drivers behind the numbers and agree on comments to be incorporated into the reports Contribute to the monthly group reporting.
* Continuously improve Business Reporting and Monitoring capabilities, processes, procedures, practices and systems.
* Design \& implement Group\-level reports using contemporary business dashboard/scorecard solutions.
* Design and develop Data Base for meeting the reporting requirements of the Management in order to make informed decisions.
* Own and maintain reporting calendar. Ensure that reports are delivered on time with agreed content.



  





**Key interactions** 




**Internal** 
 : Relevant functions under chief executives (CFO, COO, CCO, and general Counsel) and JV and Operated Assets teams.
 



**External** 
 : equity and fixed income analyst, MSX, FSA and relevant investment community
 



  





**Notable Working Conditions.** 
 Office environment, intensive computer screen use, periodic capital\-market reporting deadlines (quarterly results, annual report, disclosures), and occasional international travel and after\-hours work to support investor roadshows, conference calls, capital markets days, rating agency meetings and time\-zone\-sensitive investor engagements.
 



  





**Education requirements** 




 Minimum qualification is a bachelor’s degree in finance, Business \& Marketing. Professional certification in Investor Relations such as Investor Relations Charter (IRC)® from NIRI is preferred. CFA, CPA, NIRI Corporate Disclosure Certificate, or CFA Institute Sustainable Investing Certificate are considered an advantage.
 



  





**Language** 




 Fluent proficiency in both Arabic and English, including advanced business writing and investor presentations.
 



  





**Background and experience:** 



* 10\+ years of relevant experience, preferable previous experiences working in oil and gas company.
* 3\+ years experiences working in corporate finance and/or capital market environment
* Have a good capability to analyse and interpret consolidated financial statements.
* Experienced in developing high\-quality management reports and investor\-focused presentations.
* Able to act as coordinator for multiple team (internal and external)
* Solid understanding of sustainability related topics and frameworks.
* Have knowledge to evaluate business plans and sustainability indicators.
* Familiar with capital market expectations, corporate governance practices, and investor engagement strategies.
* Comfortable working in fast\-paced, cross\-functional environments with tight deadlines.
* Prior experience in Investor Relations (IR) within a listed company, large corporate, or financial institution.
* Demonstrated track record of working closely with IR functions, senior management, and external investors.
* Proven achievements in IR (e.g., investor engagement, disclosures, or overall IR effectiveness).
* Experience interaction with institutional investors and analysts.



  





**Competencies and skills** 




**Soft skills:**



* Strong communication skills (Written and Verbal)
* Strategic Thinking – Aligns IR efforts with business goals.
* Executive Presence – Engages confidently with senior stakeholders.
* Stakeholder Management – Builds strong, trusted relationships.
* Analytical Mindset – Interprets data to drive insights.
* Collaboration – Works effectively across functions.
* Adaptability – Handles change and pressure well.
* Attention to Detail – Ensures accuracy in all outputs.



  





**Technical skills:**



* Financial Modeling – Builds and interprets valuation models.
* Capital Markets – Understands investor behaviors and trends.
* Regulatory Reporting – Ensures compliance with disclosure rules.
* Presentations – Creates compelling investor materials.
* CRM \& BI Tools – Manages data and stakeholder tracking.
* Project Management – Leads IR campaigns and events.
* Excellent business and technical report writing skills.

 University or graduate level degree in law or equivalent.

 Membership or qualification in a recognized legal society or bar association required.

 14 to 16 years of related experience

We are supporting a hospitality investment and asset management group in Oman with the appointment of an
 **Operations Asset Manager** 
 to join their Asset Management department.
   

  

 This is an
 **owner\-side hotel portfolio role** 
 , focused on overseeing hotel performance, challenging operator results, reviewing financial and commercial performance, and supporting long\-term asset value creation.
   

  

 This is not a day\-to\-day hotel property operations role. The position is best suited to a hospitality professional with strong experience in hotel asset management, owner representation, hospitality advisory, corporate hotel operations, hotel finance, or revenue and commercial performance.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The Operations Asset Manager will represent the owner's interests across a portfolio of hotel assets. The role will monitor hotel performance, review operator submissions, assess risks and opportunities, and provide clear recommendations to support operational improvement, commercial performance, governance, and investment decision\-making.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Monitor hotel performance across occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, GOP, EBITDA, cost ratios, guest satisfaction, and operational efficiency.
* Review operating statements, budgets, forecasts, business plans, cash flow, profitability, revenue performance, cost structures, and capex requirements.
* Review and challenge hotel operator performance, assumptions, action plans, and business recommendations.
* Conduct asset reviews, operational audits, and property inspections.
* Assess service quality, brand compliance, maintenance condition, operating standards, and hotel management agreement compliance.
* Participate in owner\-operator performance review meetings.
* Track approved action plans and performance improvement initiatives.
* Analyse market trends, demand drivers, competitor positioning, pricing, segmentation, and revenue opportunities.
* Prepare asset management reports, dashboards, benchmarking analysis, and performance updates for senior stakeholders.
* Support asset repositioning, operator transitions, acquisitions, disposals, due diligence, and management agreement reviews where required.


**Required Experience**
* 8–10 years of progressive experience in hotel operations, hospitality asset management, hotel finance, revenue management, or hospitality advisory.
* At least 5 years in a senior hotel operations, asset management, owner\-representative, portfolio performance, or hospitality advisory role.
* Strong experience reviewing hotel budgets, forecasts, business plans, operating statements, capex plans, and performance reports.
* Strong understanding of hotel KPIs including occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, GOP, EBITDA, cost ratios, guest satisfaction, and market share performance.
* Experience working with upscale or luxury hotel brands.
* Ability to challenge hotel operators with confidence, evidence, and commercial judgement.
* Strong Excel, reporting, dashboarding, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Exposure to STR, HotStats, Opera, IDS, EzRMS, MARSHA, SkyRes, or similar platforms would be an advantage.


**Suitable Backgrounds**
 This role may suit candidates currently or previously working in:
   

  

* Hotel asset management
* Owner representation
* Hospitality advisory or consulting
* Hotel investment or development
* Corporate or regional hotel operations
* Hotel finance or commercial performance
* Revenue management with strong portfolio and owner\-side exposure


**Important Clarification**
 This is an
 **Asset Management department role** 
 focused on owner\-side hotel portfolio oversight. Applicants should have strong financial, commercial, operational, and stakeholder management exposure, not only day\-to\-day hotel property operations.
   

  

 Applications will be reviewed based on job\-related experience, technical capability, and suitability for the role.

**Head of HR \& Technology** 




*Global Leadership • Digital HR Transformation • Executive Hire* 




  





**This isn't a "keep the lights on" HR technology role.** 




 This is a mandate to reimagine how people technology operates across a 15,000\+ employee global workforce —
 **architecting AI\-enabled HR systems, leading large\-scale HRIS transformation,** 
 and building the digital infrastructure that powers one of the world's fastest\-growing technology enterprises.
 



**If you've done it at scale, built the roadmap, led the teams, and influenced at C\-suite level — read on.** 




  





**The Role** 




 As Head of HR \& Technology, you will own the end\-to\-end global HR technology strategy for an internationally acclaimed, market\-leading organisation at the forefront of digital HR transformation. Operating across multiple continents and jurisdictions — from the UAE and Gibraltar to Malta, the Isle of Man, Poland, and Latvia — you will lead a significant, multi\-regional HR Technology team and act as the primary architect of a people\-centric digital ecosystem that scales with the business.
 



**This is a rare executive opportunity to define, build, and deliver a truly modern HR technology function — with the mandate, the budget, and the leadership backing to make it happen.** 




  





**What You'll Do** 



* Own and lead the global HR technology strategy and roadmap — aligning HRIS capabilities with ambitious business growth targets and the organisation's long\-range people agenda.
* Drive end\-to\-end HRIS implementations and major platform upgrades (Workday, SuccessFactors or equivalent), from business case through go\-live and continuous improvement.
* Champion AI\-enabled HR transformation — deploying intelligent automation, workforce analytics and predictive talent tools that put data at the heart of every people decision.
* Partner closely with the C\-level and senior HR leadership to co\-design scalable operating models and next\-generation digital HR ecosystems that serve a globally dispersed workforce.
* Oversee the full HR tech architecture: ATS, LMS, performance management, payroll integration, employee self\-service and beyond — ensuring a seamless, consumer\-grade employee experience.
* Build, lead and inspire a high\-performing global HR Technology team across multiple regions, establishing clear standards, career pathways and a culture of continuous innovation.
* Lead change management and adoption programmes for all new technology deployments — ensuring maximum ROI and genuine behavioural change across the organisation.
* Manage strategic vendor relationships, SLA governance and the global HR technology budget, negotiating for value and holding partners accountable to delivery.
* Ensure data integrity, regulatory compliance and security across all HR platforms, maintaining rigorous governance standards across every operating jurisdiction.
* Build executive\-level people analytics capabilities — dashboards, reporting frameworks and workforce intelligence tools that drive evidence\-based decision\-making at every level.



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* 10\+ years of progressive HR Technology, HRIS or People Technology leadership experience — ideally with a track record spanning both strategy and hands\-on execution.
* Proven expertise leading global HRIS implementations at scale (Workday, SuccessFactors or comparable enterprise platforms) — you've done the full lifecycle, not just the strategy deck.
* Deep knowledge of digital HR transformation, AI\-enabled HR tools, HR data architecture and emerging technologies reshaping the future of work.

* A rare combination of strategic vision and the tenacity to execute — you set the direction and you drive it home.
* Outstanding stakeholder management, influencing and change management capability — you bring people on the journey and make transformation stick.



  





**Why This Role** 



* Digital transformation at genuine scale — lead a programme that will define HR technology for a 10,000\+ employee global workforce across 15\+ countries.
* AI and innovation at the core — full mandate to embed intelligent HR tools, predictive analytics and automation in a business that genuinely embraces technology as a competitive differentiator.
* Global remit, real executive influence — report into senior leadership, partner with the C\-level and shape the people strategy of one of the most dynamic international technology enterprises operating today.
* Build something that matters — this is a greenfield opportunity with the backing, budget and talent to deliver it. The strategy is yours to write.



  





**Ready to lead the future of HR technology on a global stage?** 




 Apply now or reach out directly for a confidential conversation. Shortlisting is underway — don't delay.

**Join Our Team: Vice President Operations \& Maintenance Power at EtihadWE** 




  





 We are seeking a talented and experienced Vice President Operations \& Maintenance Power. In this key role, you will lead and manage the operations and maintenance of EtihadWE power generation and distribution assets. This ensures that all power facilities are operated safely, efficiently, and in compliance with regulatory standards. The VP is tasked with implementing strategic plans for O\&M, driving operational excellence, managing resources, and ensuring the long\-term reliability and sustainability of the power infrastructure.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Develop and execute a comprehensive O\&M strategy for the power sector in alignment with EtihadWE overall objectives.
* Provide leadership in setting long\-term operational goals and performance metrics for power generation, transmission, and distribution assets.
* Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to ensure efficient operations, reduced downtime, and optimal utilization of resources.
* Ensure that O\&M strategies align with regulatory and environmental compliance requirements, industry best practices, and technological innovations.
* Oversee the day\-to\-day operations of all power generation and distribution facilities, including power plants, substations, transformers, and transmission lines.
* Ensure the reliable, safe, and efficient generation and delivery of electrical power to consumers, optimizing system performance and minimizing interruptions.
* Develop and enforce protocols to manage emergencies, outages, and equipment failures, ensuring quick recovery and minimal operational impact.
* Supervise the scheduling and coordination of operational activities to meet both peak demand and regulatory requirements.
* Lead all preventive and corrective maintenance programs, ensuring that equipment and systems are properly maintained to prevent unexpected failures.
* Manage the lifecycle of assets, identifying opportunities for capital improvements, retrofits, and upgrades to extend the life and enhance the efficiency of equipment.
* Ensure that maintenance activities comply with safety standards and regulations, reducing downtime and maximizing asset availability.
* Oversee the implementation of predictive and condition\-based maintenance technologies to improve asset performance and reduce unscheduled outages.
* Champion a culture of safety within the O\&M team, ensuring all operations comply with workplace safety standards and regulations.
* Ensure that all power operations adhere to environmental, health, and safety regulations, minimizing the environmental impact of power facilities.
* Oversee risk management strategies to identify, assess, and mitigate risks related to power operations, including financial, operational, and reputational risks.
* Develop and manage the annual O\&M budget for power generation and distribution facilities, ensuring cost\-effective operations while maintaining high performance standards.
* Identify cost\-saving opportunities and operational efficiencies, including optimizing resource utilization and reducing waste.
* Manage procurement and vendor contracts related to power O\&M, ensuring best value for goods and services and compliance with EtihadWE policies.



  





**Qualifications:** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Energy Management, or a related field.
* Master’s degree in Business Administration (MBA), Engineering, or a related discipline is preferred.
* 12 to 16 years experience in power generation, operations, and maintenance, with a leadership role.
* Strong leadership, team management, and interpersonal skills.
* Excellent financial management skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* High level of initiative, self\-motivation, and accountability.
* Strategic thinking and the ability to align O\&M initiatives with broader business objectives.
* Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
* Deep technical knowledge of power generation, transmission, and distribution systems.



  





**Why Join EtihadWE?** 




 At EtihadWE, we’re shaping the future of the utilities sector while fostering an inclusive and innovative work environment. Be part of a team that values integrity, excellence, and collaboration.

data.jd_text:
**About the role** 




 We are looking for a senior commercial leader to own the entire revenue function of the company. As Head of Business Development, you will report directly to the CEO and carry full P\&L responsibility for the BD division — setting strategy, owning the budget, managing a growing team, and driving revenue growth across three core streams: direct client acquisition, practitioner attraction, and strategic partnerships.
 



 This is a founding leadership role. You will build the commercial infrastructure from scratch and provide strategic direction to the Client Manager, Wellness Coaches, and potentially the Head of Marketing as a unified commercial and client experience function.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




***P\&L \& COMMERCIAL STRATEGY***



* Own the full P\&L of the Business Development division — budget planning, revenue forecasting, and delivery of financial targets
* Drive revenue growth across three core streams: direct client acquisition, practitioner attraction, and strategic partnerships
* Build a scalable, recurring revenue model — transitioning the center from individual transactions to long\-term membership subscriptions
* Design and execute the go\-to\-market strategy for membership programs
* Report on commercial performance directly to the CEO; contribute to board\-level strategic planning



  





***STREAM 1 — DIRECT CLIENT ACQUISITION***



* Build and personally manage a high\-value client database through direct outreach, private events, and VIP networking
* Organize and host private club engagements, exclusive previews, and curated experiences to convert prospects into members
* Act to acquire new clients and manage client relationships, both new and existing
* Lead the end\-to\-end sales cycle — from first contact to signed membership



  





***STREAM 2 — PRACTITIONER ATTRACTION***



* Identify and map top\-performing independent medical practitioners relevant to the center's offering, and introduce them to leadership for evaluation
* Build long\-term relationships with these practitioners; lead the process of signing and managing independent contractor agreements
* Maintain an active pipeline of practitioner prospects and track conversion from first relationship to signed, onboarded contractor



  





***STREAM 3 — STRATEGIC PARTNERSHIPS***



* Cultivate relationships across the UAE's private medical and wellness community — specialists, clinics, and complementary health providers — positioning the center as the go\-to partner for comprehensive longevity care
* Develop collaborations with complementary industries — luxury hospitality, private banking, wellness brands, and concierge services — to create new client acquisition channels
* Build strong relationships and manage contracts with corporate partners and other complementary organizations
* Structure and negotiate partnership agreements that align with the center's premium positioning



  





***TEAM LEADERSHIP***



* Lead, coach, and develop a team: align individual KPIs with overall revenue goals
* Build team structures, workflows, and performance frameworks appropriate for a premium pre\-launch environment



  





***MARKET INTELLIGENCE \& REPORTING***



* Track competitor positioning across the Dubai longevity and premium health landscape
* Contribute to the pricing architecture and membership tier design based on market data and client feedback
* Monitor performance of commercial activities using key metrics and prepare regular reports for the CEO and leadership team



  





**What We're Looking For** 




***EXPERIENCE***



* 8–12 years of business development or commercial leadership experience, with at least 3 years managing a team
* Proven P\&L ownership in a premium, client\-facing environment — luxury healthcare, aesthetic clinics, private banking, luxury hospitality, or high\-end concierge services
* Experience building and managing independent contractor or referral relationships with medical practitioners, ideally including familiarity with DHA licensing and clinical governance processes
* Established personal network in the UAE — across business, medical, or luxury lifestyle communities; UAE\-based preferred



  





***SKILLS \& ATTRIBUTES***



* Strategic thinker with hands\-on execution capability — comfortable at both board\-level planning and closing individual deals
* Commercially fluent in longevity medicine — able to speak credibly about diagnostics, biomarkers, and health optimization protocols without a clinical background
* Strong people leader: able to build, align, and motivate a small but high\-performing commercial team
* Highly presentable and culturally fluent — at ease engaging ultra\-high\-net\-worth individuals across diverse nationalities and business cultures

As the General Manager \& Pre\-Opening Operations Lead, you will lead the successful pre\-opening, launch, and operation of Earth Jumeirah Beach while supporting the operational development, future pre\-openings, and ongoing evolution of the Earth Hotels portfolio.
   

  

 This role combines hands\-on hotel leadership with strategic pre\-opening support, helping shape the operating standards, guest experience, service philosophy, and opening frameworks that will support future Earth Hotels properties.
   

  

 You will work closely with the Co\-Founders to build not only an exceptional hotel, but a scalable operating model that can be replicated across future openings.
   

  

**What on Earth Will You Do?**
* Assume full responsibility for the day\-to\-day leadership, management, and performance of Earth Jumeirah Beach.
* Lead the successful pre\-opening, launch, and stabilization of the property, ensuring operational readiness across all departments.
* Oversee all operational functions including Rooms, Food \& Beverage, Engineering, Security, Finance, and Citizen \& Culture.
* Recruit, develop, and inspire a high\-performing leadership team aligned with Earth Hotels' values and service philosophy.
* Deliver agreed financial objectives through effective budgeting, forecasting, cost control, and commercial decision\-making.
* Drive guest satisfaction and brand advocacy by ensuring consistently exceptional guest experiences.
* Maintain a strong presence within the hotel and serve as the face of the property to guests, partners, owners, and the local community.
* Ensure full compliance with all statutory, licensing, health, safety, and regulatory requirements.
* Lead Executive Committee meetings and foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Partner closely with Revenue, Sales \& Marketing, and Finance teams to maximize performance and achieve business targets.
* Develop a high\-performing leadership team capable of sustaining operational excellence as the business and portfolio continue to grow.
* Review, define, and continuously improve brand standards, SOPs, and service philosophy in collaboration with Brand, Design, and Commercial teams.
* Develop operational playbooks and KPIs across Rooms, F\&B, Engineering, Front Office, Housekeeping, Sales \& Events.
* Ensure brand standards are embedded into daily operations and consistently upheld.
* Leverage operational data and analytics to drive commercial and strategic decisions.
* Participate in ongoing strategic reviews with the Managing Partner and executive leadership.
* Own the end\-to\-end operational opening program including timelines, RACI structures, milestone tracking, and readiness checklists.
* Oversee core operational deliverables: OS\&E, kitchen commissioning, systems integrations (PMS/POS), inventory planning, and compliance documentation.
* Support recruitment and onboarding of opening teams; validate readiness before launch.
* Plan and execute mock services, soft openings, and final readiness assessments; provide go/no\-go recommendations.
* Coordinate with project teams, authorities, and consultants to secure operational approvals and licenses.
* Support recruitment and onboarding of property leadership teams with focus on operational capability and culture alignment.
* Develop structured training programs including leadership bootcamps and SOP certifications.
* Establish operational rituals and accountability systems that drive performance and retention.
* Partner with Citizen \& Culture team on compliance, workforce planning, and performance management frameworks.
* Act as primary operations liaison with Development, Design, Procurement, F\&B Concept, Revenue, Marketing, and Finance.
* Lead cross\-functional workshops translating design and concept into executable operating procedures.
* Represent Operations in executive steering committees, owner discussions, and investor engagements, providing clear updates on performance, operational priorities, risks, and strategic initiatives.
* Communicate operational risks, mitigation strategies, and performance updates clearly and proactively.
* Lead system implementation and validation across PMS, POS, CRS, HRIS, EMS, and inventory platforms.
* Ensure system integrations are operationally ready before opening.
* Manage brand\-level vendor relationships and SLAs for outsourced services.
* Validate vendor performance and contract compliance across properties.
* Establish structured guest recovery frameworks and CRM feedback loops.
* Monitor online reputation and guest sentiment during opening and stabilization phases.
* Implement rapid corrective plans to protect brand positioning and service standards.
* Support the planning, operational readiness, and successful delivery of future Earth Hotels pre\-openings, working alongside project and property teams from concept through opening.
* Travel to future Earth Hotels projects as required to support pre\-opening activities, operational readiness, hotel openings, and post\-opening stabilization.
* Support the Co\-Founders in shaping the operational foundations and pre\-opening strategy of the Earth Hotels brand.
* Contribute to the development and refinement of brand standards, SOPs, service rituals, and operational playbooks for future properties.
* Share learnings and best practices from the opening and operation of Earth Jumeirah Beach to support future openings.
* Lead or support feasibility reviews, operational planning, and pre\-opening strategies for future Earth Hotels projects.
* Provide operational leadership, coaching, and opening support to future General Managers and hotel leadership teams.
* Collaborate with Development, Design, Procurement, and Brand teams to ensure concepts are translated into executable operating models.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, consistency, and scalability across the growing portfolio.
* Support the establishment of operational KPIs, reporting frameworks, and quality assurance processes for future expansion.
* Represent Operations in strategic discussions relating to the growth and evolution of the Earth Hotels portfolio.
* Undertake additional operational projects and responsibilities as assigned by the Co\-Founders in line with the business's stage of development.
* Ensure all property safety, health, and service regulations are followed consistently.
* Maintain a clean, safe, and welcoming environment in operational and site visits.
* Remain flexible and adaptable, stepping in wherever needed to support portfolio success.
* Perform additional duties as assigned by management.


**Deliverables**
* Successful opening and operational stabilization of Earth Jumeirah Beach.
* Achievement of agreed financial, guest satisfaction, and operational performance targets.
* Development of a high\-performing and engaged leadership team.
* Strong online reputation and effective guest recovery processes.
* Full operational readiness, compliance, and execution across all hotel functions.
* Operational playbooks, SOP libraries, and training frameworks supporting future growth.
* Opening readiness documentation and post\-opening improvement plans.
* Scalable operational standards and frameworks to support future Earth Hotels openings.
* Successful support of future Earth Hotels pre\-openings, operational readiness, and opening programmes.

data.jd_text:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
   

  

 The Position
   

  

 By concentrating on healthcare’s toughest challenges, we’ve been able to make many major breakthroughs, improving lives around the world. But there’s still work to be done.
   

  

****The Opportunity****
 We are seeking a Patient Journey Partner (PJP) to join our team.
   

  

 The Patient Journey Partner (PJP) is at the center of the new Roche organization, turning upside down the role we play in society \- from mostly offering world\-class medicines towards much more partnering, innovating and leading generative disruption. By doing so the PJP will be directly accountable to deliver better outcomes for patients, their community, the ecosystem and the organisation, faster.
   

  

 The PJP is an empowered leader and the local face of Roche. She or he partners closely with all stakeholders directly touching the patient journey (in a given therapeutic or disease area), gaining a deep understanding of their needs in order to connect Roche’s capabilities to co\-create meaningful solutions.
   

  

 This role is locally embedded in the ecosystem, it is an integrated role, functionally agnostic, (i.e. it does not fit into the traditional concepts of Commercial/Sales or Medical Affairs)
   

  

 It has no profitability, sales objectives or incentives
   

  

****Your Impact****
 The PJP is a senior level role within the affiliate, who has decision making authority to request resources of Roche (both within the affiliate and broader network) in order to have improved impact on the patient journey
   

  

* The PJP focuses on the importance of bringing the outside in, working with partners to uncover all potential opportunities to transform outcomes for patients, faster. They also bring the inside out, to bring Roche expertise, science and knowledge to the ecosystem
* Acts as trusted partner and is the primary (but non\-exclusive) point of contact between stakeholders and Roche; the PJP shares the patient and stakeholder community needs internally, prioritizes and secures resources, and drives solutions that deliver outcomes faster
* Partners with patient journey stakeholders to remove roadblocks and unlock possibilities to deliver value for patients and the community
* Stewards Roche’s products through their lifecycle and supports their appropriate use, which includes sharing their merits with HCPs in a truthful and balanced manner
* By overseeing the patient journey in its entirety, the PJP acts as a system thinker with the ability to identify shared purpose among stakeholders and leverages this to co\-create solutions with stakeholders in the ecosystem
* The role is empowered to pull in expertise and resources locally and from the network as needed, including in collaboration with other PJPs
* Ensuring great experiences whenever stakeholders in the ecosystem engage with Roche employees, products and services


****Who you are****
* You possess a university degree in a scientific, economic, or business field; an advanced degree in life sciences or an MBA is a plus
* You have a proven track record in leading cross\-functional teams, formulating strategies, and orchestrating execution, with experience partnering with patient advocacy groups (PAGs) being highly desirable
* You demonstrate strong business expertise, particularly in commercialization, medical affairs, and customer experience excellence, and have experience with agile ways of working
* You excel in stakeholder engagement, including partnering with therapeutic area experts (TAEs) and organizations, with excellent collaboration and communication skills
* You possess deep knowledge of patient journeys and treatments in defined disease areas, enabling meaningful engagement with specialists and external stakeholders
* You are skilled at leveraging digital tools and innovation methodologies to enhance outcomes and create scalable value
* You demonstrate a growth mindset, entrepreneurial spirit, and a commitment to acting with integrity while navigating complexity and making bold, value\-driven decisions
* You are fluent in the local language and proficient in English, enabling seamless collaboration across the Roche global enterprise


 Who we are
   

  

 A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life\-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
   

  

 Let’s build a healthier future, together.
   

  

**Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

 McGraw Hill is seeking a visionary
 **Vice President of International Product** 
 to lead our global Higher Education product strategy and drive product\-market\-fit across international markets. This is a rare opportunity to shape the future of education technology on a global scale, building a world\-class product organization that serves diverse markets, cultures, and educational systems.
   

  

 As a member of the Higher Education Product Leadership Team, you'll report directly to our Chief Product Officer and have a powerful voice in defining how McGraw Hill innovates and competes globally. This role combines strategic product leadership, cross\-functional team management, and organizational culture\-building into a single high\-impact position.
   

  

**What You’ll Do:**
**Own International Product Strategy**
 Develop and maintain compelling regional product strategies that achieve product\-market\-fit across geographies. You'll evaluate and optimize multiple variables—content, platform capabilities, commercialization models, and revenue strategies—to ensure viability and growth.
   

  

**Lead and Develop International Product Teams**
 Manage product team members globally. You'll build a connected, empowered team that embodies McGraw Hill's culture while maintaining a global perspective. This includes fostering collaboration, mentorship, and professional development across distributed teams.
   

  

**Shape the Product Roadmap**
 Influence our global product roadmap through compelling business cases, persuasive ROI analysis, and attractive revenue opportunities. You'll advocate for regional priorities while understanding how they fit into our broader product vision.
   

  

**Drive Localization Excellence**

 As a member of the leadership team, you'll help instill a global perspective and culture across the entire product organization. You'll champion regional insights and drive the company's thinking on international education trends.

data.jd_text:
A reputable financial technology company, is looking for a seasoned Project Delivery Manager who combines rigorous delivery discipline with deep techno\-functional knowledge of fintech platforms.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will own client implementations end to end, driving structured execution while also being the person who understands how the company's modules work, can engage meaningfully in technical discussions, and bridges business needs with platform capabilities.
   

  

 This is not a coordination role. It is a delivery leadership role that demands both craft and substance.
   

  

****Key Responsibilities:****
**Project Delivery and Governance:**
* Own end\-to\-end delivery of the company's implementation projects, from kickoff through post\-go\-live, across fintech and financial services clients in the GCC.
* Develop and maintain key project documentation, Project Charters, delivery plans, RAID logs, and progress reports, structured to drive alignment, not just record\-keeping.
* Lead steering committee engagements. Presenting delivery status, managing escalations, and keeping senior stakeholders on both sides informed and aligned.
* Manage project budgets, timelines, dependencies, and risks while maintaining compliance with SAMA and GCC regulatory and governance frameworks.
* Lead and coordinate cross\-functional teams. Aligning engineering, product, and client stakeholders around clear ownership, priorities, and delivery milestones.
* Contribute to the company's PMO. Improving delivery frameworks, reporting standards, and implementation playbooks as the function scales.


**Techno\-Functional \& Client:**
* Build deep functional knowledge of the company's modules: payments, collections, disbursements, cards, lending, open banking, so you can guide configuration decisions and resolve ambiguity without constantly escalating to product or engineering.
* Engage meaningfully in technical integration reviews, understand gaps before they become delivery blockers.
* Contribute in functional workshops, translating client business requirements into platform configurations and delivery scope that both engineering teams and clients can commit to.
* Act as a trusted delivery partner to clients, building long\-term relationships through transparency, delivery excellence, and a genuine understanding of their business.
* Stay current on digital banking trends, payments innovation, and emerging technologies to keep the company's delivery approach sharp and forward\-looking.


****Role Requirements:****
**Experience \& Background:**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.
* 6–10 years in project management or delivery roles within consulting, fintech, or banking technology in the GCC with a track record of owning complex implementations end to end.
* Proven experience in team leadership, cross\-functional coordination, and task allocation across multi\-disciplinary delivery teams.
* Proven experience delivering complex core banking or retail banking implementations, or end\-to\-end card management programs is a must.
* Previous experience in Product Management or Techno\-Functional Role is a plus


**Project Management Skills:**
* Strong command of project planning, risk management, dependency tracking, and budget oversight across the full delivery lifecycle.
* Fluency in both Agile and Waterfall methodologies, comfortable adapting the approach to the project context rather than defaulting to one.
* Hands\-on with modern PM tools: Jira, Confluence, MS Project, or equivalent with documentation and reporting treated as a first\-class habit.
* Solid understanding of risk, governance, compliance, and SAMA regulatory frameworks in Saudi Arabia's fintech landscape.


**Techno\-Functional Skills:**
* Basic functional understanding of payments infrastructure: how payment rails, collections, disbursements, reconciliation, and open banking flows work end to end.
* Enough technical depth to engage in API integration discussions and spot where integration decisions will create downstream issues.
* Ability to contribute in functional requirement workshops producing specs that engineering and clients both trust.
* Capacity to make independent platform and configuration decisions, you understand the product deeply enough to resolve grey areas without constant escalation.


**Soft Skills \& Culture:**
* Strong communication and presentation skills, equally effective in a C\-level steering committee and a technical integration review.
* People\-first leadership, you build trust quickly, create clarity in ambiguity, and foster collaboration across delivery teams without micromanaging.
* Ownership mindset, you take accountability for outcomes, not just activities, and you bring adaptability and maturity to fast\-moving environments.
* Arabic Native and very good English command is a must for client\-facing contexts across the GCC.


****Nice to Have:****
* Experience delivering API\-first, open banking, or embedded finance platforms in a SaaS environment.
* Previous experience in product management or techno\-functional consultancy.
* Background in solution consulting, pre\-sales, or functional analysis for fintech or banking platforms.
* Familiarity with core banking systems or payment switching infrastructure.
* PMP, PRINCE2, or Agile certifications.

data.jd_text:
SYSTRA is one of the world's leading engineering and consultancy groups specialising in public transport and sustainable mobility. With over 10,300 employees, SYSTRA's mission is to design safe and sustainable transport solutions to bring people together, develop social inclusion and facilitate access to employment, education and leisure throughout the world.
   

  

 For 65 years, the Group has been working alongside cities and regions to contribute to their development by creating, improving and modernising their infrastructure and transport systems, throughout the life cycle of their projects. SYSTRA is involved from the earliest stages of design through to the testing, deployment and maintenance phases. The company provides all its services in over 80 countries worldwide and generates 74% of its turnover internationally. With its new services, SYSTRA supports its clients and partners in their digital, ecological and energy transition, in order to invent the mobility of tomorrow.
   

  

 Context
   

  

***This requirement is for a bid opportunity only at this stage. Any engagement will be subject to successful project award and final client approval.***
 The Project Delivery Manager will be responsible for leading the successful delivery of the conventional railway and freight rail program, with a strong focus on construction execution, package coordination, interface management, and delivery performance. The role requires a highly capable leader with deep expertise in managing large\-scale conventional railway, freight rail, and associated infrastructure works, coordinating multidisciplinary teams, resolving complex technical and delivery interfaces, and ensuring execution in line with project requirements for schedule, budget, quality, safety, and operational performance. The position demands substantial experience in delivering integrated works across conventional rail corridors, freight alignments, yards, depots, terminals, and associated infrastructure, including coordination of civil, structural, track, systems, MEP, architectural, utilities, and operational interfaces, while ensuring compliance with project specifications, applicable standards, regulatory requirements, and the operational needs of conventional and freight railway systems.
   

  

 Missions/Main Duties
   

  

* Lead and manage the overall construction delivery of the railway program across multiple project packages, work fronts, or contractor interfaces.
* Drive site execution strategies to ensure safe, efficient, and timely delivery of all construction activities.
* Oversee and coordinate construction teams, subcontractors, package managers, and support functions to achieve program milestones.
* Ensure strong integration between engineering, procurement, construction, commercial, planning, contracts, and project controls functions.
* Monitor construction progress and productivity, and implement recovery plans where required to address delays or performance gaps.
* Manage site\-related risks, constructability issues, sequencing constraints, logistics challenges, and interface coordination across the program.
* Lead delivery reviews, construction progress meetings, and reporting processes to ensure transparency and timely decision\-making.
* Ensure construction activities are executed in compliance with project specifications, contractual requirements, quality standards, and HSE regulations.
* Support the development of construction methodologies, phasing plans, mobilization strategies, and execution plans during bid and post\-award stages.
* Act as a key point of contact for internal stakeholders, contractors, consultants, and the client on all matters related to delivery and construction performance.
* Promote a strong site culture focused on safety, quality, productivity, accountability, and delivery excellence.
* Support testing, commissioning readiness, and handover planning in coordination with relevant teams, where required.


 Profile/Skills
   

  

* The successful candidate will be a hands\-on, delivery\-focused leader with strong construction execution capability and a proven ability to manage complex railway works in live and challenging environments. They should be capable of driving site performance, managing contractors and interfaces, and ensuring coordinated delivery across multiple packages while maintaining the highest standards of safety, quality, and operational excellence. Prior conventional railway and freight rail project experience is essential.
* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a related discipline. A master’s degree is an advantage.
* Minimum 20 years of total experience in major infrastructure and construction projects.
* Strong experience in conventional railway and freight rail projects is essential.
* Proven project and construction delivery experience in leading major infrastructure, rail, or transportation projects from execution through completion.
* Strong background in construction management, site delivery, contractor coordination, and field execution.
* Prior experience in a Program Delivery Manager, Construction Delivery Manager, Senior Project Manager, or similar senior delivery role on major conventional and/or freight railway projects.
* Gulf experience preferred.
* Strong understanding of construction sequencing, site logistics, temporary works, constructability, project controls, and commercial impacts on delivery.
* Demonstrated ability to manage complex construction interfaces and multidisciplinary teams in large project environments.
* Excellent leadership, stakeholder management, communication, and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong knowledge of HSE, quality, risk, compliance, and construction best practices in major infrastructure projects, including the requirements of conventional and freight railway systems.


 Systra is an equal opportunities company; this position is open to all applicants.

 Core Competencies

data.jd_text:
**Locations** 
 : Dubai \| Riyadh
   

  

 Who We Are
   

  

 The Middle East IT Service Manager is the face of Tech@BCG in a key market for BCG. Spanning Dubai, Riyadh, Doha, Abu Dhabi, and Kuwait, this role is not a back\-office function: it is the primary connection between a demanding regional business and the global IT organisation. Local business leadership knows this person by name, calls them first, and relies on them to make technology work.
   

  

 The role sits at the intersection of the local business and the IT function. It owns regional IT service delivery end to end, manages senior stakeholder relationships, feeds office demand and business feedback into the IT organisation, and ensures that what is built and delivered globally actually works for the Middle East. The person in this role represents the business to IT, and IT to the business.
   

  

 In practice, this means running a tight operation, governing vendors and contracts with discipline, driving a sustained shift towards automation and AI\-enabled support, and always knowing what the numbers are telling you. It requires someone equally comfortable in a service review and a conversation with a Managing Director, who understands that trust with the business is the foundation everything else is built on.
   

  

 Beyond operations, this role demands a genuine people leader. Someone who invests in their team, listens before they act, and creates an environment where people do their best work. Within the broader EMESA IT Service community, this person is a collaborative and engaged peer: sharing what works, supporting colleagues across other regions, and contributing to a function that is stronger because its leaders work well together. If you lead with integrity, bring others with you, and take the success of the team as seriously as your own, this role is for you.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

* Stakeholder Relationships \& Business Partnering
* Serve as the primary point of contact for local business leadership across all Middle East offices as the face of Tech@BCG in the region
* Actively manage senior stakeholder relationships, building trust with office leadership and ensuring IT is seen as a partner, not a utility
* Capture, consolidate, and feed local business demand and feedback into the global IT organisation and translating office needs into inputs the IT function can act on
* Own the senior escalation path for critical incidents and high\-impact service events, and maintain playbooks for executive support and key office moments
* Capacity \& Financial Management
* Ensure regional capacity is managed in line with global and functional targets, escalating deviations and translating business demand into resourcing inputs for the IT organisation
* Build cost\-to\-serve visibility at office level to support data\-led conversations with both local leadership and global IT
* Challenge and reduce local service deviations where demand doesn’t justify them
* Drive the shift from human\-touch support to automation and self\-service. This is a direction of travel, not a one\-off project
* Automation \& AI\-Enabled Support
* Set and own targets for no\-contact and low\-contact resolution rates across the region
* Build out self\-service capabilities for high\-frequency, routine requests: if a human is handling it repeatedly, it should be automated
* Embed AI\-assisted triage and resolution tooling into local support workflows
* Maintain a live automation backlog and convert repeat demand into scalable workflows systematically
* Improve ticket and knowledge quality to cut engineering escalations and break the cycle of recurring incidents
* Security, Compliance \& Resilience
* Ensure secure fulfilment patterns are embedded in all service workflows, not treated as a separate workstream
* Enforce compliance with device management, access control, and privileged support standards
* Minimise operational risk through disciplined change management and resilience practices
* Partner closely with ISRM: regional security posture is a shared responsibility and I expect you to own your side of i


 What You'll Bring
   

  

* 8–12\+ years in IT Service Management, Digital Workplace, or End\-User Computing leadership
* Proven experience running multi\-site or regional service delivery across geographically dispersed teams
* Background in service transformation or operating model redesign : you have changed how a function works, not just run it
* Hands\-on familiarity with AI\-enabled / automated support tooling and modern ESM platforms
* Strong grounding in financial management, capacity planning, and cost\-to\-serve modelling
* Vendor management and contract governance experience in a contracted or hybrid delivery model
* Fluent English; Arabic proficiency is a genuine advantage in this region
* Readiness to travel occasionally across Middle East office locations : presence matters here

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.
